studio:prompts3:ours-712.content:
[추천·추정·시즌·품종·MBTI 등 결과] 결 매번 다르게 자체 생성합니다.
- 사용자 결 결과 텍스트 결 박지 마세요. AI 결 사진 결 보고 자동 작성합니다.
- 아래 옵션 (디자인 톤·색·언어·길이 등) 만 사용자가 customize 합니다.

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a rich 4-panel seasonal outfit transformation image using the same source person across all seasons, designed as a realistic editorial fashion comparison card for social sharing and portfolio-style presentation.
The image should clearly show one {원본 인물} re-styled into spring, summer, autumn, and winter looks with consistent framing, readable Korean labels, and lifestyle details that make each season feel authentic.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the same {원본 인물} in all 4 panels, with each panel using the same waist-up or full-body framing for easy seasonal comparison.
- Use a structured {레이아웃} with four matching vertical panels, elegant thin dividers, and a polished magazine-look comparison format so each season occupies clear visual weight.
- Place each seasonal look in its own realistic {배경}: spring near blooming trees or a bright street café, summer near a beach boardwalk or sunlit terrace, autumn on a leaf-covered park path, winter in a snowy city street or frosted outdoor setting.
- Use {4 시즌} as the visual transformation guide, with each panel differentiated by clothing, atmosphere, accessories, fabric texture, and color tone rather than major pose changes.
- Keep the overall canvas proportion aligned to {비율}, with a finished editorial layout that includes title text, small captions, seasonal tags, and subtle graphic accents.
- Add a small top header like a social fashion guide: "4계절 스타일 변환" plus a date label such as "2026 STYLE GUIDE" and a small handle such as "@season.look".
- Add seasonal label blocks in each panel: "봄 SPRING", "여름 SUMMER", "가을 AUTUMN", "겨울 WINTER", with one short Korean outfit caption per panel.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Panel 1 — Spring: place {원본 인물} in a pastel spring outfit with soft floral cues, light cotton or linen fabric texture, fresh mint/pink accents, and a bright outdoor background with cherry blossoms, café table details, or a light tote bag accessory.
2. Panel 2 — Summer: style {원본 인물} in a cool blue summer outfit with breathable fabric, relaxed silhouette, sunlight highlights, sunglasses or a light cap detail, and a refreshing seasonal background with sky, terrace, beach boardwalk, or sparkling water cues.
3. Panel 3 — Autumn: dress {원본 인물} in a warm fall look with layered knit textures, amber and rust tones, scarf or leather-bag styling, and a grounded natural background with fallen leaves, warm street lamps, or park path depth.
4. Panel 4 — Winter: render {원본 인물} in a thick winter coat with heavier fabric volume, knit scarf or gloves, icy blue and charcoal tones, visible breath or snow detail, and a crisp seasonal background with frosted glass, snowflakes, or winter city lights.
5. Across all four panels, keep face identity, body proportions, skin tone, hairstyle logic, and camera angle consistent so the transformation reads as outfit, styling, and environment change only.
6. Include small realistic editorial details: fabric swatch dots, tiny weather icons, micro caption lines, and a page indicator such as "LOOK 01 / 04", "LOOK 02 / 04", "LOOK 03 / 04", "LOOK 04 / 04".
7. Add short Korean captions that match the theme, for example: "가벼운 파스텔 레이어", "시원한 블루 포인트", "따뜻한 니트 무드", "포근한 윈터 코트".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: set Korean labels in Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold, 22–30px for season names, with smaller 12–16px caption text for details; keep text crisp and accurately rendered.
- Color palette: spring pastel pink and mint, summer sky blue and white, autumn amber and rust, winter icy blue and charcoal; harmonize them into a balanced 4-panel comparison using {컬러} as the overall grading reference.
- Border/shadow: use thin white or light-gray dividers with subtle 2–4px soft shadow, 10–15% opacity, to separate panels without heavy framing.
- Graphic accents: add small seasonal stickers, fabric texture chips, weather symbols, and micro UI-style save/share icons in a refined editorial manner.
- Text hierarchy: make the main title readable, the four season labels clear, and all smaller details secondary but still legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm portrait lens look, f/2.8, natural perspective, consistent framing across panels.
- Lighting: each panel should use seasonal lighting cues while staying realistic — spring soft diffused daylight, summer bright clear daylight, autumn warm late-afternoon light, winter cool overcast daylight.
- Color grade: seasonal but cohesive editorial grading, with slightly muted saturation and clear tone separation for each season.
- Texture detail: show believable fabric weave, coat volume, knit texture, hair detail, skin texture, and natural background depth.
- Layout finish: polished fashion lookbook card with a magazine spread feel, subtle shadows, layered labels, and realistic photographic depth.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial seasonal wardrobe comparison — realistic fashion lookbook layout with a lively magazine spread feel, combining lifestyle photography, Korean style-guide captions, and four clearly differentiated seasonal atmospheres.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all Korean labels must render perfectly with no broken characters; use readable text such as "4계절 스타일 변환", "봄 SPRING", "여름 SUMMER", "가을 AUTUMN", "겨울 WINTER", "가벼운 파스텔 레이어", "시원한 블루 포인트", "따뜻한 니트 무드", "포근한 윈터 코트".
- The same {원본 인물} must remain recognizably consistent across all 4 panels, with no face drift or identity changes.
- All 4 panels must show the same layout and framing logic, with only season, clothing, background, accessories, and color treatment changing.
- Respect {배경}, {조명}, {컬러}, {레이아웃}, and {비율} while enriching each panel with realistic seasonal details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-711.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- ratio_note: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
i2i 한복 전통·모던 변환용 세로형 인물 보정 포스터. 입력 인물의 얼굴 정체성과 기본 포즈를 유지한 채, 전통 한복 또는 모던·생활 한복 스타일로 자연스럽게 재해석하고, 실제 촬영된 한복 프로필 카드처럼 날짜·장소·짧은 캡션이 포함된 완성형 결과물.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {원본 인물}이 프레임 중앙 60%를 차지하는 반신~무릎 위 구도, 얼굴은 화면 상단 1/3 지점에 위치, 시선은 카메라 정면.
- Background treatment: {배경}의 결을 살린 은은한 배경, 한지 섬유 질감, 한옥 목재 기둥, 창호 문살, 낮은 화병이나 보자기 소품처럼 현장에 자연스럽게 있을 법한 요소를 깊이감 있게 배치.
- Framing: 소매·저고리·치마의 실루엣이 화면 안에서 잘 읽히도록 세로 포스터 구도로 정돈하고, 인물 주변에는 얇은 한지 질감 타이틀 영역과 작은 정보 라벨이 자연스럽게 어우러지게 구성.
- Style mapping: {한복 결}의 디테일을 살리되 실제 의상처럼 자연스럽게 드레이프되도록 하고, {컬러}는 깃·고름·소매 끝·치마 주름에서 포인트 대비가 보이게 유지.
- Editorial layer: 상단 또는 좌측에 작은 프로필 카드형 타이포그래피를 넣고, {포스터 제목}, {촬영 날짜}, {촬영 장소}, {캡션}, {태그 문구}가 한복 초상 사진집처럼 읽히게 배치.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero body: {원본 인물}의 얼굴과 기본 체형은 그대로 유지한 상태에서, 한복이 자연스럽게 착장된 상반신 중심 구도로 정리.
2. Outfit conversion: {한복 결}을 전통 한복 실루엣 또는 모던·생활 한복 실루엣으로 변환하되, 천의 주름, 깃 선, 고름 매듭, 동정, 소매 끝단이 실제 섬유처럼 보이게 렌더링.
3. Background integration: {배경}을 인물 뒤로 부드럽게 연결하고, 창호지 패턴, 목재 결, 한지 벽면, 낮은 전통 소품의 질감이 인물과 같은 조명 안에 존재하도록 구성.
4. Pose preservation: {자세}를 유지하면서 어깨·팔·손 위치는 자연스럽게 보정하고, 손가락과 팔목 구조가 어색하지 않게 정리.
5. Lighting pass: {조명}을 기준으로 얼굴과 한복의 명암을 맞추고, 광택이 강하지 않은 섬유 질감 위주로 하이라이트를 조절.
6. Color balancing: {컬러}의 대비를 살리되, 전체 톤은 한지·원단·목재 질감과 어울리도록 색 번짐 없이 정돈.
7. Editorial details: 화면 하단 또는 측면에 작은 날짜·장소 라벨, 세로형 짧은 캡션, 얇은 장식 선, 매듭 문양 아이콘, 작은 필름 번호 같은 디테일을 추가하여 실제 한복 프로필 포스터처럼 완성.
8. Final polish: 피부는 과도한 미용 필터 없이 자연스럽게, 한복 가장자리와 배경 경계는 깨끗하게 정리하여 고해상도 인물 변환 결과처럼 마감.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 이미지 내 텍스트는 Pretendard SemiBold 또는 Noto Sans KR Medium, 제목 42–58px, 정보 라벨 22–30px, 세로 캡션 24–34px 수준의 단정한 인상으로 적용.
- Color palette: {컬러}를 중심으로 red #B51E23, blue #1F4E79, yellow #D8A51C, green #2F7D4A, paper beige #F3E7D3 계열을 조화롭게 사용.
- Decorative graphics: 얇은 한지 테두리선, 작은 매듭 문양, 도장처럼 보이지 않는 원형 패턴 마크, 필름 프레임 넘버, 짧은 가로 구분선을 자연스럽게 추가.
- Border/shadow: 아주 얕은 소프트 드롭 섀도우 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; 배경과 인물 사이 분리감만 확보.
- Material realism: 비단, 모시, 면, 한지, 오래된 목재 표면이 각각 다른 질감으로 구분되며, 의상 주름은 중력과 착장 구조에 맞게 흐르도록 표현.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, high-detail portrait capture 느낌.
- Lighting: soft daylight from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, soft rim light to define hanbok sleeves and jawline.
- Color grade: warm ivory paper tone with muted amber highlights, restrained crimson and indigo accents, clean natural skin tones.
- Finish: premium Korean heritage editorial poster, tactile paper texture, realistic fabric micro-detail, refined print-ready contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Korean heritage portrait editorial — Vogue Korea cover portrait meets refined Hanbok campaign aesthetic, 따뜻하고 품격 있는 개인 초상 기록의 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 이미지 안에 보이는 한글은 반드시 정확하고 선명하게 렌더링. 권장 표기: 상단 제목 “{포스터 제목}”, 작은 라벨 “{촬영 날짜} · {촬영 장소}”, 캡션 “{캡션}”, 태그 “{태그 문구}”, 필름 번호 “HANBOK PORTRAIT 05”.
- Text placement: 한글 텍스트는 얼굴을 가리지 않고, 한지 배경이나 하단 카드 영역 위에 배치하며 실제 인쇄물처럼 자간과 행간을 안정적으로 맞춤.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: original face identity preserved, no face distortion, no extra fingers, hands anatomically correct, clothing folds and sleeves must look physically plausible.
- Identity preservation: 입력 인물의 눈매, 코, 입, 얼굴형, 피부톤, 표정의 핵심 특징을 유지하고, 유명인이나 다른 사람의 얼굴로 바꾸지 않음.
- Hanbok accuracy: 깃, 동정, 고름, 치마 주름, 소매 비율이 한복 구조에 맞아야 하며, 현대식 변환이어도 착용 가능한 의상처럼 보여야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters / unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or changing the person into a famous public figure

studio:prompts3:ours-710.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
90년대 한국 사진관 느낌의 i2i 인물 톤 변환 세로형 포토 포스터.
입력 인물의 얼굴 정체성과 기본 인상을 그대로 유지하면서 {시대 결}에 맞는 필름 그레인, 빈티지 컬러, 인화지 질감, 실제 사진관에서 받은 초상 인화본 같은 주변 디테일을 더한 결과물. 완성 이미지는 한 장의 오래된 사진을 앨범에서 꺼내 다시 스캔한 듯한 포스터 카드이며, 작은 날짜/장소 라벨, 캡션, 필름 메모, 현상 번호, 사진관 보관용 마이크로 텍스트가 자연스럽게 포함된다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 인물}을 세로 {비율} 프레임의 중심 피사체로 배치하고, 머리와 어깨 라인이 자연스럽게 보이는 90년대 증명사진/스튜디오 인화 프레이밍을 만든다.
- {배경}은 인물 뒤에서 위아래로 은은하게 변하는 사진관 그라디언트 스튜디오 월로 처리하고, 가장자리는 살짝 어둡게 눌러 피사체가 앞으로 떠 보이게 한다.
- 결과물은 실제 인화된 사진을 다시 스캔한 듯한 포스터 카드로 구성한다. 하단 좌측에는 날짜/장소 라벨 “{촬영일}  {촬영장소}”, 중앙 하단에는 짧은 캡션 “{캡션문구}”, 하단 우측에는 필름 메모 “{필름메모}”와 작은 현상 번호 “{현상번호}”를 배치한다.
- 상단 한쪽 모서리에는 아주 작은 사진관 보관 메모 “{사진관명} / PORTRAIT SAMPLE”, 다른 모서리에는 앨범 분류 태그 “{앨범태그}”를 넣어 오래된 사진첩 속 실제 인화본처럼 보이게 한다.
- 전체 구도는 인물이 정면 또는 3/4 각도로 또렷하게 보이도록 유지하고, 과장된 원근감보다 플랫한 스튜디오 초상 사진 느낌을 준다.
- {의상·소품}은 인물의 실루엣을 크게 바꾸지 않는 범위에서 자연스럽게 반영한다. 90년대 사진관 촬영처럼 재킷의 어깨선, 셔츠 칼라, 작은 목걸이, 헤어핀, 캡, 얇은 금속 안경, 손에 가볍게 든 안경집 같은 소품이 실제로 존재하는 듯 정돈한다.
- 인화지 가장자리에는 약한 종이 섬유, 스캔 먼지, 미세한 모서리 눌림, 오래된 앨범에서 꺼낸 듯한 옅은 접촉 자국, 손으로 넘긴 듯한 미세한 광택 차이를 더해 현실감을 높인다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Subject render: {원본 인물}의 얼굴형, 피부 톤, 눈매, 코와 입의 주요 인상은 유지한 채 {시대 결}에 맞는 90년대 한국 사진관 필름 룩으로 변환한다.
2. Wardrobe pass: {의상·소품}을 적용하되, 90년대 청자켓/오버사이즈 재킷/니트 조끼/캡/얇은 금속 안경 같은 레트로 요소가 과장되지 않게 실제 촬영 사진처럼 정리한다.
3. Background pass: {배경}을 사진관 스튜디오 월로 만들고, 회청색·베이지·연보라 계열의 약한 그라디언트, 천 배경의 희미한 주름, 벽면 조명 번짐, 필름 노이즈가 자연스럽게 보이도록 만든다.
4. Print layout pass: 초상 사진 위 또는 하단 인화지 영역에 작은 한국어 라벨을 넣는다. 필수 텍스트는 “{촬영일}”, “{촬영장소}”, “{캡션문구}”, “{사진관명}”, “{현상번호}”이며, 실제 인쇄된 캡션처럼 약간 흐릿하지만 읽을 수 있어야 한다.
5. Micro-detail pass: 하단 여백에는 현상소 주문표처럼 보이는 작은 숫자열 “ROLL 24 / CUT 07 / REPRINT OK”, 짧은 손글씨풍 메모 “다음에 또 찍기”, 아주 작은 별표나 밑줄 태그를 추가해 현실적인 사진관 아카이브 느낌을 만든다.
6. Lighting pass: {조명}은 상단 45도 방향의 부드러운 키라이트와 약한 보조광으로 얼굴 윤곽을 살리고, 턱 아래 그림자는 짧고 부드럽게 눌러 90년대 사진관 특유의 평평한 조명을 재현한다.
7. Color grading: {컬러}를 적용해 시안, 노랑, 따뜻한 amber가 섞인 빈티지 필름 색감을 만들고, 검정은 살짝 떠 보이게, 피부는 과하게 매끈하지 않은 실제 필름 톤으로 유지한다.
8. Final print look: 전체 화면에 약한 필름 그레인, 미세한 소프트 콘트라스트, 인화지 섬유 질감, 스캐너 라인, 작은 먼지 입자와 빛샘을 얹어 디지털 티가 덜 나게 마감한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 화면 내 한국어 캡션은 Pretendard SemiBold 또는 90년대 사진관 인화 라벨 느낌의 고딕체로 작게 넣는다. 주요 예시 문구: “{촬영일}”, “{촬영장소}”, “{캡션문구}”, “{현상번호}”.
- Label details: 하단 좌측에는 날짜/장소 라벨, 하단 중앙에는 감성 캡션, 하단 우측에는 현상 번호나 필름 롤 표기, 상단 모서리에는 아주 작은 스튜디오 메모를 배치해 실제 앨범 스캔처럼 만든다.
- Decorative tags: 작은 별표, 얇은 밑줄, 모서리의 투명 테이프 자국, 연필로 적은 듯한 “보관용” 메모를 사용해 사진관 인화본의 생활감을 더한다.
- Color palette: cream white #F4EFE6, warm amber #D8A15C, muted cyan #8AA7B8, faded yellow #E6D58A, soft gray #C9C3BA.
- Border/shadow: 인화지 가장자리에 약한 비네팅, 2px 수준의 소프트 그림자, 모서리의 미세한 마모와 빛바랜 종이 톤을 적용해 오래 보관된 사진 인화 느낌을 살린다.
- Texture: 피부, 의상 원단, 헤어, 배경 천, 인화지 표면이 각각 분리되어 보이도록 실제 촬영 사진 수준의 디테일을 유지한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 emulating 90s medium-format film scan, 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, studio portrait framing, scanned glossy print 느낌.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill on the right, faint shadow under chin, controlled highlight on hair and cheekbones, no harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: faded 90s film scan with cyan-yellow shift, warm amber skin tone, slightly lifted blacks, low saturation, subtle magenta/cyan color drift at the edges.
- Material realism: visible film grain, paper fiber, faint scanner dust, slight edge darkening, soft optical blur around the background while the face remains clear.

[6. MOOD]
90년대 한국 사진관 인화본 같은 레트로 스튜디오 초상 — 오래된 필름 앨범, 동네 사진관 진열 샘플, 잡지 화보 사이의 따뜻하고 현실적인 분위기. 사진 속 인물은 현재의 셀카가 아니라 1990년대 어느 오후에 사진관에서 정성스럽게 촬영한 한 장의 보관용 초상처럼 느껴져야 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 화면에 들어가는 한글 “{촬영일}”, “{촬영장소}”, “{캡션문구}”, “{사진관명}”, “{현상번호}”, “보관용”, “다음에 또 찍기”는 글자 깨짐 없이 정확해야 한다.
- {원본 인물}의 얼굴 정체성과 기본 인상은 유지해야 하며, 실제 인물을 다른 사람처럼 바꾸지 않는다.
- 인물은 1명 기준으로 안정적으로 중앙 배치하고, 손이나 신체가 보이는 경우 해부학적으로 자연스럽고 손가락은 정확히 5개여야 한다.
- 90년대 한국 사진관 특유의 필름 그레인, 빈티지 컬러, 스튜디오 배경, 정적인 초상 구도, 인화지 스캔 질감을 유지한다.
- 추가 라벨, 태그, 모서리 장식, 필름 메모는 초상 사진의 시대감과 현실감을 높이는 역할이어야 하며, 얼굴을 가리거나 인물보다 더 강하게 시선을 빼앗지 않아야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Live club / jazz bar promotional flyer, vertical poster for nightlife event marketing and social sharing.
Dark urban gig-poster aesthetic with bilingual headline hierarchy, printed-paper realism, venue details, ticket information, and the feeling of a real flyer taped near a club entrance or posted as an Instagram story.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center a tall live-club poster design in a 1024x1536 frame, using {비율} as the intended vertical flyer proportion and keeping the design print-ready.
- Place the venue name and weekly schedule in the upper 35%, with {장소} as the primary title and {일정} as a clear date/time band.
- Place {이번 주 라인업} in the middle 30% as the strongest secondary focus, with stacked performer names, small genre notes, and divider marks that feel like a real live schedule.
- Build the background as a dark club wall and printed flyer surface: near-black charcoal paper, visible ink grain, tiny scuffs, tape marks, faint smoke haze, spotlight bloom, and subtle risograph-like texture.
- Use {장소}, {일정}, {이번 주 라인업}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포} as the core customizable content blocks, surrounded by realistic event metadata such as doors/live time, ticket price, address, reservation contact, sponsor strip, and small social handle.
- Add decorative graphic elements appropriate to a jazz/live club flyer: thin neon rules, small saxophone or microphone icons, dotted rhythm lines, corner registration marks, a small ticket stub box, and a compact QR/barcode-style reservation area.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone: set {장소} as the dominant title in bold condensed uppercase English style with a smaller Korean subtitle treatment, aligned center or slightly above center. Add tiny credit text such as “LIVE CLUB WEEKLY PROGRAM” and “VOL. 247 / NIGHT SESSION” near the top edge.
2. Schedule band: place {일정} directly below the title as a compact event-date line, using smaller but high-contrast text with tight tracking. Add supporting Korean event details: “DOORS 19:30”, “LIVE 20:00”, “서울 중구 클럽로 12 B1”, and “예매 ₩25,000 / 현장 ₩30,000”.
3. Main lineup block: feature {이번 주 라인업} in the midsection as the most legible content block, using stacked typography, plus-sign dividers, small set-time labels, and short Korean tags like “재즈 트리오”, “소울 보컬”, “레이트 잼”.
4. Visual atmosphere: build the scene around {비주얼} with a moody live-stage feel, including microphone silhouettes, saxophone and double-bass outline fragments, partial drum hardware, low crowd silhouettes along the bottom edge, spotlight beams, light haze, and reflections on a dark floor.
5. Color system: apply {컬러} across text accents, thin rules, glow edges, small icons, sponsor dividers, and ticket labels; keep the base mostly dark so neon cyan and muted gold accents read sharply.
6. Typography system: render {타이포} with a bold poster hierarchy, pairing heavy English display type with a clean Korean supporting font for readable event information. Use mixed-size typography to create a real gig-poster rhythm rather than a plain template.
7. Footer treatment: create a detailed bottom information strip with “RESERVATION”, “@midnight_groove”, “문의 02-777-0427”, “후원 LOCAL RECORDS · JAZZ NOTE”, “입장 19세 이상”, a small barcode/QR reservation box, and a tiny poster credit line “Design & photo credit: club archive”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use condensed bold display type similar to Bebas Neue or Anton for the main English title, paired with Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean subtext; title around 72–96px feel, body copy around 22–34px feel, micro info around 12–18px feel.
- Color palette: deep charcoal #0B0D12, black #050608, neon cyan #42E8F4, metallic gold #D7B15D, off-white #F5F1E8.
- Border/shadow: thin glowing edge lines, soft neon bloom around highlights, subtle drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity on text layers.
- Print realism: include slight paper fibers, ink spread, tiny scratches, dust specks, tape residue, and slight edge curl while keeping all key text readable.
- Layout density: make the flyer feel content-rich and authentic with event labels, section markers, ticket boxes, sponsor marks, and microcopy, while preserving a strong hierarchy around {장소}, {일정}, and {이번 주 라인업}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulated editorial concert poster look, 50mm documentary framing with shallow depth cues, as if shot on a Sony A7R IV with 50mm f/1.4.
- Lighting: strong stage spotlights from upper-left and upper-right, thin beams cutting through haze, slight rim light on edges, dark ambient fill with controlled contrast.
- Color grade: cool noir base with cyan neon and muted gold accents, lifted only on text, paper texture, and stage highlights, no washed-out background.
- Surface treatment: realistic pasted-poster finish on a dark venue wall, with soft specular highlights on ink, tiny imperfections, and a believable nightlife print-ad atmosphere.

[6. MOOD]
Indie live-music venue poster — a mix of Tokyo jazz club flyer energy, modern Berlin gig-poster design, and a real Seoul basement jazz bar announcement board.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보일 텍스트 — {장소}, {일정}, {이번 주 라인업}.
- Additional Korean text should be realistic and readable where used: “예매 ₩25,000”, “현장 ₩30,000”, “서울 중구 클럽로 12 B1”, “후원 LOCAL RECORDS · JAZZ NOTE”, “문의 02-777-0427”.
- Layout invariants: vertical flyer composition, dark club atmosphere, neon accent hierarchy, readable bilingual typography, real event-poster details, no distortion of Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean music playlist card for seasonal or mood-based listening, designed as a square social post that feels like a real curated playlist cover shared on a music platform. Collage-style playlist artwork with readable track list, platform identity, curator details, date label, and social-post micro elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: the playlist cover system fills the main square frame with layered title, collage artwork, track list, and footer information arranged like a professionally designed music editorial post.
- Background treatment: tactile matte paper, soft printed ink texture, faint gradient, subtle dust specks, sticker edges, and gentle album-sleeve shadows derived from {컬러}, giving the card a real photographed print/poster feeling while keeping the Korean text readable.
- Layout direction: vertical information stack from playlist title to mood/date label to collage artwork to 5-song list, with platform footer, curator handle, save/share micro icons, and small metadata labels near the lower area.
- Add realistic playlist details such as “VOL.08”, “2026.05”, “오늘의 5곡”, “총 18분”, “CURATED BY @daily_sound”, “저장해두기”, and a tiny QR/barcode-style block as decorative platform metadata.
- Use {무드}, {곡 5}, {플랫폼}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {비율} as customizable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title zone (top 18%): large playlist heading in Korean, “음악 플레이리스트”, with a secondary English or bilingual subtitle such as “SEASON MOOD MIX” beneath it using compact tracking, aligned to the central grid.
- Metadata strip (upper 8–10%): include “VOL.08”, “2026.05”, “오늘의 5곡”, and {무드} as small capsule labels, separated by dots, thin rules, or tape-sticker shapes.
- Mood zone (upper-middle 10%): {무드} placed as a short descriptive line, slightly smaller than the title but still prominent, paired with a short Korean caption like “지금 이 계절에 어울리는 소리” or “오늘 밤 반복 재생”.
- Main visual zone (middle 40–44%): {비주얼} as a rich collage of album-cover-like squares and rectangles, arranged with natural overlap, visible paper edges, grain, tape tabs, tiny handwritten notes, a small headphone icon, waveform strip, lyric-card fragment, and one circular disc/vinyl-inspired shape integrated into the composition.
- Track list zone (lower-middle 18–20%): {곡 5} rendered as five concise numbered entries, each with track title and artist in compact rows for easy reading; add tiny duration placeholders such as “03:12”, “04:05”, “02:58” aligned to the right like a real playlist UI.
- Platform zone (bottom 10–12%): {플랫폼} appears as a brand-style footer treatment with a wordmark/badge area, small channel handle “@daily_sound”, micro icons for save/share/play, and a tiny QR/barcode-style metadata block; real platform color cues may be used when appropriate.
- Aspect handling: keep all major typography and the five-song list fully visible within a square 1:1 composition, with the playlist artwork and footer balanced for {비율}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use {타이포} as the primary type direction; if unspecified, use Pretendard Bold for the main heading, Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR for supporting Korean text, and a clean sans-serif for track lines. Title size should dominate, subtitle 40–55% smaller, track list 30–40% smaller.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러}, with a strong contrast system such as black #111111, deep green #1DB954, off-white #F5F2EA, charcoal #2A2A2A, and one accent hue matching the selected mood.
- Graphic details: use thin dividers, capsule labels, small play-button marks, waveform bars, date stamps, sticker tabs, subtle halftone dots, and printed album-sleeve textures to make the playlist feel curated and lived-in.
- Depth and materials: collage tiles can have soft drop shadows with 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity; printed paper grain, ink spread, and small scuffs should be visible at close range without harming legibility.
- Text hierarchy: Korean title and {곡 5} must be the clearest elements; supporting labels such as “VOL.08”, “2026.05”, “CURATED BY @daily_sound”, and “저장해두기” should feel authentic but secondary.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: graphic design mockup look, front-facing flat layout, as if shot with a 50mm normal lens on a studio copy setup; collage pieces should feel like printed album sleeves with real paper thickness and slight edge lift.
- Lighting: even studio lighting with mild top-left falloff, soft edge contrast, gentle paper shadows, and controlled highlights on glossy album-cover fragments.
- Color grade: clean digital poster grade with mood-specific palette control; for rainy or late-night moods, lean into deep navy, muted green, gray-blue, and off-white; for morning or travel moods, use warm beige, soft blue, and muted coral accents.
- Rendering quality: crisp vector-like typography combined with realistic print texture, subtle dust, tiny misregistration, and tactile collage layering so the final image looks like a real designed playlist card rather than a blank template.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial playlist-card aesthetic — like a music streaming social graphic mixed with a Korean lifestyle magazine insert, record-shop recommendation card, and seasonal mood board. Warm, curated, contemporary, and shareable.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly if rendered in the design: 음악 플레이리스트, 오늘의 5곡, 저장해두기, {무드}, {곡 5}, {플랫폼}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {비율}
- Include realistic small Korean/metadata text such as “VOL.08”, “2026.05”, “총 18분”, “지금 이 계절에 어울리는 소리”, and “CURATED BY @daily_sound” where appropriate.
- All 5 listed songs in {곡 5} must be clearly readable, numbered 01–05, visually grouped as a set of five entries, and paired with small duration-style details.
- Keep the composition square and centered; do not shift the track list off-canvas or obscure the title.
- Ensure Korean characters are fully intact, with no broken glyphs, spacing errors, or garbled text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-707.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Indie and rookie artist album jacket, square cover art for streaming platforms and digital music release.
Create a realistic, emotionally layered LP/EP jacket aesthetic with tactile print details, artist identity, release information, and a believable Korean indie label design system.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square album cover with {비주얼} as the main visual occupying about 60–70% of the frame, composed like a finished streaming cover and physical record sleeve artwork.
- Use {장르·아티스트} as the conceptual anchor, with {컨셉} expressed through symbolic composition, light, surface marks, and small production details that feel connected to the artist.
- {비주얼} should remain the focal element while being surrounded by believable album-jacket information: artist name, album title zone, small catalog code, release date, label credit, and short track-list fragments.
- Background treatment: deep toned surface with visible tactile texture, such as grainy paper stock, matte vinyl ink, risograph speckles, folded sleeve scuffs, faint dust, soft gradient wash, or hand-scanned print marks depending on {컬러}.
- Typography area: integrate {타이포} as a clear title or artist mark, with supporting Korean microtext such as “첫 번째 EP”, “2026.05.01 발매”, “SIDE A”, and “서쪽방 레코즈”.
- Add realistic sleeve details: tiny spine-style text along one edge, a small barcode-like rectangle or catalog-number block, compact credit line, and 2–4 short track titles placed in a tasteful album-cover layout.
- Keep the overall framing balanced and editorial, with the density of a real indie release package rather than a plain concept mockup.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main visual block — Place {비주얼} in the central field, scaled to dominate the composition with deliberate cropping, tactile edges, and designed interaction with the surrounding album text.
2. Concept layer — Encode {컨셉} through abstract cues such as silhouette, texture, light falloff, environmental hints, handwritten markings, sticker residue, sleeve creases, or subtle object traces related to the mood.
3. Color treatment — Apply {컬러} as the dominant palette logic, using one strong accent color against a dark base, with vintage-modern contrast, controlled saturation, and realistic print behavior.
4. Typography block — Integrate {타이포} with a primary title/artist lockup and secondary lines: “첫 번째 EP”, “오늘의 파도”, “2026.05.01 발매”, “트랙 01 밤의 온도”, “트랙 02 느린 새벽”, “CAT. NO. IR-026”.
5. Album mood layer — Blend the full frame into a cohesive indie jacket structure, making the final piece feel like a curated record sleeve with real release metadata, not a generic poster or advertisement.
6. Surface finish — Add subtle paper grain, faint print noise, matte coating texture, slight misregistration, tiny ink spread, sleeve corner wear, and scan-like dust to reinforce {결} and avoid sterile digital smoothness.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean, paired with a clean grotesk or condensed sans for English; weight 500–700 for title, 300–400 for subtext, with tight but readable sizing.
- Color palette: follow {컬러} with dark charcoal, near-black, muted navy, deep brown, coral accent, cyan accent, or antique gold highlights; keep palette focused to 2–4 primary tones while allowing print texture variation.
- Cover information system: include a small artist/title credit, release date label, catalog number, tiny label imprint, compact track-list snippet, and spine/edge text such as “{장르·아티스트} / 첫 번째 EP / IR-026”.
- Graphic accents: allow one or two tactile graphic elements such as a translucent price sticker, small punched registration dot, torn paper strip, handwritten Korean note, or barcode-area rectangle if they support {컨셉}.
- Border/shadow: use a soft vignette or thin perimeter shadow, 10–15% opacity, with subtle print-edge softness, corner rubbing, and matte sleeve depth rather than hard framing.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life look shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth feel, centered composition, album-cover clarity.
- Lighting: controlled studio softbox at 45° from upper-left with a very light fill from right; keep shadows smooth and readable, with natural paper sheen, soft sleeve texture, and no harsh glare.
- Color grade: muted charcoal base with one accent hue, slightly desaturated, analog print-like contrast, and a faint film grain finish.
- Rendering quality: make the cover feel physically printed and photographed or scanned, with believable ink density, micro-scratches, dust flecks, and crisp but human-designed Korean typography.

[6. MOOD]
Indie record label cover — Quiet luxury meets underground zine and modern Korean music editorial, like a refined Kinfolk x Aesop x contemporary album sleeve hybrid with the tangible feeling of a newly released Korean rookie artist EP.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "한글 정확"
- Render Korean cover text accurately where used: "첫 번째 EP", "오늘의 파도", "2026.05.01 발매", "트랙 01 밤의 온도", "트랙 02 느린 새벽", "서쪽방 레코즈".
- Layout invariants: maintain a square album-jacket composition, keep {비주얼} cleanly centered or deliberately offset with clear intent, and ensure {타이포} plus all release metadata remain legible without overlapping key visual details.

studio:prompts3:ours-706.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Large-scale festival lineup poster for social media and print, designed like a high-energy event key visual with strong hierarchy.
Korean/English mixed concert poster aesthetic with a dramatic lineup reveal, complete date/time/venue/ticket information, sponsor strip, and realistic festival-poster production details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster layout with a top-heavy festival title block, a dominant tiered lineup hero zone in the center, and practical event information anchored near the lower third.
- Background treatment: dark stage-night base with neon gradient haze, subtle grain, laser beams, confetti specks, LED-panel texture, crowd silhouettes, stage truss outlines, and atmospheric smoke for a real outdoor festival mood.
- {페스티벌명} and {일정} should sit prominently in the header area; {라인업} must be arranged as a tiered hierarchy with visible size differences; {시간} and {장소} placed as clear supporting event lines.
- {비주얼} should integrate stage, crowd, wristband, ticket-stub, soundwave, and neon graphic elements around the typography so the poster feels like an actual major festival announcement.
- {티켓정보}, {스폰서정보}, {문의채널}, and {주최정보} should appear in realistic small-print areas near the bottom, using dividers, icons, QR-like blocks, and compact label text.
- {컬러} and {타이포} should define the overall look, with energetic contrast between massive artist names, Korean event details, and micro information.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): Place {페스티벌명} in the strongest typographic block, with “SUMMER SONIC KOREA 2026” large and iconic; place {일정} directly below or to the side as an official date stamp, with a small “VOL.01 / SEOUL EDITION” style label.
2. Event badge zone: Add small rounded labels such as “3 DAYS”, “LIVE STAGE”, “SEOUL OPEN AIR”, and “ALL NIGHT AFTER PARTY” near the header, plus tiny Korean guide text like “공식 라인업 공개”.
3. Hero lineup zone (mid 45%): Build {라인업} as a layered text composition where headliners are largest, main acts medium, and sub acts smallest; use separators, slashes, dot bullets, and distinct weights to clearly separate tiers.
4. Visual support zone: Add {비주얼} behind and around the lineup as a compact stage-and-crowd illustration treatment with beams, LED screens, hands in the air, confetti, and abstract soundwave shapes, while keeping the lineup as the main readable focus.
5. Venue and schedule zone (lower third): Set {장소} and {시간} as clean information lines with map-pin and clock icons; add entrance/opening details, age notice, and a short Korean 안내 line.
6. Ticket and sponsor zone: Place {티켓정보} in a highlighted ticket strip or sticker-style box; place {스폰서정보} and {주최정보} in a sponsor/footer band with small logo placeholders, barcode/QR-like graphic, and production credit line.
7. Contact/footer zone: Add {문의채널} with website, handle, and customer-service style microcopy; include a spine-like vertical credit on one side reading “SUMMER SONIC KOREA 2026 / LINEUP POSTER / SEOUL”.
8. Style synthesis: Apply {컬러} across gradients, glows, accent lines, sticker labels, ticket blocks, and sponsor dividers; apply {타이포} to the header and lineup so the overall poster feels like a premium metropolitan festival announcement.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use a bold condensed sans for English headline text (e.g., Bebas Neue / Oswald style), paired with Korean sans such as Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; headline weight 800-900, subtext 500-700, date/venue 400-600, legal microcopy 300-500.
- Color palette: dark charcoal #0B0D14, electric cyan #00E5FF, hot magenta #FF3EA5, neon violet #7A3CFF, acid lime #C8FF2E, with subtle white highlights and warm amber spark accents.
- Border/shadow: add soft outer glow around neon text, 2-4px stroke where needed, subtle shadow at 20% opacity to separate text from the background, and a faint vignette to keep focus centered.
- Poster realism: include practical festival-poster elements such as sponsor footer, ticket price box, admission notice, venue map-pin icon, QR/barcode-like block, stage number labels, and small production credits.
- Decorative graphics: use diagonal beams, halftone dots, torn ticket-edge shapes, waveform lines, tiny stars, confetti, wristband patterns, and transparent gradient stickers to enrich the layout.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial concert-poster look inspired by a 24mm wide-angle stage shot and a 50mm portrait crop for textual emphasis, with crisp graphic composition rather than literal photography.
- Lighting: strong stage backlights, diagonal neon beams, LED wall glow, rim-lit crowd silhouettes, and diffused haze as if shot under concert lighting rigs; simulate bright rim highlights against the dark background.
- Color grade: deep midnight blue + neon cyan + magenta + violet gradient, with high contrast and slightly crushed blacks for a festival-night feel.
- Print texture: add subtle paper grain, ink density variation, micro halftone texture, and slight chromatic glow around neon areas so it feels like a finished poster asset.

[6. MOOD]
Big-ticket summer music festival announcement poster — a concert key visual with the punchy energy of a Coachella/Ultra-style lineup reveal and Korean festival flyer clarity.
Energetic, crowded, premium, loud, and celebratory, with enough realistic event information to feel ready for street posting, Instagram feed upload, and ticket-launch promotion.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “SUMMER SONIC KOREA 2026”, “2026.08.15~17”, “올림픽공원 잔디마당”.
- 포스터에 다음 정보가 자연스럽게 보여야 함: “2026.08.15~17”, “OPEN 12:00 / START 13:30”, “올림픽공원 잔디마당”, “1일권 ₩129,000 / 3일권 ₩299,000”, “예매처: 공식 홈페이지·멜론티켓”, “문의 @summersonic_kr”.
- 라인업 위계는 반드시 3단계로 보여야 함: 헤드라이너 3팀 > 메인 5팀 > 서브 10팀. 헤드라이너 예시: “THE AURORA”, “NIGHT WAVE”, “서울전자음악단”.
- 하단에는 스폰서/주최 영역이 있어야 함: “주최: SSK Festival Committee”, “후원: Seoul Culture Wave · Radio 247 · Neon Stage Lab”, “NO. SSK-2026-0815”.
- 모든 한글과 영문은 깨지지 않고 읽혀야 하며, 날짜·장소·티켓 가격·문의 채널이 누락되지 않아야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or scrambled Latin letters
- Distorted real people or celebrity likeness composites
- Missing lineup tiers, date, venue, or ticket information

studio:prompts3:ours-705.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Indie rock / jazz concert poster for print and social promotion, with a gritty live-show editorial feel.
Vertical event poster that combines artist silhouette, real venue atmosphere, clear lineup typography, ticket information, sponsor strip, and authentic small-print event details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {콘서트명·아티스트} headline occupies the top 18% of the frame, with the hero silhouette and stage scene filling the middle 55%, and {일자·장소} plus lineup, ticket, and sponsor text anchored in the lower 22%.
- Background treatment: deep charcoal to near-black textured backdrop with visible paper grain, smoke haze, stage dust, scratched ink, faint taped-poster marks, and concert-light bloom; include realistic wall-poster texture and printed ink depth.
- Framing direction: tall poster layout with strong vertical flow, slightly asymmetrical spacing, layered text blocks, subtle diagonal light beams, small decorative arrows/rules, and a real indie gig flyer density.
- Use {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {결} to guide the exact visual language, while keeping the composition dense, readable, and print-ready.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: place {콘서트명·아티스트} in a dominant poster masthead, spanning nearly full width with tight tracking and strong contrast against the dark background. Add small issue-like event label text such as "LIVE SESSION VOL.27" and "SEOUL NIGHT SERIES" near the header.
- Secondary info strip: set {일자·장소} directly below the header in smaller but crisp type, aligned left or center depending on the overall poster balance. Include readable Korean event details: "2026.05.24 SAT 19:30", "한남 어반플레이 B1 LIVE HALL", "입장 19:00 / 공연 19:30".
- Hero visual core: render {비주얼} as a layered concert scene with one or more artist silhouettes, stage beams, microphone stands, guitar neck silhouette, drum kit hints, amp cabinets, cable lines, monitor speakers, and light haze, all integrated into the center mass.
- Color energy layer: apply {컬러} as neon accent light streaks, edge glows, printed overprint marks, spotlight flares, and selective text highlights rather than full-screen saturation.
- Typography stack: build {타이포} with a bold English title weight, a smaller Korean subtitle line, and a compact lineup list arranged in disciplined blocks. Include short Korean copy blocks such as "라인업", "인디 / 록 / 재즈", "스페셜 게스트", "오프닝 DJ SET".
- Event information block: add ticket and venue information in the lower section: "예매 ₩55,000 / 현장 ₩66,000", "문의 02-3144-0524", "티켓: ticketlink.kr", "All ages welcome". Keep text small but legible like a real printed concert poster.
- Sponsor / partner area: create a small bottom sponsor strip with realistic text-only partner names and micro labels such as "Presented by URBANPLAY", "Supported by Seoul Indie Archive", "Media Partner: Night FM", plus tiny square logo-like typographic marks without fake official seals.
- Decorative print details: include thin divider rules, tiny registration crosses, a small barcode-style ticket block, subtle corner crop marks, and faint fold/wear marks to make the poster feel physically printed and posted.
- Texture and finish: add {결} through paper grain, distressed ink edges, faint halftone, offset-print noise, rubbed corners, and subtle vintage-print wear so the poster feels like an indie venue wall print.
- Format anchor: keep {비율} as a tall 1024x1536 poster with strong top-to-bottom rhythm, layered event information, and crisp edge-to-edge poster design.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use condensed bold sans for the main English headline (similar to Helvetica Neue Condensed / DIN Condensed), paired with Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean details; headline around 72–110 px equivalent, supporting text 24–36 px, lineup 18–24 px, micro event text 10–16 px.
- Color palette: charcoal #111111, near-black #0A0A0D, neon cyan #00E5FF, neon pink #FF4FD8, muted silver #B7BCC7, off-white #F2F2EE.
- Border/shadow: use subtle poster-edge vignette, soft drop shadow behind layered text only, light distressing around silhouette edges, thin cyan/pink divider lines, and realistic ink misregistration; keep shadows sharp enough to read like concert print design.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: stage-photography look with a 35mm documentary perspective for the environment and an 85mm f/1.4 portrait feel for the silhouette separation, as if shot on a Canon EOS R5 + RF 35mm f/1.8 and RF 85mm f/1.4.
- Lighting: strong backlit concert beams from upper rear, cyan and magenta spotlights crossing at 30–45°, low ambient fill, slight smoke diffusion, practical stage LEDs, and crisp rim light around the silhouettes.
- Color grade: deep noir base with neon cyan / pink highlights, lifted midtone grain, slightly desaturated shadows, subtle halation around lights, and an indie-venue editorial finish.

[6. MOOD]
A gritty live-music poster with a Vibey club-flyer energy, like a Moon Safari / Nulbarich gig graphic mixed with a vintage underground jazz club print, realistic enough to appear on a venue wall or social announcement feed.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열 — "한남 어반플레이", "라인업", "인디", "록", "재즈".
- Include realistic Korean poster text where appropriate: "2026.05.24 SAT 19:30", "입장 19:00 / 공연 19:30", "예매 ₩55,000 / 현장 ₩66,000", "스페셜 게스트", "티켓 예매".
- Layout invariant: maintain a clear poster hierarchy with headline, date/venue, hero silhouette, lineup text, ticket info, and sponsor strip all visible in one tall composition.
- Typography invariant: Korean characters must be clean, fully legible, and not stylized into broken or distorted glyphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-704.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
회의록 표지와 요약 카드용 세로형 문서 디자인. {회의명}의 핵심 정보를 한 장에 압축해 내부 공유, 아카이브, 프린트 배포에 바로 쓰는 현실적인 편집형 브리핑 카드로 제작한다. 실제 사내 회의록 첫 페이지처럼 문서 번호, 작성일, 페이지 표시, 섹션 라벨, 액션 상태 배지, 작은 QR/바코드형 관리 영역까지 포함해 정보가 풍부하게 보이게 한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Create a vertical 1024x1536 document card matching {비율}. The top 20% is a strong header area where {회의명} is read first, with a small document label MEETING NOTE, 내부 공유용, DOC-2026-05-01, 작성일 2026.05.01, PAGE 01 / 03, and a thin accent rule.
- The middle 55% is a dense but legible meeting summary body. Include {참석자} as participant chips or a compact attendee row, then arrange {주요 의제} into realistic editorial modules such as 요약, 핵심 논의, 결정 사항, 리스크 메모, 다음 확인 포인트.
- The bottom 25% is an action item card for {액션 아이템}. Use a table-like card with columns 담당, 마감, 상태, 우선순위, and small status pills such as 진행중, 확인 필요, 완료 예정.
- Use left and right document safe area around 7%, with aligned grid columns, visible section numbering 01, 02, 03, small divider lines, index ticks, and a subtle footer containing 전략기획팀 · 회의 아카이브 · CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL.
- Background is realistic white paper with fine fiber texture, slight ink density variation, subtle page edge shadow, and {컬러} used as the primary accent plus soft tint blocks. Keep the overall structure: top header + middle summary + bottom action card.
- {비주얼} should guide the framing details, icon style, and accent graphics while preserving the hierarchy of meeting title, summary, and action list.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 20%): Place {회의명} in the largest Korean typography. Add a small upper-left label MEETING NOTE / 회의록 요약, upper-right metadata 작성일 2026.05.01, 문서번호 DOC-247, and a compact page marker 01. Under the title, set {참석자} as a one-line attendee credit with label 참석자 and small dot separators. Add a slim colored vertical bar or tab using {컬러}.
2) Summary block (middle 55%): Present {주요 의제} as scan-friendly editorial content. Include 2-column or stacked modules: 요약, 주요 의제, 결정 사항, 참고 메모. Add realistic short Korean filler lines that look like internal notes, for example 일정 조율 필요, 예산안 2차 검토, 고객 피드백 반영, 다음 회의 전 자료 취합. Use numbered bullets, check icons, and small highlighted callout strips.
3) Action card (bottom 25%): Render {액션 아이템} inside a stronger card panel. Show a practical task list with row dividers, owner initials, due date chips such as D-3, 05.08, 05.15, and status labels 진행중, 대기, 검토 완료. Add right-aligned auxiliary labels 담당, 마감, 상태 so it feels like a real operational meeting summary.
4) Document furniture: Add a footer line with 내부 공유용, 전략기획팀, 회의 아카이브, PAGE 01 / 03. Include a small barcode or QR-like management block, a tiny file path line /archive/meeting/2026/05, and a revision label REV.02. These details must remain decorative document metadata, not official certification marks.
5) Visual framing: Follow {비주얼} for the editorial mood. The final image should look like a polished printed meeting minutes cover placed flat for presentation, with realistic paper surface, crisp ink, subtle tabs, section dividers, and a professional archive-card finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR. {회의명} Bold 40~48px, header metadata 12~15px, {참석자} and {주요 의제} Medium 22~28px, module labels SemiBold 16~20px, {액션 아이템} SemiBold 20~24px, footer microcopy 9~12px.
- Color palette: Base on {컬러}; use white #FFFFFF, charcoal #23262B, warm light gray #F3F5F7, divider gray #D9DDE3, and {컬러} as primary accent with 10~18% tint panels.
- Lines / cards: Use thin 1px dividers, rounded 10~16px information cards, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px 10% opacity, small status pills, index tabs, and subtle highlight bands.
- Korean layout quality: Align Hangul cleanly on a grid, keep line breaks natural, balance short headings with compact body text, and make all key Korean text readable at print size.
- Realistic print details: Add slight paper grain, gentle ink texture, clean crop edges, tiny registration-like ticks, and believable document metadata without turning it into a certificate.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat editorial document layout, top-down graphic composition, no perspective distortion, print-ready presentation board style.
- Lighting: even studio-like diffuse illumination with gentle paper-edge shadow, realistic matte paper highlights, and no harsh glare over the Korean text.
- Color grade: clean white + charcoal + {컬러} accent, neutral corporate document tone, soft gray paper depth, crisp black ink contrast.
- Rendering quality: high-resolution print mockup realism, sharp vector-like typography, precise Korean glyphs, consistent baseline grid, believable office-document texture.

[6. MOOD]
Corporate editorial briefing card — a polished internal strategy memo page with practical meeting-room realism, structured archive metadata, calm authority, and a content-rich operations dashboard feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보이게 할 것:
  - {회의명}
  - {참석자}
  - {주요 의제}
  - {액션 아이템}
- Also render these Korean document labels clearly where appropriate: 회의록 요약, 내부 공유용, 참석자, 주요 의제, 결정 사항, 액션 아이템, 담당, 마감, 상태, 다음 단계, 작성일 2026.05.01, PAGE 01 / 03.
- Maintain the document structure: large top header + middle summary body + bottom action card.
- All Hangul must be sharp, unbroken, and readable; avoid garbled syllables or pseudo-Korean.
- Keep {컬러}, {비주얼}, and {비율} reflected in the final layout without changing the core meeting-minutes subject.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
KPI dashboard mockup for a marketing performance presentation, designed as a polished UI/UX hero image for business reporting, executive slide cover use, and SaaS product showcase.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main dashboard panel occupies about 90% of the canvas, centered in a 1536x1024 landscape frame with a thin top app bar, visible side navigation rail, and realistic product chrome.
- Use {대시보드제목} as the main title, {부제} as the supporting subtitle, {KPI카드} as the row of KPI summary cards, {차트구성} as the analytic modules, {필터탭} as the control strip, {색상테마} as the visual theme, and {비주얼스타일} as the overall presentation style.
- Background should be a deep matte charcoal workspace with subtle noise texture, soft monitor glow, fine panel reflections, and crisp UI separation.
- Layout should feel like a premium SaaS product screenshot: strong grid, readable density, precise alignment, natural executive-report content, and no perspective tilt.
- Include realistic business UI details such as an account avatar, notification chip, export button, updated timestamp, small status badges, source note, and a compact insight callout so the dashboard feels like an actively used analytics product.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top app bar (top 7%): show product-style navigation labels such as "개요", "캠페인", "성과", "리포트", a search field, notification dot, user avatar for {사용자}, and a small workspace label for {팀명}.
- Header area (next 12%): place {대시보드제목}, {부제}, breadcrumb labels, the timestamp {업데이트시간}, and right-side buttons reading "공유", "PDF 내보내기", "보고서 예약"; use precise spacing and thin divider lines.
- Filter strip (below header): render {필터탭} as pill tabs with active-state emphasis, tiny icon markers, dropdown arrows, and readable values such as {기간라벨}; include a small comparison selector reading "전월 대비".
- KPI summary row (upper analytic band): show 5 metric cards for {KPI카드}, each card with a bold numeric value, small trend arrow, sparkline, target progress bar, and micro-label; keep equal card widths and consistent padding.
- Main chart zone (middle 46%): arrange {차트구성} as a 2-column analytic board, with one large primary line-and-bar chart on the left and three smaller supporting charts on the right; include clear axes, legend chips, hover-style tooltip card, annotations, and subtle grid lines.
- Lower intelligence zone (bottom 18%): add a compact campaign table with channel rows, budget, conversions, ROAS, owner, status chips, plus a right-side insight card titled {인사이트제목} with 3 short bullet findings and a priority tag.
- Data accent layer: integrate {색상테마} through chart lines, bars, donut segments, gauge indicators, status chips, and CTA accents, while preserving a charcoal base and high contrast readability.
- Visual framing: make {비주얼스타일} look like a high-fidelity product mockup, with sharp corners, 1px borders, inset panel shadow, soft glass highlights, and a workspace-like dashboard environment.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard and Inter, with bold 700 for title text, 600 for KPI values, and 400–500 for labels; keep Korean text crisp, geometric, and highly legible.
- Color palette: charcoal #1B1E23, slate #2A2F36, cyan #3DD6FF, lime #A6E22E, coral #FF6B6B, amber #FFB020, soft white #F3F5F7.
- Border/shadow: 1px cool-gray borders, soft drop shadow 0px 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.28), subtle inner glow on active cards, faint separators between modules.
- UI realism: include consistent icon sizes, tab hover states, checkbox-style row selectors, chart legends, page indicator text, and realistic values that match the marketing KPI theme.
- Text hierarchy: title and KPI numbers should be readable at thumbnail scale, while table rows and annotations remain plausible and neatly typeset.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing screen-capture aesthetic, equivalent to a 50mm f/8 clean product documentation shot, perfectly orthographic and distortion-free.
- Lighting: controlled studio monitor glow with soft ambient edge light from upper-left, faint reflective highlight on panel edges, no harsh reflections.
- Color grade: dark UI neutral base with cyan/lime/coral/amber data accents, slightly cool-toned contrast, crisp whites, and restrained saturation.

[6. MOOD]
Premium SaaS analytics dashboard — executive-ready, data-rich, modern Korean B2B reporting interface with Notion x Stripe x linear.app product presentation feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render exactly these Korean strings where applicable: "마케팅 KPI", "매출·운영·고객 만족", "CTR", "CVR", "ROAS", "CAC", "LTV", "기간", "채널", "디바이스".
- Add realistic Korean UI labels: "2026년 5월 1일 업데이트", "실시간 캠페인 요약", "필터: 기간 · 채널 · 디바이스", "전월 대비", "공유", "PDF 내보내기", "보고서 예약", "데이터 출처: GA4 · CRM · 광고 관리자", "목표 달성률", "예산 소진", "전환 수", "캠페인 상태".
- KPI values must be legible and plausible: "CTR 4.8%", "CVR 3.2%", "ROAS 486%", "CAC ₩18,400", "LTV ₩142,000" with trend arrows and short Korean micro-labels.
- Campaign table should include readable rows such as "검색 광고", "리타겟팅", "브랜드 캠페인", "카카오 채널", with status chips "정상", "주의", "상승".
- All charts, cards, tabs, tooltips, and table rows must remain neatly aligned to a strict grid with consistent spacing and readable labels.
- No distorted Korean glyphs, no placeholder gibberish, no broken UI text, and no illegible axis labels.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Garbled chart labels, missing UI text, or illegible dashboard numbers
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized portrait likenesses

[1. PURPOSE]
Consulting presentation slide deck template in 16:9 landscape, designed for executive briefing, strategy review, and investor-style business storytelling.
Create a realistic, content-rich corporate slide as if exported from PowerPoint or Keynote for a senior leadership meeting, with believable business labels, chart annotations, source notes, page metadata, and polished enterprise presentation details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: a structured consulting slide with a top header band, central content grid, and slim footer strip, using strict alignment, visible grid discipline, and realistic slide production details.
- Main slide body: use {슬라이드 종류} as the primary slide type, with {내용} positioned to read like a high-level consulting framework supported by concise Korean business copy, KPI figures, and a small analytical exhibit.
- Visual balance: {비주얼} arranged with a clear left-to-right reading order, 12-column grid feel, practical content density, and authentic executive deck spacing.
- Background treatment: crisp white or very light warm gray paper-like surface with subtle printed-paper grain, faint section bands, and carefully placed divider rules.
- Typography hierarchy: {타이포} placed with strong executive clarity, ensuring the headline dominates while secondary notes, captions, and chart labels remain readable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 12–15%): place the slide title area with a firm corporate masthead feel, thin divider line beneath, small section label aligned to the left, and metadata on the right such as “2026년 5월”, “VOL.03”, “Client Confidential”, or “전략 워크숍”.
2. Main content zone (middle 68–72%): build a consulting-style grid where {내용} is organized into a headline block, three insight blocks, and one chart or geometric diagram block; include realistic Korean labels, short bullets, KPI numbers, arrows, callout tags, chart legends, and source captions.
3. Slide type control: show {슬라이드 종류} as the structural logic of the page, so the layout can adapt between agenda, market analysis, strategy, execution, and conclusion without changing the overall design system.
4. Visual structure: {비주얼} should read as a disciplined boardroom deck, with each content card evenly spaced, sharp edges, consistent baseline alignment, numbered insight chips, and a small exhibit title such as “Exhibit 1. 성장 기회 매트릭스”.
5. Footer zone (bottom 6–8%): include a professional footer with page number, source note, confidentiality label, section marker, author initials, and a faint separator rule; example microcopy: “출처: 내부 분석 및 공개자료”, “p.07”, “Strategy Review”.
6. Color application: use {컬러} for the main palette, with one restrained accent color repeated for emphasis markers, chart highlights, KPI deltas, and key figures.
7. Texture and polish: {결 추가} should appear through slightly muted contrast, refined spacing, realistic slide export sharpness, subtle paper grain, and polished enterprise slide finishing rather than flashy visual effects.
8. Aspect handling: {비율} must be preserved exactly as a landscape presentation canvas with no crop on margins or footer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold or SemiBold for headers, Pretendard Regular for body, and Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for small editorial-style supporting text; headline around 42–54 px, body around 20–24 px, captions around 12–14 px.
- Color palette: use white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F2937, cool gray #E5E7EB, and a single restrained accent from the consulting-firm range such as muted blue #2F6FED or muted teal #2AA198 from {컬러}.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px divider lines, 8–12 px corner radius if cards are present, very soft shadow 0px 6px 18px at 10–14% opacity, and matte editorial surfaces.
- Spacing: consistent 8px spacing system, clear gutters between blocks, strong alignment to a clean grid, and enough information density to look like a real executive briefing slide.
- Business content details: include slide furniture such as small section tabs, numbered bullets, chart axis labels, legend keys, delta indicators like “+12%p”, table row labels, quarter markers “1Q–4Q”, and short Korean feature phrases.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat presentation layout captured as a premium editorial product mockup, Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/4 equivalent perspective, nearly orthographic top-down view with crisp slide edges and realistic screen/export sharpness.
- Lighting: studio-clean, even illumination with soft ambient falloff, subtle paper realism, and gentle contact shading that makes the slide feel physically printed or professionally exported.
- Color grade: neutral corporate grade with white, charcoal, and a single muted accent, slightly cooled to convey consulting-presentation precision.

[6. MOOD]
McKinsey / BCG-style boardroom strategy slide — polished, editorial, executive-ready, analytical, and believable as a real senior management briefing page with restrained premium consulting aesthetics.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: "컨설팅 슬라이드", "목차 / 시장 분석 / 전략 / 실행 / 결론 — 5종 중 1", "핵심 헤드라인 + 3가지 인사이트 + 차트 또는 도형", "상단 헤더 + 본문 그리드 + 하단 푸터", "화이트 + 차콜 + 단일 액센트 — 컨설팅 펌 결", "Pretendard 굵은 헤더 + 본문 명조 + 작은 캡션", "BCG·McKinsey 톤다운", "1536x1024".
- Additional realistic Korean slide text to render clearly: "2026년 5월", "전략 리뷰", "프로젝트명: 성장 전략", "핵심 인사이트", "우선순위", "시장 기회", "실행 로드맵", "출처: 내부 분석 및 공개자료", "페이지 07".
- Slide layout invariants: preserve the top header, middle grid, and bottom footer structure; maintain a strict consulting deck hierarchy with clean alignment and no playful composition.
- Text rendering: all Korean characters must be crisp, complete, and correctly spaced.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals or certifications

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean monthly report editorial layout, consulting-style data dashboard poster for business performance review.
Vertical printed report design optimized for presentation, internal sharing, and executive summary reading, with realistic report-page details such as issue metadata, chart annotations, footer notes, and page indicators.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: structured 3-zone vertical composition with top header occupying 14%, middle chart block 58%, and bottom insight panel 28%.
- Page structure: precise consulting-report grid with clear hierarchy, visible page metadata, small executive-report labels, and a realistic premium report sheet placed on a cool gray office surface.
- Header area: centered title block with {기간} as the main headline, followed by {주요 KPI} in a smaller subheadline line; add compact metadata such as "VOL.04", "2026.04", "데이터전략팀", "내부 공유용", and a small document code "MR-2026-04".
- Middle zone: {차트} placed as the main analytical centerpiece, with clear separation between chart modules, readable axes, Korean month/week labels, legends, annotations, and mini KPI cards.
- Bottom zone: {인사이트} placed inside a restrained executive summary card, accompanied by short supporting bullets, a tiny action-note row, and a page indicator.
- Background treatment: matte white report paper with realistic fine paper grain, faint page curl, subtle desk shadow, small binder-clip impression near the top edge, and cool gray UI surfaces; keep the chart area prominent and highly legible.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: place {기간} centered in a bold report-title style, with compact spacing and a thin divider line beneath; {주요 KPI} appears immediately below as a single readable KPI strip. Add small header labels: "월간 리포트", "VOL.04", "2026년 4월호", "작성: 데이터전략팀", "공유 범위: 임원/팀장".
2. Main analytics block: render {차트} in the center with a dashboard-like arrangement, using one primary weekly line chart and one category donut chart area with crisp Korean labels, thin gridlines, restrained annotations, and realistic data markers. Include short chart labels such as "1주차", "2주차", "3주차", "4주차", "매출", "가입", "검색", "신상", "재구매".
3. Supporting metric framing: place small data labels, mini cards, delta arrows, and summary callouts around the chart block without blocking the graphs. Add realistic business-report microcopy such as "전월 대비", "목표 달성률", "주요 변동", "관찰 메모", and "단위: 백만원".
4. Bottom insight card: place {인사이트} inside a refined rectangular panel with subtle emphasis, designed to read like a consultant’s highlight note rather than a marketing slogan. Include 2–3 concise Korean bullets: "검색 유입 정상화", "신상품 전환율 개선", "5월 캠페인 예산 재배분 권장".
5. Footer balance: include a professional report footer with "Confidential Internal Report", "p.01 / 06", "업데이트 2026.05.01", and a tiny source line "Source: CRM · GA4 · Sales Dashboard" while keeping the exact top-header / middle-chart / bottom-insight structure intact.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, headline in Bold 700–800, KPI line in Medium 500–600, body labels in Regular 400; title size large, chart labels small but legible, metadata text very small but readable.
- Color palette: use {컬러} as the guiding palette while preserving white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F2933, soft gray #E5E7EB, deep gray #374151, lime accent #A3E635 or #B7F000 for key highlights.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px gray rules, subtle card borders, very soft shadow 0px 8px 24px rgba(31,41,51,0.08) for report cards, plus a natural paper shadow on the desk surface.
- Layout accents: use disciplined spacing, crisp alignment, editorial separators, tiny index tabs, small table rows, chart legends, and realistic analyst annotations; avoid gimmicky presentation effects.
- Visual ratio: reflect {비율} in the chart emphasis and composition density, keeping the vertical 1024x1536 report-page format.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down graphic poster style, equivalent to a clean flat-lay composition with 50mm perspective and orthographic-like precision; the full report page is visible with slight realistic paper depth.
- Lighting: even studio lighting with softbox diffusion, gentle contact shadows along the page edges, no harsh glare, and crisp chart edges.
- Color grade: cool neutral consulting palette, white + charcoal + lime, with very light gray UI surfaces, realistic printed ink behavior, and high readability.
- Material detail: use {비주얼} as the visual direction; show matte paper texture, subtle toner-like ink edges, fine gray gridlines, small punched guide marks or binding hint, and a professional office-report finish.

[6. MOOD]
McKinsey-style business report slide meets modern editorial infographic — crisp, analytical, boardroom-ready, and believable as a real monthly KPI report printed for an executive review meeting.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문자열: "월간 리포트", "2026년 4월 월간 리포트", "매출 1.2억 (+18%) / 가입 4500 / NPS 64", "주별 라인 + 카테고리별 도넛", "\"오가닉 트래픽 회복 + 신상 효과\"".
- Additional Korean microtext should be accurate and legible: "VOL.04", "2026년 4월호", "데이터전략팀", "내부 공유용", "전월 대비", "목표 달성률", "5월 액션 아이템", "p.01 / 06".
- Typography and layout must remain aligned and highly legible; all chart text, legends, table labels, and annotations must be correctly rendered in Korean.
- Preserve the exact report-like composition: top header, middle chart block, bottom insight card.
- Keep all placeholders exactly as written: {기간}, {주요 KPI}, {차트}, {인사이트}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {비율}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Any layout that removes the clear top-header / middle-chart / bottom-insight structure

[1. PURPOSE]
Business plan cover page for startup and government support applications, designed as a formal vertical document cover with a premium corporate presentation feel.
Suitable for investor decks, grant submissions, government grant applications, startup incubation programs, and internal proposal packets.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Portrait cover layout: top header zone about 12%, central hero zone about 58%, bottom metadata zone about 20%, with a document-safe binding area on the left and balanced executive cover proportions.
- Main title should be the strongest visual anchor, aligned center-left or centered depending on the logo balance, with {프로젝트} as the primary headline.
- Add a small cover label reading “사업계획서” and a submission label reading “창업·지원사업 제출용” in the upper header area, so the page feels like a real proposal cover.
- Secondary corporate line with {회사} sits beneath the title in smaller type, and {일자} is placed in a disciplined footer-style line.
- Include realistic document metadata: {지원사업}, {문서번호}, {기밀표기}, {문의처}, and {웹사이트} in the lower information zone with thin dividers and corporate alignment.
- Background should be deep navy with subtle geometric abstraction, diagonal grid lines, faint data-map patterns, and refined brochure-paper grain.
- Place {비주얼} as a structured corporate graphic system with abstract growth charts, node lines, and premium gold accent bars integrated into the layout.
- Add a narrow left-side binding stripe or spine-like credit band containing {기관표기} and the document version, reinforcing the proposal packet feeling.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background field: a full-bleed deep navy base with faint abstract gradients, subtle linear geometry, thin gold map-grid traces, and matte premium paper texture.
2. Header label area: top-left or top-center contains “사업계획서”, “창업·지원사업 제출용”, and a small corporate mark or logo treatment; typography should feel official but not like a government seal.
3. Brand anchor area: a small company mark or logo treatment near the upper region, integrated discreetly so it supports the layout without overpowering the title.
4. Main title area (mid-upper): {프로젝트} rendered as the largest element, bold and highly legible, occupying the visual center with strong hierarchy.
5. Subtitle and purpose line: {부제} placed near the main title in smaller sans-serif type, with a refined gold separator line.
6. Supporting identity line: {회사} set below the title in smaller corporate typography, aligned for quick reading and balanced spacing.
7. Bottom metadata block: include “지원사업: {지원사업}”, “문서번호: {문서번호}”, “제출일: {일자}”, “보안등급: {기밀표기}”, “문의: {문의처}”, and “웹사이트: {웹사이트}” in a neat two-column or stacked document-info table.
8. Visual accent layer: {비주얼} arranged as abstract business graphics, including subtle growth-line motifs, node networks, transparent rectangles, and gold rule lines.
9. Color emphasis: {컬러} applied with gold accents for hierarchy and prestige, while white is reserved for the main readable text, metadata, and key separators.
10. Final framing: maintain a polished executive-cover silhouette with crisp typography, premium document logic, and a high-end proposal aesthetic.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use {타이포}; Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the main Korean title in bold weight, with a strong size hierarchy; use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for secondary lines in medium/light weight.
- Color palette: deep navy #0B1B3A, gold #C8A45D, white #F7F7F4, with subtle charcoal accents for structure.
- Border/shadow: soft shadow only if needed, such as 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity; use thin gold lines, small divider rules, and paper-like surface contrast.
- Title styling: strong condensed or semi-bold serif feel, precise kerning, high contrast, and executive Korean editorial rhythm.
- Metadata styling: the lower information block should look like a real proposal cover table, with readable labels, aligned values, and small separators.
- Graphic system: use abstract business-oriented motifs such as upward trend lines, data nodes, planning-grid overlays, translucent panels, and refined geometric accents.
- Layout discipline: align all elements to a clean grid with strict spacing, binding-safe placement, and premium presentation logic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio-designed graphic poster look, equivalent to a clean 50mm editorial frame, front-facing and orthographic in feel.
- Lighting: studio softbox from upper-left with very gentle fill from the right, producing controlled sheen on gold accents and flat readability on the navy background.
- Color grade: deep navy + antique gold + crisp white, with slight cool contrast and refined corporate saturation.
- Surface feel: smooth premium brochure stock, subtle matte finish, fine paper grain, embossed-looking gold rules, and shallow tactile depth.

[6. MOOD]
Premium startup proposal cover — resembles a McKinsey / boutique strategy-consulting presentation deck with a restrained executive editorial finish, upgraded with realistic submission metadata and formal Korean business-document details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - 사업계획서
  - 창업·지원사업 제출용
  - {프로젝트}
  - {부제}
  - {회사}
  - 지원사업: {지원사업}
  - 문서번호: {문서번호}
  - 제출일: {일자}
  - 보안등급: {기밀표기}
  - 문의: {문의처}
  - 웹사이트: {웹사이트}
  - {기관표기}
- All text must be clean Korean typography with no broken characters, no misspellings, and no layout collisions.
- The composition must remain formal, business-oriented, and cover-like, with a clear title hierarchy, realistic proposal metadata, and disciplined spacing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likenesses
- Fake government approval marks that could be mistaken for a real issued certificate
