studio:prompts3:ours-699.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
One-page marketing campaign planning sheet for presentation or internal review, designed as a premium consultant-style editorial layout with the realism of a printed strategy document on matte paper.
A vertical strategy summary poster that communicates campaign goal, tactics, timeline, budget focus, and KPI at a glance while feeling like an actual working campaign brief.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Page structure: top header occupies about 12%, main content uses a 2x2 box grid in the middle 55%, and a compact chart / timeline / KPI area anchors the lower 20%.
- The overall framing should feel like a polished strategy deck page: centered layout, strong alignment, precise column grid, clear section hierarchy, and realistic document details such as page code, version label, owner line, and footer notes.
- Background treatment: matte white paper texture with faint cool-gray tint, subtle grid hints, light print grain, delicate fold impression, and small editorial metadata details that make the sheet feel physically produced.
- Use {캠페인명}, {목표}, {전략}, {KPI}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {비율} placeholders throughout the layout.
- Add realistic planning-sheet microcopy in Korean, such as "2026 Q2 캠페인 브리프", "내부 검토용", "작성일 2026.05.01", "담당: Growth Marketing Team", "예산 배분", "채널 믹스", "실행 일정", and "리포트 기준: 주간".

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 12%): set {캠페인명} as the main title, large and bold, slightly left-aligned, with a small eyebrow label reading "마케팅 캠페인 한 페이지" and a right-side metadata block reading "DOC-699 · v1.2 · 2026.05".
- Summary line area: place {목표} directly beneath the title as a smaller statement, separated by a thin horizontal rule or subtle divider line; include the visible label "목표" before the goal statement.
- Main grid area (middle 55%): render four equal boxes for campaign planning content. Box 1 title "전략" presents {전략} as bullet-style channel actions with mini icons for SNS, influencer, event, and email. Box 2 title "KPI" presents {KPI} with small metric chips such as "CTR", "CPC", "전환율", "ROAS". Box 3 title "비주얼" follows {비주얼} as an organized creative direction overview with a tiny mood strip, sample ad-card thumbnail, and asset checklist. Box 4 title "컬러 / 비율" uses {컬러} and {비율} as a campaign design-system block with swatches, ratio bar, and usage notes.
- Visual system area: show a chart panel in the lower section with a 6-week timeline, line chart for expected conversion growth, stacked bar for budget/channel mix, and a small legend. Include Korean labels such as "1주차", "2주차", "3주차", "4주차", "5주차", "6주차", "런칭", "리타겟팅", "리뷰 리포트".
- Include a footer strip with page number "01 / 01", small confidentiality text "Internal Marketing Review", a tiny QR-style reference block, and short Korean note "성과 기준은 GA4 및 광고관리자 주간 리포트 기준".
- Keep all text blocks highly legible, with each section aligned to a consistent column grid and balanced padding for a real executive review sheet.
- Format the overall composition to match a one-page marketing campaign dashboard rather than a brochure or social post.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text, bold weights for headings, medium weights for labels, and clear size hierarchy; title around 42–54px, section labels around 18–22px, body around 16–18px, metadata around 10–13px.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2F33, cool gray #D9DEE5, muted blue-gray #6E7C8C, with a clear accent matching {컬러}.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px gray dividers, soft drop shadow 0px 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) on boxes, refined rounded corners around 8px, subtle printed-paper edge shadow.
- Treat {컬러} as the campaign accent system, applying it to chart markers, section tags, timeline dots, KPI chips, and the ratio visualization while keeping the overall palette consulting-grade.
- Add small realistic design artifacts: alignment ticks, section numbers "01 전략", "02 KPI", "03 비주얼", "04 컬러·비율", tiny chart legends, annotated percentage callouts, and neat table rows.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat-lay document rendering style, equivalent to a 50mm standard lens look with a perfectly orthographic page presentation.
- Lighting: soft studio overhead lighting with even diffusion, slight left-side emphasis, gentle paper-edge shadow, and realistic matte print texture.
- Color grade: crisp white, charcoal, muted slate, and restrained accent color accents; clean corporate editorial tone with neutral contrast.
- Material realism: visible fine paper grain, subtle ink density variation in dark text, clean vector-like charts, and slightly tactile printed document quality.

[6. MOOD]
Premium strategy deck page — McKinsey / Bain-style consulting presentation aesthetic with modern editorial polish, realistic internal-review document details, and dense but readable campaign-planning information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and without broken characters: "마케팅 캠페인 한 페이지", "목표", "전략", "KPI", "비주얼", "컬러", "비율", "6주간 매출 +25% / 신규 가입 5000명", "SNS 광고 + 인플루언서 + 이벤트 + 이메일", "CTR / CPC / 전환율 / ROAS 4x 이상".
- Also include readable Korean support text such as "2026 Q2 캠페인 브리프", "내부 검토용", "작성일 2026.05.01", "예산 배분", "채널 믹스", "실행 일정", "리포트 기준: 주간", and "01 / 01".
- All text should be cleanly typeset in Korean, with no garbled Hangul, no missing spaces, and no distorted punctuation.
- Maintain a strict one-page consultant layout: top header, structured boxes, and lower chart area; do not change the overall framing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity likeness or composite portraits

studio:prompts3:ours-698.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Abstract pattern sheet for graphic design use, presented as a realistic printed catalog page featuring a curated set of geometric motifs in a structured grid.
Suitable for a poster-style pattern board, design archive page, studio reference sheet, or social-media-ready pattern collection preview.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 프레임은 정사각형 캔버스 안에서 2x3 또는 3x2 그리드로 6개의 패턴 샘플이 균등 배치되며, 각 칸은 동일한 정렬 기준과 안정적인 간격을 유지한다.
- 각 샘플은 {패턴}을 중심 요소로 두고, {결}에 맞는 도형 조합으로 구성한다. 원, 삼각형, 격자, 점, 물결선, 대각 라인, 반복 블록을 서로 다른 밀도와 리듬으로 변주한다.
- 배경은 실제 인쇄된 두꺼운 매트지처럼 보이게 하며, 미세한 종이 결, 잉크 흡수감, 아주 옅은 스캔 질감을 포함해 그래픽 보드가 실제로 존재하는 느낌을 준다.
- 상단에는 작은 카탈로그 헤더를 배치한다: Korean title text 패턴 연구, issue label VOL.247, date label 2026년 5월호, collection note 기하와 라인의 조합.
- 각 샘플 아래에는 작은 영문 라벨 {타이포}와 함께 Korean micro label 샘플 01, 샘플 02처럼 번호를 붙이고, 짧은 컬러 코드나 모티프 설명을 더한다.
- 우측 하단 또는 하단 바에는 작은 barcode area, archive code ABST-06, studio credit text 디자인 아카이브 / model-name credit Pattern Set by Studio Han을 넣어 실제 카탈로그 페이지처럼 완성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Canvas base: a printed square catalog sheet on matte paper, using {컬러} as the main palette with a subtle paper fiber texture, faint ink grain, and realistic print registration softness while keeping the geometric edges crisp.
2. Grid system: arrange 6 samples in a strict 2x3 or 3x2 layout as defined by {레이아웃}, with consistent gutters, aligned columns, and catalog-style measurement ticks or fine divider rules between sample blocks.
3. Header system: include a compact top title bar with Korean text 패턴 연구, VOL.247, 2026년 5월호, and a small subtitle 도형·라인·기하 모티프 컬렉션. Add tiny spine-like credit text along one edge, such as ARCHIVE SERIES / GEOMETRIC PATTERN.
4. Pattern units: each cell contains a distinct geometric variation built from circles, triangles, grids, lines, dots, waves, blocks, or repeated modules from {패턴}, rendered as clean printed vector artwork with slight ink-on-paper tactility.
5. Style coherence: keep every sample aligned to the same visual logic, while varying shape composition, scale, rotation, line weight, spacing, color blocking, or rhythm so the set feels like a coherent design family.
6. Labels and metadata: place small English labels {타이포} beneath each sample or near the lower edge of each cell, paired with Korean labels such as 샘플 01, 라인 변주, 원형 리듬, 격자 패턴, and tiny swatch codes like C-12, L-04, G-08.
7. Decorative direction: apply {결 추가} through mid-century or Bauhaus-inspired spacing, asymmetric balance, modular numbering, small alignment marks, crop marks, divider lines, and subtle catalog annotations that support the pattern-board identity.
8. Framing: ensure the whole board reads as a polished printed pattern catalog page photographed or scanned from above, with all six samples visible and a finished editorial layout including header, labels, barcode block, page number 06, and credit line.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean system text, and compact Latin labels in Helvetica Neue or Inter, light to medium weight, around 10–18px equivalent depending on hierarchy. Header title may be bolder around 28–40px equivalent.
- Color palette: use {컬러} with concrete combinations such as pastel peach, mint, butter yellow, powder blue, ivory paper, modern charcoal, muted gold, coral, cyan, or deep navy; keep contrast editorial and intentional.
- Printed details: add realistic matte paper grain, slight halftone or risograph-like ink texture where appropriate, tiny crop marks, page code, thin dividers, swatch chips, barcode area, and subtle misregistration no more than 1–2px.
- Border/shadow: allow fine printed rules, thin sample frames, delicate divider lines, and a soft contact shadow if the page is shown as a physical sheet on a surface. Shadows should feel natural and paper-like.
- Text content visible in image may include: 패턴 연구, 도형·라인·기하, 2026년 5월호, VOL.247, 샘플 01, 샘플 02, 컬러 코드, ARCHIVE SERIES, PAGE 06, Pattern Set by Studio Han.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down orthographic editorial product shot captured with Canon EOS R5 and RF 50mm f/2.8 macro, aligned square to the page with very low perspective distortion; the result should feel like a high-resolution scan or catalog photograph of a real printed sheet.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio lighting from above with gentle paper surface visibility, a barely perceptible contact shadow at the sheet edge, and no harsh glare.
- Color grade: crisp editorial palette with either muted pastel harmony or modern high-contrast accent colors, depending on {컬러}; preserve clean white balance, stable saturation, and natural matte ink depth.
- Material finish: premium uncoated paper, tactile ink, fine fibers, light print grain, tiny registration marks, and realistic physical presence while retaining the graphic clarity of vector-based geometric design.

[6. MOOD]
Graphic design archive board — Bauhaus exhibition catalog meets mid-century modern pattern study, enriched with the realism of a photographed printed swatch page from a contemporary design studio.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 한글이 깨지지 않아야 하며, 이미지 안의 문구 패턴 연구, 도형·라인·기하, 2026년 5월호, 샘플 01, 컬러 코드가 정확한 문자 형태로 유지되어야 한다.
- Layout invariant: all 6 pattern samples must remain evenly spaced and clearly separated inside the grid.
- Preserve placeholders exactly: {패턴}, {결}, {레이아웃}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {결 추가}, {비율} must remain conceptually reflected without renaming or replacing them.
- The geometric motifs should remain abstract pattern artwork; any added elements must function as catalog-page details such as labels, barcode, page code, crop marks, swatches, or studio credits.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-697.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a richer 4-panel landscape illustration set for social media, editorial travel content, or postcard merchandise, covering city nightscape, nature mountains, sea, and open fields in a polished illustrated presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas uses a strict {레이아웃} with four equally sized panels, aligned gutters, matching frame thickness, and a printed travel-postcard sheet feeling.
- Each panel features one scene from {풍경목록} while keeping the same {일러스트결}, so the set reads as a unified landscape series.
- Add realistic editorial postcard details: a main series title, small panel names, date/location labels, tiny map-pin icons, weather/time notes, coordinate-like micro text, and stamp-style corner tags.
- The overall surface should feel like matte printed paper with subtle {엽서결}, gentle ink grain, tiny paper fibers, and slightly imperfect risograph-like color edges.
- Place Korean-safe labels near the lower or upper corner of each panel using {라벨타이포}; make them crisp and integrated into the postcard layout.
- Add small scenic details that make each place feel lived-in: lit apartment windows, street lamps, distant birds, a lighthouse or buoy, footpath lines, tiny trees, grasses, clouds, stars, and shoreline marks.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left panel: render the first landscape as a city night view with simplified building silhouettes, glowing windows, a moon or star accents, streetlight dots, and layered skyline depth.
2. Top-right panel: render the second landscape as a nature mountain scene with rolling ridgelines, soft atmospheric perspective, contour-like hill shapes, pine clusters, cloud shadows, and a small hiking trail marker.
3. Bottom-left panel: render the third landscape as a sea scene with broad horizon, gentle wave bands, shoreline separation, a small lighthouse or buoy, gull silhouettes, and golden-hour reflection lines.
4. Bottom-right panel: render the fourth landscape as a field or meadow scene with open land, low vegetation, a curved walking path, wildflowers, distant trees, and a wide sky with warm light.
5. Keep all four panels consistent in {일러스트결}: simple cartoon forms, gradient fills, tiny micro-details, gouache-like edges, and subtle paper texture.
6. Apply time-of-day variation across the set within {컬러}: night tones for the city, clean daylight for mountains, golden-hour warmth for the sea, and late-afternoon softness for the field.
7. Add a small header strip or corner label system to the full sheet: {시리즈명}, {발행일}, {지역표기}, and postcard-style index numbers such as 01 / 02 / 03 / 04.
8. Include decorative but functional travel graphics such as miniature compass marks, dotted route lines, stamp boxes, and small icon badges that support the landscape theme.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean labels in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, Regular to Medium weight, about 18–32 px equivalent; main title slightly larger around 42–56 px equivalent; use crisp Hangul with subtle tracking.
- Color palette: use {컬러} with specific landscape tones such as deep navy #10233F, twilight blue #2E4A77, forest green #4F7A57, sea blue #4C86A8, warm gold #D9A441, sunset coral #E88B6A, cloud cream #F4EBDD, and paper beige #EFE4D0.
- Border/shadow: thin panel borders with subtle 1–2 px dark outline, soft print shadow, and lightly aged postcard edges; keep the sheet suitable for editorial print.
- Label system: use small Korean place names, date stamps, weather tags, coordinates, and index numbers as part of the design rather than floating random text.
- Texture: combine vector-clean silhouettes with gouache grain, soft gradients, ink speckles, tiny hatch lines, and printed paper fibers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat illustration composition, top-down editorial poster logic, digitally painted with a clean 2D vector-meets-gouache look rather than a photographic lens effect.
- Lighting: panel-specific lighting cues such as soft moonlit night for the city, diffused daylight for mountains, low-angle golden hour for sea, and warm late-afternoon light for the field, all rendered with smooth gradients and gentle highlight bands.
- Color grade: natural landscape tones with time-of-day variation—cool midnight blues, fresh daylight greens, amber sunset highlights, and creamy paper whites—while keeping saturation controlled and harmonious.

[6. MOOD]
A polished travel-postcard illustration series with the calm editorial clarity of a modern Japanese stationery set, the tactile charm of printed souvenir cards, and the organized rhythm of a lifestyle magazine spread.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: no broken Hangul characters anywhere in the artwork.
- Render these readable Korean texts exactly where appropriate: main title “{시리즈명}”, date “{발행일}”, location line “{지역표기}”.
- Panel labels should include: “도시의 밤 01”, “푸른 능선 02”, “노을 바다 03”, “바람 들판 04”.
- Add small Korean micro labels such as “맑음”, “산책로”, “해안선”, “별빛”, “여행 기록”, and “엽서 시리즈” with correct spelling.
- All four panels must keep the exact same grid structure, matching frame thickness, and aligned spacing.
- Maintain consistent illustration treatment across all scenes: simple cartoon forms, gradient color fields, paper grain, and micro-detail accents.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person impersonation

studio:prompts3:ours-696.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
8종 직업·일상 사람 일러스트 시트. 2x4 그리드로 각 인물의 역할이 한눈에 읽히는 캐릭터 카드형 인포그래픽.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 캔버스는 정사각형 1024x1024, 8개의 동일한 칸을 2열 4행으로 균등 분할하고 각 칸 사이 여백은 24px 수준으로 일정하게 유지.
- 각 칸 내부에서 인물은 중앙 중심 배치, 머리부터 발끝까지 80~85% 높이로 꽉 차게 두고 상단과 하단에 라벨이 안전하게 들어갈 공간 확보.
- 배경은 칸마다 옅은 파스텔 단색 또는 아주 미세한 톤온톤 패턴으로 정리하고, 전체적으로 화이트/크림 계열 바탕 위에 직업별 포인트 색이 살아나게 구성.
- 각 칸의 하단에는 둥근 라벨 영역을 두고 {타이포} 스타일의 텍스트를 배치, 상단 또는 보조 위치에 영문 부제를 작게 넣어 시리즈 감각을 통일.
- 8종은 {직업·일상}의 구성에 맞춰 서로 다른 도구와 포즈를 명확히 보여주되, 전체 스타일은 동일한 캐릭터 패밀리처럼 유지.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1열 1행: {직업·일상} 첫 번째 인물은 {자세}를 명확하게 취한 상태로 배치하고, 직업을 상징하는 소품이 손에 정확히 들려 보이게 구성.
- 2열 1행: 두 번째 인물은 같은 비례와 선 굵기를 유지하되, 포즈의 각도만 달리해 8종이 반복 복제가 아닌 개별 캐릭터처럼 보이게 조정.
- 1열 2행: 세 번째 인물은 상반신과 하반신 비율이 안정적으로 읽히도록 단순한 바닥선 위에 세우고, 도구의 형태는 둥근 카툰 스타일로 정리.
- 2열 2행: 네 번째 인물은 자세의 실루엣이 배경과 분리되도록 팔과 소품의 윤곽을 조금 더 크게 잡아 시각적 식별성을 강화.
- 1열 3행: 다섯 번째 인물은 {결}의 질감을 가장 잘 보여주도록 선이 매끈하지만 과도하게 AI-플라스틱처럼 보이지 않게 브러시 감을 약간 남김.
- 2열 3행: 여섯 번째 인물은 {컬러}의 직업 시그니처 색이 의상이나 소품에 가장 두드러지게 들어가도록 배치.
- 1열 4행: 일곱 번째 인물은 {타이포} 라벨이 아래쪽에서 읽히기 쉽게 인물과 라벨 사이 간격을 충분히 두고 정렬.
- 2열 4행: 여덟 번째 인물은 나머지 칸과 동일한 프레임 규칙을 따르되, 실루엣이 가장 명확하게 보이도록 도구를 몸 앞쪽으로 배치.
- 각 칸의 인물 수, 비례, 라인 두께, 라벨 위치는 모두 동일한 시스템을 사용해 시리즈 일관성을 유지.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 라벨은 Pretendard Rounded 또는 Nanum Square Round 계열의 둥근 한글, weight 600~700, 22~28px 느낌; 영문 부제는 Noto Sans KR 또는 Pretendard, weight 400~500, 12~16px 느낌.
- Color palette: 파스텔 베이스에 직업별 포인트를 섞은 조합; 예시로 cream #F7F1E8, soft mint #CFE8D8, sky blue #CFE3F8, peach #F7C9B8, lavender #DCCFF7, butter yellow #F6E7A6, coral #F4A28C, sage #BFD3B2.
- Border/shadow: 각 칸은 아주 얇은 라운드 사각 프레임 또는 구분선으로 정리하고, 인물 아래에는 6px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity의 부드러운 그림자를 넣어 떠 보이게 하되 과한 입체감은 금지.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat 2D illustration look, top-down infographic layout reference, no realistic camera perspective; clean vector-like line work with poster composition similar to a modern character sheet.
- Lighting: 균일한 소프트 스튜디오 조명처럼 보이도록 명암 대비를 낮추고, 특정 방향 그림자보다는 미세한 하단 그림자만 유지.
- Color grade: warm pastel editorial grade, cream + mint + peach + sky blue 중심에 직업별 시그니처 컬러를 가볍게 얹은 톤.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean character-sheet editorial — 친근한 교육용 인포그래픽과 스튜디오 캐릭터 포스터가 결합된 느낌.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 한글 문자열: "사람 일러스트", "의사", "교사", "요리사", "개발자", "디자이너", "바리스타", "운동선수", "예술가".
- 8개 칸은 모두 동일한 2x4 그리드 구조를 유지할 것.
- 각 인물은 사람 형태로 명확히 읽혀야 하며, 손/팔/도구의 비례가 어색하지 않게 자연스럽게 표현할 것.
- 한글 라벨은 절대 깨지지 않도록 정확한 자모 결합과 또렷한 획으로 처리.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- 한글 깨짐
- AI 매끈한 플라스틱 질감 과다
- 노출·sexual 강조
- 실제 인물 변형
- 광고 카피 부풀림
- 실제 브랜드 로고
- 인증 마크나 공식 인장처럼 보이는 요소

- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Simple cartoon food icon sheet for social media, app UI, sticker-pack style use, and cute printed merchandise preview.
Flat illustrated food grid with bold outlines, cheerful package-like details, clear bilingual labels, and a lively retail sticker-sheet finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the full composition as a 3x4 grid covering about 82–88% of the canvas, with even gutters and consistent tile size for {음식 12종}, while allowing a small header and footer area like a real sticker-pack backing card.
- Use a clean white #FFFFFF base with soft pastel accent blocks, tiny food-themed decorative marks, rounded dividers, and a light printed-paper feel so the sheet looks like finished character-goods packaging.
- Keep all 12 food items visually balanced in scale, aligned on a strict grid, and separated by cheerful rounded tile zones or subtle sticker backing shapes.
- Add rounded Korean and English labels beneath each item in the {타이포} style, with centered placement and enough breathing room so text stays legible.
- Include a small top header strip reading "FOOD STICKER PACK" and "맛있는 아이콘 12종", plus a tiny product code such as "VOL.012" and "2026 SPRING" in the corner.
- Add a compact footer area with tiny price/contact-style details like "₩3,500", "@cutefood_lab", a small barcode-style rectangle, and short decorative captions, keeping the 12 icons as the main subject.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top-to-bottom, left-to-right grid: place one distinct food icon in each of the 12 slots, matching the simple cartoon look described by {결}.
- Each icon should be rendered with simplified geometry, thick outer contour lines, friendly facial or shine accents where appropriate, small garnish marks, and a consistent sticker-sheet finish.
- Apply the {컬러} palette across all items, keeping the base clean white while adding coordinated pastel panels, small dots, stripes, sparkles, and label ribbons that support the food theme.
- Preserve the {레이아웃} arrangement exactly, with equal spacing between rows and columns and no overlap between the 12 labeled icon tiles.
- Use the {결 추가} treatment so the entire sheet feels like a cohesive icon set rather than mixed illustration styles.
- Keep all label text crisp, centered, and readable under each icon, following the rounded, friendly look of {타이포}.
- Respect {비율} so the icons, header, footer, labels, and decorative packaging elements feel balanced on the square canvas.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: rounded Korean and English sans-serif, similar to Pretendard Rounded or Nanum Square Round, medium-to-bold weight; food labels about 22–28 px at 1024 canvas scale, header text larger and playful.
- Color palette: {컬러} with vivid coral #FF6F61, bright yellow #FFD84D, lime green #A8E063, clean white #FFFFFF base, and deep outline black #1A1A1A; add soft pastel tints derived from the palette for tile backgrounds and package accents.
- Border/shadow: bold 3–5 px black outlines around every icon, with light flat offset shadows and tiny printed sticker edges for a tactile merchandise-sheet look.
- Graphic details: include rounded corner backing-card frame, small sticker cut-line hints, tiny stars, dots, hearts, sauce marks, steam marks, and simple divider lines without disturbing the 3x4 grid.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: orthographic illustration look, no perspective distortion, no photographic lens feel; crisp vector-style framing on a square canvas.
- Lighting: even studio-flat illumination with soft flat shadows used only as graphic accents, no dramatic shadow, and no surface glare.
- Color grade: high-saturation candy palette with clean white and pastel packaging accents, matching a cheerful UI sticker sheet and cute retail stationery design.

[6. MOOD]
Playful retail sticker sheet — Japanese character goods packaging meets Korean cafe-menu cuteness and clean flat icon design, like a finished app asset board sold as a small sticker pack.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the labels and package text must render clearly and without broken characters.
- Every food icon must remain distinct and recognizable, with exactly 12 food items shown in the 3x4 grid.
- Composition invariants: equal spacing, centered layout, consistent icon scale, bold outline style across all 12 items.
- Verbatim Korean strings that must appear correctly: "피자", "버거", "라멘", "초밥", "치킨", "샐러드", "디저트", "커피", "맥주", "아이스크림", "도넛", "과일".
- Additional Korean package text that may appear clearly: "맛있는 아이콘 12종", "오늘의 간식", "귀여운 푸드 스티커", "₩3,500".

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
Botanical illustration sheet for 8 flower and plant varieties, designed as a refined editorial botanical card suitable for print, poster insert, stationery packaging, and social sharing.
A portrait-format illustrated collection page with handmade botanical charm, small catalog details, specimen labels, and realistic printed-card information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: 8 botanical illustrations arranged to fill the portrait page evenly, with each item occupying a clearly readable botanical card area.
- Layout: {레이아웃}, using soft panel divisions, botanical index numbers, and varied stem/leaf silhouettes so the sheet feels collected rather than empty.
- Background: warm ivory paper with subtle fiber texture, faint pressed-flower speckles, pale beige guide lines, and lightly printed editorial marks.
- Header area: show the main title {제목}, subtitle {부제}, issue/date line {발행정보}, and collection code {컬렉션코드} at the top like a small botanical catalog cover.
- Labels: small Korean and English labels placed near each illustration using {타이포}, paired with specimen numbers such as 01–08 and short care-note microcopy.
- Social/card details: include a tiny creator handle {핸들}, hashtag line {해시태그}, and small save/share-style micro icons in the lower footer.
- Visual grouping: keep all species visually cohesive while preserving individual silhouette clarity and species identity.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Panel system: place {종류} as the full set of 8 botanical subjects, each rendered as a separate illustrated element with a small specimen label, Latin-style note, and Korean name.
- Illustration treatment: render each plant in {일러스트_결} style, with delicate outlines, soft pigment edges, translucent washes, hand-drawn veins, tiny pollen dots, and natural stem imperfections.
- Composition order: arrange the 8 illustrations in a neat 2x4 grid or a freer collage depending on {레이아웃}, while keeping the portrait sheet balanced and readable from top to bottom.
- Color handling: use {컬러} as the base palette, keeping greens natural and floral tones distinct so each subject remains recognizable at a glance.
- Typography placement: add {타이포} as small captions beneath or beside each illustration, aligned consistently with specimen numbers, bilingual names, and tiny descriptive notes.
- Finishing layer: apply {결_추가} as an editorial botanical card finish with warm paper grain, fine beige rules, small corner crop marks, botanical sticker tags, and a discreet footer credit.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean, paired with a light serif italic for English botanical labels; regular to medium weight, small caption size around 18–24px equivalent, crisp anti-aliased edges.
- Color palette: {컬러} with specific support tones such as #F8F6F0, #E8EFE3, #C9DDB9, #F2D8D0, #D9C7A3, #6F8F61, #B8766B.
- Border/shadow: fine warm-beige panel rules, soft paper-card layering, ultra-soft shadow with 2px y-offset, 8px blur, 10% opacity, and subtle printed ink variation.
- Editorial details: add tiny page notation, footer credit, collection barcode-like decorative strip, and specimen note blocks without overwhelming the botanical artwork.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat lay editorial look, equivalent to a 50mm lens perspective with minimal distortion and perfectly parallel framing.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left, even fill from right, gentle paper shadow around card edges, natural pigment depth.
- Color grade: fresh botanical paper tones with muted green, petal pink, sunflower yellow, lavender violet, olive gray, cactus sage, and clean ivory white.

[6. MOOD]
Premium botanical stationery sheet — like a refined herbarium catalog page mixed with a modern Korean lifestyle magazine insert, handmade but polished, calm and collectible.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: "꽃·식물 일러스트", "장미", "튤립", "해바라기", "라벤더", "올리브", "유칼립투스", "몬스테라", "선인장".
- Additional rendered Korean text should include: "VOL.08", "2026년 봄 컬렉션", "보태닉 노트", "저장", "공유", "@botanic.studio", "#식물일러스트 #플라워카드".
- Maintain exactly 8 distinct botanical subjects total, each clearly separable and not merged into a single bouquet.
- All labels, specimen numbers, and footer texts must remain legible, properly spelled in Korean, and visually aligned with the card system.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or impersonation
- Photorealistic human figures

studio:prompts3:ours-693.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024
- target_format: printed character sticker sheet product preview, 2x3 grid, Korean stationery goods catalog image

[1. PURPOSE]
6개의 동물 캐릭터 일러스트를 한 화면에 정리한 2x3 그리드 스티커 시트 포스터. SNS 공유용, 아동용 굿즈 프리뷰, 문구 브랜드 상품 페이지에 어울리도록 실제 인쇄된 다이컷 스티커 샘플처럼 상단 제목, 시즌 정보, 품번·가격·바코드, 작은 장식 스티커, 컷 라인, 매장형 안내 문구가 함께 보이는 풍성한 벡터풍 상품 레이아웃.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 화면은 가로형 1536x1024 캔버스 기준으로 {레이아웃}을 반영한 2x3 그리드를 중심에 배치하고, {비율}에 맞춰 각 칸이 같은 크기의 스티커 상품 패널처럼 읽히게 구성한다.
- 화면은 실제 스티커 시트를 정면에서 촬영한 듯한 포스터형 구성으로, 상단에는 둥근 헤더 바, {제목}, {시즌라벨}, {발행정보}를 넣고, 우측 상단에는 작은 걸이 구멍과 제품 분류 태그를 배치한다.
- 하단에는 제품 코드·가격·바코드·브랜드 메모처럼 보이는 얇은 정보 줄을 넣는다. “{품번}”, “{가격}”, “{브랜드명}”, “{문의문구}”가 실제 패키지 인쇄처럼 작고 또렷하게 보이게 한다.
- 각 칸은 개별 다이컷 스티커 카드처럼 보이도록 둥근 컷 라인, 옅은 컬러 패널, 작은 번호 태그, 동물 이름표를 포함하되, 6개의 동물 캐릭터가 가장 먼저 눈에 들어오게 한다.
- {동물1}, {동물2}, {동물3}, {동물4}, {동물5}, {동물6}이 모두 한눈에 구분되도록 각 캐릭터의 자세와 방향을 다르게 배치하고, 귀·꼬리·날개·앞발·발바닥·표정 같은 특징을 명확하게 살린다.
- {배경}은 전체 통일감이 느껴지는 파스텔 종이 질감 또는 연한 컬러 보드로 만들고, 작은 발자국, 별, 잎사귀, 하트, 스티커 조각, 반짝이 모양, 테이프 조각, 라운드 인덱스 탭을 동물 주변에 자연스럽게 배치한다.
- 텍스트 요소는 실제 상품 시트처럼 작고 또렷하게 넣는다: 상단 제목, 시즌 라벨, 각 칸의 짧은 한글 이름표, 하단 품번/가격/브랜드형 마이크로 텍스트, 작은 사용 안내 문구가 보이도록 구성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) 좌상단 칸: {동물1} 캐릭터를 {자세1}로 배치하고, 몸통과 얼굴이 가장 잘 보이도록 정면 또는 3/4 각도로 정리한다. 주변에는 작은 생선뼈, 발자국, 하트 스티커, 둥근 다이컷 라인을 더해 첫 번째 칸의 상품성을 높인다. 이름표는 “{라벨1}”로 넣는다.
2) 상단 중앙 칸: {동물2} 캐릭터를 {자세2}로 배치하되, 첫 번째와 실루엣이 겹치지 않도록 팔·다리·꼬리 방향을 다르게 둔다. 작은 공, 별 모양 태그, 컬러 말풍선 장식, 뼈다귀 아이콘을 곁들인다. 이름표는 “{라벨2}”로 넣는다.
3) 우상단 칸: {동물3} 캐릭터는 {자세3}처럼 가볍게 움직이는 동작으로 넣어 상단 행에 리듬감을 만든다. 날개·깃털·작은 구름·반짝임 요소를 넣어 가벼운 움직임을 강조한다. 이름표는 “{라벨3}”로 넣는다.
4) 좌하단 칸: {동물4} 캐릭터는 {자세4}로 안정감을 주고, 앞발이나 귀의 방향으로 귀여운 포인트를 만든다. 작은 나뭇잎, 도토리, 번호 라벨, 숲속 메모 스티커를 함께 배치한다. 이름표는 “{라벨4}”로 넣는다.
5) 하단 중앙 칸: {동물5} 캐릭터는 {자세5}처럼 표정 변화가 드러나는 포즈로 배치한다. 꿀단지, 작은 꽃, 둥근 장식 스티커, 체크 무늬 미니 태그를 주변에 넣어 풍성하게 만든다. 이름표는 “{라벨5}”로 넣는다.
6) 우하단 칸: {동물6} 캐릭터는 {자세6}로 마무리해, 6종 전체가 서로 다른 감정과 동작을 갖도록 정리한다. 달, 작은 담요 패턴, Z 모양 장식 스티커, 별가루를 넣어 따뜻한 엔딩 느낌을 준다. 이름표는 “{라벨6}”로 넣는다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 실제 스티커 시트 상품처럼 한글 텍스트를 사용한다. 상단에는 굵고 둥근 제목, 각 칸에는 작은 이름표, 하단에는 품번·가격·날짜·문의 문구 같은 마이크로 텍스트를 넣는다. 모든 글자는 선명하고 읽기 쉬운 둥근 고딕 스타일로 처리한다.
- Palette: {컬러}를 중심으로 하되, pink, mint, yellow, sky blue, coral, lavender를 캐릭터별 포인트 컬러로 나눠 사용한다. 배경 종이 톤은 따뜻한 아이보리 또는 {배경} 계열로 두고, 컷 라인은 흰색과 연한 회색으로 실제 스티커 테두리처럼 표현한다.
- Line / shape: {결}처럼 둥글고 단순한 카툰 형태를 유지하되, 볼 홍조, 작은 털 결, 귀 안쪽 그라데이션, 발바닥 패드, 깃털 선, 코의 하이라이트, 꼬리 끝 색 변화처럼 가까이 보면 보이는 세부 묘사를 추가한다. 외곽선은 부드럽고 일정하지만, 인쇄된 잉크처럼 살짝 따뜻한 질감을 가진다.
- Print details: 각 다이컷 스티커 가장자리에 반무광 코팅 하이라이트, 얇은 종이 두께, 미세한 잉크 망점, 살짝 어긋난 파스텔 오버프린트 느낌을 더한다. 하단 바코드는 장식용 상품 바코드처럼 보이게 하며, 숫자와 품번은 실제 패키지 인쇄처럼 정렬한다.
- Shadow: 각 캐릭터와 다이컷 스티커 아래에 부드러운 접촉 그림자를 넣고, 시트 전체에는 얇은 종이 두께와 살짝 들뜬 가장자리 그림자를 넣어 실제 촬영된 문구 상품처럼 보이게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 50mm macro lens, straight-on orthographic product-photo framing, very low distortion, printed sticker sheet captured as a clean editorial flat lay.
- Lighting: large softbox studio lighting from upper left, gentle paper-edge shadows, subtle highlights on semi-matte sticker coating, consistent illumination across all six grid cells.
- Color grade: pastel editorial palette — pink, mint, yellow, sky blue, coral, lavender with warm ivory paper, soft gray cut lines, and cheerful kids-stationery color harmony.

[6. MOOD]
Korean kids-brand sticker sheet aesthetic — playful stationery illustration, boutique character-goods preview, warm printed-paper realism, friendly preschool gift-shop feeling, cheerful weekend stationery market vibe.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 이미지 안의 한글은 반드시 정확하고 깨지지 않게 렌더링한다. 상단 제목은 “{제목}”, 작은 라벨은 “{시즌라벨}”, “{발행정보}”, “{테마문구}”, 하단 정보는 “{품번}”, “{가격}”, “{브랜드명}”, “{문의문구}”처럼 자연스러운 한국어로 넣는다.
- Label set: 6개 칸의 이름표는 “{라벨1}”, “{라벨2}”, “{라벨3}”, “{라벨4}”, “{라벨5}”, “{라벨6}”를 각각 정확히 사용하고, 번호 태그는 “01”, “02”, “03”, “04”, “05”, “06”으로 작게 표시한다.
- Layout invariant: 6개의 메인 동물은 반드시 2x3 그리드로 모두 분리되어 구분되어야 하며, 각 칸에 1마리씩 배치한다. 장식용 발자국·별·잎사귀·하트·스티커 조각은 가능하지만 메인 동물 수는 정확히 6마리여야 한다.
- Style invariant: 모든 캐릭터는 {결} 스타일이어야 하고, 과도한 사실감, 사람형 손, 복잡한 근육 표현 없이 아동용 스티커 캐릭터로 일관되게 보인다.
- Product realism: 다이컷 라인, 반무광 코팅 느낌, 작은 그림자, 종이 가장자리, 바코드, 품번, 가격, 제품 정보 줄을 통해 실제 판매용 스티커 시트처럼 보이게 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean mind map infographic for brainstorming and idea organization, designed as a polished presentation graphic for slides, reports, workshop documentation, or social sharing.
Single-page editorial infographic with a central topic hub, 4–6 branching categories, compact subnodes, and realistic workshop-style supporting details such as a title strip, date label, legend, small icons, and annotation chips.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered main hub occupies about 22% of the canvas width, with {중심 주제} inside a large circular node.
- 4–6 main branches radiate outward in balanced directions, keeping the left and right sides visually even while allowing natural variation in branch length.
- Each branch ends in a rounded rectangular label, with smaller subnode boxes nested beneath or beside each branch.
- Add a top editorial header bar reading “아이디어 맵” with a small date label “2026.05.01”, a project tag “팀 브레인스토밍”, and a tiny credit line “작성: @planner”.
- Add a compact lower information strip with “핵심 질문”, “다음 액션”, “우선순위” chips, a small page marker “01 / 01”, and a simple color legend matching the branch colors.
- Background is bright white with subtle off-white paper texture, faint dotted grid marks, light pencil-like alignment guides, and small sticky-note or marker accents that support the brainstorming theme.
- Use {중심 주제}, {가지 (4~6개)}, {하위 노드}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {비율} placeholders exactly as user-customizable content.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Center hub: render {중심 주제} as the largest circular node in the middle, with a strong visual anchor, crisp outline, and a small icon or pictogram derived from {비주얼} placed subtly above or beside the text.
- Main branches: place each item from {가지 (4~6개)} on its own color-coded branch, evenly spaced around the center like a strategic brainstorming map.
- Subnode layer: under each branch, place the relevant items from {하위 노드} in smaller boxes, aligned clearly and connected by thin curved lines.
- Add realistic idea-board details: tiny numbered dots on main branches, small checkbox bullets beside selected subnodes, short Korean annotation tags such as “메모”, “검토”, “실행”, and “우선” where appropriate.
- Visual scaffolding: match {비주얼} with a clear center-circle-plus-branch-line system, using smooth curved connectors, neat node spacing, and occasional small icon badges that help differentiate categories.
- Color system: apply {컬러} with one distinct accent color per branch, while keeping the background and core text neutral for readability.
- Typography layer: apply {타이포} with a rounded Korean sans-serif for main labels and a smaller English subtitle style where needed; include tiny editorial microcopy such as “WORKSHOP MAP”, “IDEA FLOW”, and “BRAINSTORM LOG”.
- Canvas ratio: maintain {비율} with a wide infographic layout that feels balanced, content-rich, and presentation-ready.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for main Korean text, SemiBold for branch labels, Medium for subnodes, 28–40 px for the center, 18–24 px for branches, 14–18 px for subnodes; optional English subtitle in Inter Regular.
- Color palette: clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, coral #FF7A6B, lime #9AD84B, cyan #4CC9F0, gold #F2C14E, with branch-specific color coding.
- Border/shadow: thin 2px charcoal outline on the center node, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 14px at 12% opacity, rounded corners on all boxes, no heavy bevels.
- Graphic texture: use faint paper grain, subtle dotted grid, light marker strokes, small tape-tab shapes, and simple flat icons to make the infographic feel like a real workshop artifact refined for publication.
- Information density: include enough labels, subnodes, legend items, metadata, and visual cues for the page to feel complete and usable rather than like a template placeholder.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat graphic layout inspired by Adobe Illustrator infographic design, equivalent to a 35mm flat-lay framing if photographed.
- Lighting: even diffused studio lighting, soft natural paper shadows under sticker-like chips and node cards, high readability with flat poster-like consistency.
- Color grade: neutral white base with vivid coral, lime, cyan, and gold accents; slightly cool-balanced whites with charcoal text.
- Finish: editorial vector infographic blended with realistic printed-paper texture, precise alignment, crisp Korean typography, and tactile workshop-board details.

[6. MOOD]
Clean strategy-board editorial — like a modern startup workshop slide or a polished Notion / Miro brainstorming board translated into a refined infographic, with the warmth of an actual planning session captured on a finished presentation sheet.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: {중심 주제}, {가지 (4~6개)}, {하위 노드}
- Additional Korean text rendered in the image should be short and clear: “아이디어 맵”, “팀 브레인스토밍”, “핵심 질문”, “다음 액션”, “우선순위”, “메모”, “검토”, “실행”.
- Layout invariants: 중심 허브 1개, 방사형 가지 4~6개, 각 가지별 하위 노드가 명확히 구분되어야 함, 텍스트는 모두 한글이 깨지지 않고 선명해야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean process-step infographic poster, vertical editorial layout, designed for a clear and shareable 5-step workflow guide.
Suitable for social sharing, presentation slides, internal onboarding documents, workshop handouts, and educational carousel first pages.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster in 1024x1536 format with a structured editorial infographic layout: top masthead/title zone about 14%, main step-flow zone about 70%, and footer/CTA zone about 16%.
- Main composition uses {비주얼구성} with five connected step nodes, arrows, numbered labels, icon blocks, short descriptions, and a small progress indicator.
- Background is a warm white paper-like design surface with faint grid ticks, light section dividers, small annotation labels, and subtle geometric accents that support the workflow theme.
- Add realistic infographic-poster details: a small series label, issue/date line, author or team credit, bottom CTA, page indicator, and a compact reference note area.
- Use {주제}, {부제}, {단계목록}, {단계설명}, {컬러팔레트}, {타이포스타일}, {프로젝트명}, {작성자}, {발행일}, {하단CTA}, {페이지표시}, {아이콘스타일}, {장식요소}, {비율} as the content anchors for the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header block (top 14%): place a small label such as {프로젝트명} above the main headline, set {주제} as the large bold headline, and add {부제} as a one-line editorial subtitle beneath it.
2) Metadata strip: near the title or top-right corner, include {발행일}, {작성자}, and a compact label like “WORKFLOW GUIDE / VOL.05” to make the poster feel like a real published learning asset.
3) Step flow area (middle 70%): build five stacked or sequential step boxes for {단계목록}; each box contains a STEP number, icon from {아이콘스타일}, step title, and a short explanation line from {단계설명}.
4) Connector logic: connect each step with clear arrows, dotted guide paths, or directional lines; show the flow from start to finish with consistent spacing and visual rhythm.
5) Visual hierarchy: make Step 01 and Step 05 slightly more emphasized through scale, accent color, badge treatment, or stroke weight while maintaining the same design system across all five steps.
6) Detail layer: add small helpful microcopy such as “체크포인트”, “추천 도구”, “검토 질문”, or “실행 메모” inside or beside the step boxes where appropriate.
7) Footer area (bottom 16%): include {하단CTA}, {페이지표시}, a short source/note line, small save/share-style micro icons, and a thin divider or decorative bar derived from {장식요소}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the title, Pretendard SemiBold for step titles, Pretendard Medium for descriptions, and Inter Bold for STEP numbers and small metadata labels.
- Color palette: use warm white #FAFAF7 and charcoal #2B2B2B as the base, with step-by-step accent colors derived from {컬러팔레트}; allow small pastel fills, badge labels, and connector accents for clarity.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px dividers, lightly rounded cards, small pill labels, and a soft drop shadow of 0px y-offset, 8px blur, 12% opacity; keep all effects flat and print-friendly.
- Layout accents may include small arrows, dot grids, timeline ticks, rounded number badges, underlines, marker highlights, and tiny UI-like labels, aligned to a strict editorial grid.
- Icons should be simple but recognizable: lightbulb for idea, magnifier for search, pencil/document for writing, check shield for review, rocket/play button for execution.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic design look, as if composed in a clean vector-editor mockup; no photographic lens distortion, no perspective tilt.
- Lighting: even studio-like front illumination, no directional shadow drama, no glare.
- Color grade: neutral warm white + charcoal base with readable step accents, similar to modern startup slide decks, editorial magazine infographics, and Notion-style workflow systems.

[6. MOOD]
Modern editorial infographic — practical startup workflow guide with a magazine-like information design feel, friendly learning-poster energy, and polished Korean typography.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구: “프로세스 단계 인포그래픽”, “AI 도구 사용 5단계”, “아이디어 → 검색 → 작성 → 검토 → 실행”, “기획부터 실행까지 한 장으로 정리하는 실전 워크플로”, “간단 한 줄 + 작은 도구 추천”, “화이트 + 차콜 + 단계별 컬러 코딩”, “굵은 한글 + 영문 STEP 번호”, “1024x1536”.
- Realistic poster text elements to include in Korean: “워크플로 노트 VOL.05”, “2026.05.01 발행”, “에디터 팀 인사이트”, “저장하고 다음 프로젝트에 적용하기”, “01/05”.
- All five steps must be visually consistent as one cohesive system, with all arrows present, no duplicated panels, and precise alignment.
- Korean typography must remain crisp and fully legible with proper spacing, especially inside step titles, captions, CTA, and metadata labels.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized portrait likenesses

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean provincial and metropolitan city map infographic poster for data presentation, designed as a polished editorial data page that feels like a real report insert, magazine infographic, and social-share poster.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header occupies about 14% of the frame; main Korea 17-region map hero takes about 58% in the middle; bottom insight / legend / source area fills the remaining 28%.
- Use {주제} as the headline concept, with a strong single-line or stacked Korean title treatment. Add a small publication-style kicker above it such as "REGIONAL DATA MAP" and a date label such as "2026년 5월호 · VOL.247".
- The map should be a full Korea 17-region outline infographic with each region separated clearly, including small Korean region labels such as "서울", "부산", "대구", "인천", "광주", "대전", "울산", "세종", "경기", "강원", "충북", "충남", "전북", "전남", "경북", "경남", "제주".
- Background treatment should be a realistic warm off-white report paper surface with visible fine paper grain, faint registration marks, subtle folded-paper impression, and editorial print texture.
- Place {범례} and {주요 데이터} in a structured bottom block with aligned columns for easy reading; include source note, page number, section marker, and a small barcode / QR-style information box for realism.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 14%): set {주제} in a bold Korean infographic title style, centered or slightly left-aligned, with strong contrast and tight leading. Add small supporting text: "대한민국 17개 시도 비교 인포그래픽", "데이터 기준일 2026.05", and a tiny credit line "Map design: 데이터편집팀".
- Main map area (middle 58%): render {지도 결} as a clean Korea map hero, with each region legible, borders crisp, island placement carefully handled, and color intensity changing by data level. Add fine leader lines for compact regions when needed.
- Data emphasis: apply {컬러} across the map regions as a step-gradient system, keeping the darkest tone for the highest value regions and the lightest tone for the lowest. Include a subtle mini-scale strip beside the map showing "낮음 → 높음".
- Legend block (bottom-left): display {범례} as a compact explanatory key using small color chips, thin rules, short Korean labels, and sample value ranges such as "0–20", "21–40", "41–60", "61–80", "81+".
- Insight block (bottom-right): place {주요 데이터} as a concise ranked or listed summary, aligned vertically with numeric emphasis. Add small badges like "TOP 3", "전월 대비", "핵심 지표" and short Korean blurbs such as "상위 지역 집중", "변화 폭 확대", "권역별 격차 확인".
- Footer information strip: include realistic report elements such as "자료: 통계청·지자체 공개자료 재가공", "단위: 지수", "PAGE 03", "SECTION A / 지역 분석", and a small barcode area with micro text "SCAN FOR DATA".
- Use {비주얼} to keep the whole composition editorial and structured, with layered paper panels, ruled dividers, data callout boxes, small arrows, dot markers, and tidy alignment between title, map, and data panels.
- Maintain {비율} as a tall infographic poster ratio with strong vertical hierarchy suitable for a 1024x1536 vertical report poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the title, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, Pretendard Regular for supporting text; title around 52–68px, body labels 22–28px, numeric highlights 30–36px, micro metadata 12–16px.
- Color palette: warm beige #F4EBDD, off-white #FAF7F2, muted black #1F1F1F, step-gradient greens from #DCECC3 to #2F6B3C, optional accent sand #D8C39A. Use {컬러} as the visible data-map palette reference.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal divider lines, hairline grid marks, soft drop shadow under map panel (0px x, 6px y, 14px blur, 10% opacity), lightly printed ink edges, and realistic paper-depth layering.
- Add small editorial details: section tabs, map coordinate ticks, callout dots, source footnote, page number, date stamp, and a compact barcode / QR placeholder box while keeping the map and data hierarchy dominant.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic design poster, top-down infographic layout, equivalent to a 35mm editorial layout view with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft diffuse studio light 느낌, even illumination across the entire page, with gentle paper texture and natural print finish.
- Color grade: warm neutral paper tone with controlled green data gradation, slightly desaturated for a report-ready, magazine-infographic finish.
- Rendering: high-resolution editorial print mockup look, crisp vector-style map boundaries, tactile paper grain, precise Korean typography, and subtle CMYK print realism.

[6. MOOD]
Modern data editorial infographic — reminiscent of Bloomberg Businessweek chart pages and Monocle-style information design, but enriched with realistic Korean report-poster details, source notes, ranking modules, and magazine-like metadata.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and legibly if shown: {주제}, {범례}, {주요 데이터}, {지도 결}, {컬러}, {비주얼}, and any rendered regional or numeric labels included in {주요 데이터}.
- Include realistic Korean infographic text such as "대한민국 17개 시도", "데이터 기준일 2026.05", "자료: 통계청·지자체 공개자료 재가공", "TOP 3", "전월 대비", "PAGE 03", and "SECTION A / 지역 분석".
- Map layout must show all 17 Korean administrative regions clearly separated and consistently styled, including 제주 placement and compact metropolitan regions.
- Text must be crisp Korean typography with no broken characters, no garbling, and no misread numerals.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Historical/process timeline infographic for a company or personal project, designed as a vertical editorial poster and report-page hybrid with milestone cards, metadata, source notes, and presentation-ready Korean text.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main timeline runs vertically through the center 55% of the frame, with milestone nodes spaced evenly from top to bottom and connected by a continuous charcoal spine.
- Title area occupies the top 16% with strong hierarchy: use {주제} as the headline, {부제} as the subtitle, and {기간} as a compact date range label.
- Add a realistic publication metadata row near the title: {발행처}, {발행일}, {문서번호}, and {페이지표시} rendered like an annual report or archive poster.
- Use {주요 마일스톤} as the timeline content, {비주얼} as the structural layout cue, {컬러} as the palette direction, and {타이포} as the typography direction.
- Include small documentary details around the timeline: category chips, tiny source captions, a 3-item summary strip, miniature chart marks, and one QR-style information block labeled {문의정보}.
- Background should be white or very light warm gray with subtle paper grain, faint grid ticks, pale archival lines, and quiet editorial dividers that support the information hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title block (top 16%): Set {주제} in a large Korean serif headline, with {부제} beneath it and a small uppercase/numeric line showing {기간}, {발행일}, and {문서번호}.
- Header metadata: Add small labels such as “HISTORY TIMELINE”, “ARCHIVE NOTE”, “VOL.05”, and “작성: {발행처}” in neatly aligned type.
- Timeline spine (middle 55%): Draw a thin charcoal line with circular nodes; each node anchors one milestone from {주요 마일스톤}. Nodes may use accent rings, tiny year tabs, and small icon markers related to launch, growth, funding, expansion, and future plan.
- Milestone cards: Place small rounded rectangles beside each node, each card containing a year label, a short event phrase, a 1-line supporting note, and a small status tag such as “완료”, “확장”, “진행중”, or “예정”.
- Data strip: Add {통계요약} as a horizontal mini-dashboard with three compact numbers and captions, separated by fine vertical dividers.
- Context annotation: Include {섹션라벨} as a small side label and {출처문구} as a footnote-style caption near the lower timeline.
- Publisher/footer area (bottom 10%): Place {발행처}, {문의정보}, {하단CTA}, a page indicator {페이지표시}, and a thin editorial rule, with one small QR-style square and a barcode-like archive code.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use a Korean serif such as Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the title at 44–64 px, paired with Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text at 18–24 px; years can use a clean sans-serif with semi-bold weight.
- Color palette: Follow {컬러} with white #FFFFFF, charcoal #222222, warm gray #F4F1EA, and accent tones like gold #C8A96A or lime #B8D34A applied to nodes, year tabs, badges, and key statistic highlights.
- Cards and dividers: Cards use 1px light-gray borders, rounded 14–18 px corners, very soft shadows, small colored top bars, and subtle internal dividers for year, event, note, and status label.
- Information density: The poster should feel like a polished annual-report timeline, with readable Korean labels, realistic captions, and structured secondary details rather than empty poster space.
- Decorative graphics: Use restrained editorial ornaments such as dotted guide lines, tiny arrows, archival ticks, small pictogram badges, and a QR-style block, all aligned to the grid.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Graphic design poster look, flat editorial layout, as if photographed with a 50mm lens perspective but rendered as a clean print composition; no painterly distortion.
- Lighting: Even studio-like illumination with no harsh directionality, mimicking a catalog page or annual report spread.
- Color grade: Neutral premium base with restrained accent contrast, charcoal + warm white + selective gold/lime highlights.

[6. MOOD]
Corporate retrospective editorial — a premium annual-report timeline page with archive-document realism, calm confidence, and a polished Korean business presentation feel.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Layout invariant: milestone nodes must remain evenly spaced along a single coherent vertical timeline, with all cards aligned to the same grid logic and no overlapping text.
- Year labels and short milestone phrases must be legible, correctly ordered from earliest to latest, and visually matched to the timeline sequence.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean comparison infographic chart for editorial/social use, designed as a polished data-poster spread that looks ready for a magazine, news app, or research report.
Show two entities with a clear versus structure, combining bar charts, a donut chart, small metric icons, annotation labels, source microcopy, and realistic editorial details in one content-rich layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main composition: a strict left-right split layout with a centered “VS” divider, where each side occupies roughly 44% of the frame and the middle gutter takes about 12%.
- Title/header area: top band 14–16% of height, containing a bold comparison headline, a short subtitle line, a date label, and a small publication-style tag such as “DATA BRIEF VOL.247” or “2026년 5월 리포트”.
- Data area: the lower 70–74% holds charts, labels, metric cards, legends, small icons, and short explanatory notes, with aligned rows to keep both sides perfectly comparable.
- Background treatment: white or very light gray editorial sheet with subtle paper grain, faint grid ticks, tiny registration marks, and a refined printed-report feeling.
- Add realistic infographic details: small source line, page marker “p.03 / 비교 분석”, tiny QR-style box, compact legend chips, footnote symbols, and caption text without changing the core side-by-side comparison.
- Use {비교 대상}, {비교 항목}, {차트}, {인사이트}, {비주얼}, {컬러} placeholders naturally as the content variables for the poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone: place a concise Korean comparison headline at the top, followed by a smaller subline that introduces {비교 대상} in one sentence. Include issue/date metadata such as “VOL.247”, “2026.05 업데이트”, “편집부 리서치”.
2. Left comparison panel: present the first item of {비교 대상} with a stacked label block, one dominant bar chart set, 2–3 small metric icons aligned vertically, a short caption, and a small accent badge such as “강점 포인트”.
3. Center divider: render a bold “VS” separator in the middle gutter using a compact badge, vertical rule, and tiny comparison ticks; add subtle labels like “동일 기준 비교” and “{비율} 기준”.
4. Right comparison panel: mirror the left side with the second item of {비교 대상}, keeping the same chart positions, label sizes, icon scale, and value axis logic for symmetry.
5. Chart layer: integrate {차트} so the primary bar comparison sits near the middle of each panel, the donut chart acts as a supporting visual, and the small icons clarify each metric row. Include axis labels, percentage/value labels, legend chips, and small callout arrows for key differences.
6. Insight strip: near the bottom, place {인사이트} in a highlighted callout box so the conclusion is immediately readable; add a short Korean label like “핵심 인사이트” and a tiny analyst note line.
7. Footer microcopy: add realistic source-style detail and caption line such as “자료 기준: 2026.05 · 표본 업데이트 · 단위: {비율}”, plus a small page number, QR-style square, and editorial credit “디자인/데이터: 리서치팀”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text, with 700–800 weight for the headline and 400–500 weight for labels; title size should feel poster-like while body text remains highly legible.
- Color palette: base on white and charcoal, then apply two accent colors from {컬러}; keep contrast strong, newsroom-like, and consistent across bars, donut segments, badges, and legend chips.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px divider lines, soft shadow 4px y-offset with 12px blur at 15% opacity for chart cards, and clean rounded rectangles with 10–14px radius.
- Layout finish: use precise alignment, consistent padding, clear grid rhythm, small editorial ornaments, fine divider ticks, numeric labels, and structured metadata so the image feels like a real published comparison graphic.
- Data styling: all values should feel plausible and organized; use readable Korean labels for {비교 항목}, with bar lengths and donut percentages visually coherent with {비율}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic design layout, top-down editorial infographic framing, equivalent to an orthographic poster composition with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft studio-style even illumination, digitally rendered with gentle paper depth and uniform card shadows.
- Color grade: crisp white + charcoal base with two contrasting accent tones, similar to a modern newsroom infographic, premium business magazine data spread, and tech comparison slide.
- Surface realism: include subtle paper fiber, crisp printed edges, microtext, fine ruled lines, small icon glyphs, and polished vector shapes for a believable finished editorial poster.

[6. MOOD]
Modern editorial infographic — sharp newsroom data-visualization feel, like a premium comparison spread from The Economist graphics, Information is Beautiful, or a Korean business magazine data brief.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표기할 한국어 문자열: {비교 대상}, {비교 항목}, {차트}, {인사이트}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {비율}.
- Include realistic Korean microcopy rendered in the image, such as “비교 분석 리포트”, “핵심 지표”, “데이터 업데이트 2026.05”, “자료 기준”, “편집부 리서치”, “p.03”.
- All charts must remain perfectly readable and aligned; both comparison sides should use the same structure, scale logic, and spacing.
- The composition must clearly communicate “comparison” at a glance with a centered VS logic and symmetrical framing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Cropped or misaligned text blocks

Korean annual statistics infographic poster for sales summary, growth rate, and market performance. Designed as a realistic vertical annual report page that can be shared on social media, inserted into an internal deck, or printed as a one-page executive summary.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical editorial report layout with a strong top-to-bottom hierarchy: a branded report header and date metadata at the very top, the large headline number in the upper hero zone, the main chart dashboard in the center, and the insight / action summary anchored near the bottom.
- Background treatment: premium off-white report paper with very subtle fiber grain, faint spreadsheet grid cues, light page shadow, and small registration/crop details to make it feel like a real printed business infographic.
- Add realistic report-page details: issue label “ANNUAL REPORT 2026”, section tag “SALES PERFORMANCE”, page number “P.08”, source note “Source: 내부 매출 데이터 · 2025.01–2025.12”, and a small QR-style data access block labeled “DATA ROOM”.
- Use {주제}, {주요 수치}, {차트}, {인사이트}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {비율} placeholders exactly as configurable content.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top report header: place a compact masthead row with “2026 BUSINESS REVIEW”, “VOL.12”, “2026년 1월 발행”, and a small department credit “전략기획팀 리포트”. Include thin colored rules and tiny metadata text for realism.
- Top hero section: display {주제} as the main Korean business headline and {주요 수치} as the largest typographic element. Add supporting KPI chips around it: “전년 +28%”, “목표 달성률 112%”, “고객 재구매율 41%”, and “분기 평균 성장률 6.8%”.
- Middle chart dashboard: place {차트} as the central analytical visual inside layered report cards. Include a quarterly line chart labeled Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4; a donut chart for channel mix labeled “온라인 54% / 오프라인 31% / 파트너 15%”; a vertical bar comparison for “2024 vs 2025”; and a lime green upward growth arrow with percentage callout.
- Supporting context area: add compact legends, axis labels, tick marks, data point labels, a tiny table row with “매출 / 전년비 / 목표비 / 기여도”, and short photo-free business annotations such as “Q3 신상 출시”, “Q4 시즌 세일”, “리텐션 캠페인”.
- Bottom insight band: render {인사이트} in a highlighted executive insight strip with a title “핵심 인사이트”, a numbered 3-point summary, and a small CTA label “다음 액션: 고성과 채널 예산 확대”.
- Footer: include address/contact-style corporate footer text “서울시 강남구 테헤란로 00 · revenue-team@company.co.kr”, a small page marker “08 / 24”, and a barcode-like reference area “AR-2026-12-SALES”. Overall layout direction should match {비주얼}: large number on top, chart in center, insight at bottom, with a polished business-report rhythm.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR mix; headline in ExtraBold 72–92px, supporting labels in Medium 22–28px, annotations in Regular 18–20px, micro metadata in 11–14px, with tight but readable line spacing.
- Color palette: use {컬러} as a strict palette direction, with white #FFFFFF, charcoal #222222, lime green #A6E22E for key growth accents, warm off-white #F7F6F1 for paper, and light gray #E9E9E9 for dividers, table lines, and chart axes.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft shadow 0px 8px 24px at 12% opacity on chart cards, fine 1px divider lines, realistic report-card layering, restrained corner radius, and crisp vector-like chart edges.
- Add content-rich business details without changing the core subject: legends, axis numbers, annotations, footer source notes, page codes, KPI badges, and small report metadata should support the annual sales and growth-rate story.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean graphic design layout with top-down editorial poster presentation; 50mm equivalent neutrality, orthographic-feeling composition, and true vertical 1024x1536 report-page framing.
- Lighting: even studio-style illumination with a slight soft ambient falloff near the edges, gentle paper shadow, and enough dimensionality for the cards and layered report elements to feel tangible.
- Color grade: neutral white + charcoal + lime green business palette, with restrained contrast, precise data-viz clarity, and subtle premium print texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium corporate annual report infographic — Apple Keynote-style presentation meets Financial Times data visualization clarity, with the realism of a finished executive summary page ready for quarterly board review.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보일 문구 — “연간 매출 결산”, “연 매출 12억”, “전년 +28%”, “Q3 신상 출시 효과 + Q4 시즌 세일”.
- Additional Korean report text should be legible and contextually correct: “2026년 1월 발행”, “핵심 인사이트”, “목표 달성률 112%”, “온라인 54%”, “오프라인 31%”, “파트너 15%”, “다음 액션: 고성과 채널 예산 확대”.
- All numeric figures must remain sharp, legible, and aligned with the chart hierarchy.
- Do not distort Korean characters; preserve clean baseline alignment and consistent spacing across headings, labels, tables, chart legends, and insight text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a 4-panel collage of platform ad mockups for {광고 4종}, with the store identity {매장} tied consistently across all panels.
- Layout: editorial 2x2 grid with four distinct ad formats: Facebook feed ad, Instagram square post, Instagram Story ad, and blog header banner. Each panel should feel like a real deliverable from a campaign presentation, with active UI cues, campaign labels, and supporting copy.
- Background treatment: white presentation base with charcoal framing accents, soft paper texture, realistic card shadows, faint alignment marks, and subtle brand swatches using {컬러}.
- Composition details: include small campaign notes, platform labels, handle text, engagement micro-icons, CTA buttons, and readable Korean promotional snippets around {키 메시지} without changing the core 4-panel arrangement.
- Use {매장}, {광고 4종}, {키 메시지}, {비주얼}, {컬러}, {타이포}, {비율} placeholders throughout the design.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Overall canvas: build a professional advertising showcase sheet in a 4-cut collage layout, with all four mockups aligned neatly and visually unified as a real agency presentation board.
2. Panel 1: render the Facebook ad mockup as a rectangular feed-style ad using the store colors from {컬러}. Include a profile row with circular store avatar, store name {매장}, small label "Sponsored", headline {키 메시지}, short body copy such as "오늘의 추천 메뉴와 혜택을 만나보세요", a compact CTA button "자세히 보기", reaction/comment/share row, and a small promo badge "이번 주 이벤트".
3. Panel 2: render the Instagram ad mockup as a square social post with tighter image framing. Include handle "@{매장}", save/share/heart/comment micro icons, a bold Korean headline using {키 메시지}, caption text "매장에서 직접 만나는 특별한 순간", hashtags such as "#{매장} #동네매장 #신상소식", and a small carousel dot indicator.
4. Panel 3: render the Instagram Story mockup as a tall vertical ad with native story details: top progress bars, profile icon, "{매장} · 광고", bold vertical hierarchy, sticker-style CTA "지금 확인", swipe cue "위로 밀어보기", poll sticker text "오늘 방문할까요? 예 / 곧 갈게요", and a date label "2026.05 캠페인".
5. Panel 4: render the blog header mockup as a wide banner-style format with the key message {키 메시지} centered or slightly left-weighted for header use. Add blog navigation details such as "HOME · EVENT · REVIEW · MAP", category tag "매장 소식", a search field, a small address/contact line "서울 ○○구 매장거리 12 · 02-000-0000", and a footer strip reading "운영시간 11:00–21:00".
6. Unifying treatment: keep all four mockups stylistically related through matching palette, typography language, repeated logo/avatar treatment, and the same store identity {매장}, while still reflecting each platform’s native format and {비율}.
7. Visual emphasis: make {비주얼} read as a polished mockup collage rather than a literal screenshot, with crisp card edges, realistic printed/poster-card surface, layered shadows, platform UI details, small annotation labels, and presentation-grade alignment.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for platform UI text, with bold 700–800 weights for headlines and medium 500 weights for supporting copy; apply {타이포} as the campaign typography direction and keep Korean characters sharp and legible.
- Color palette: apply {컬러} as the main brand palette, anchored by white #FFFFFF and charcoal #2B2B2B; add practical accent blocks, CTA buttons, tiny highlight stickers, and platform-label chips using the same palette.
- Border/shadow: add soft drop shadows with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity for each mockup card; use thin separators, UI dividers, rounded cards, and subtle paper grain to make the composite feel tactile and production-ready.
- Content density: include realistic ad components such as profile handles, comment counts, captions, hashtags, story stickers, blog navigation, schedule/contact lines, campaign date labels, and CTA buttons while keeping hierarchy clear.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product-style presentation, shot like a precise flat-lay editorial layout with a 50mm standard lens look and no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from the right to preserve crisp edges and readable text.
- Color grade: clean commercial grade with white, charcoal, and store-brand accents from {컬러}; keep the overall tone crisp, modern, high-clarity, and suitable for a real marketing portfolio.

[6. MOOD]
A polished boutique marketing deck — refined agency presentation sheet with realistic SNS campaign details, lively local-store promotion energy, and a finished client-preview feel.

[7. CRITICAL]

- 중단 메인 영역은 좌측에 {비주얼}의 실제 매장 사진을 크게 배치하고, 우측에는 월 매출·순수익 막대 차트, 상담 예약 QR 박스, 가맹 절차 타임라인을 함께 구성.
- 하단 정보 영역은 {수익 정보}, {지원}, {초기 비용}을 카드형 박스로 나누고, 각 카드에는 라벨, 숫자, 작은 주석, 체크 아이콘을 넣어 창업 안내서처럼 읽히게 구성.
- 최하단에는 {상담일정}, {장소}, {문의}, {참가정보}, {주최}를 포함한 설명회·상담 예약 영역을 넣고, 전화번호, 웹사이트, QR 자리, 안내 문구가 실제 광고처럼 보이게 배치.
- 배경은 화이트 계열의 프리미엄 비즈니스 포스터 배경에 차콜 텍스트, 시그니처 포인트 컬러, 연한 베이지 패턴, 얇은 구분선, 작은 캘린더·지도핀·체크 아이콘을 사용해 신뢰감 있는 창업 광고 분위기를 만들기.
- 모든 핵심 텍스트는 {프랜차이즈}, {수익 정보}, {지원}, {초기 비용}, {상담일정}, {장소}, {문의}, {참가정보}, {주최}, {컬러} placeholders로 치환 가능하도록 설계.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. 상단 타이틀 영역: “프랜차이즈 가맹 모집”을 가장 크게 배치하고, 그 아래에 {프랜차이즈} 브랜드명과 “예비 점주를 위한 창업 상담 프로그램” 서브카피를 넣어 브랜드 정체성과 목적을 고정.
2. 모집 배지 영역: 타이틀 옆 또는 상단 우측에 “VOL. 2026-05”, “신규 가맹 상담”, “오픈 지원 패키지” 같은 작은 태그를 배치해 실제 배포용 포스터 느낌을 강화.
3. 메인 비주얼 영역: {비주얼}을 중심으로 따뜻한 조명이 켜진 매장 외관 또는 카운터 사진을 크게 두고, 사진 위에는 작은 캡션 “실제 매장 운영 예시 이미지”를 넣어 현실적인 정보 광고처럼 표현.
4. 수익 정보 카드: {수익 정보}를 굵은 숫자 중심의 박스로 표현하고, 월 매출과 순수익은 서로 다른 강조색으로 구분. 작은 막대 그래프와 “상권·운영 방식에 따라 변동 가능” 같은 주석 텍스트를 하단에 추가.
5. 지원 혜택 박스: {지원}을 체크리스트 스타일로 정리해 인테리어, 마케팅, 교육, 운영 매뉴얼, 오픈 초기 프로모션이 각각 독립된 항목처럼 읽히게 배열.
6. 초기 비용 박스: {초기 비용}을 하단 또는 우측 하단에 배치하고, 금액 요소는 작은 라벨과 큰 숫자 조합으로 금융 리포트처럼 정돈. “상담 후 견적 확정” 같은 현실적 보조 문구를 함께 배치.
7. 절차 안내 박스: “01 상담 신청 → 02 상권 분석 → 03 계약 협의 → 04 오픈 교육 → 05 매장 오픈”의 5단계 흐름을 번호형 타임라인으로 연결하고, 각 단계에 작은 아이콘을 넣기.
8. 설명회 정보 영역: {상담일정}, {장소}, {참가정보}를 캘린더·지도핀·티켓 라벨과 함께 보여주고, {문의}는 전화/카카오/웹사이트 형식으로 현실적인 상담 CTA를 구성.
9. 스폰서·주최 영역: 최하단 작은 바에 {주최}, “창업지원센터 협력”, “운영 교육 파트너” 같은 협력사 텍스트와 로고 자리 2–3개를 넣어 행사 포스터의 신뢰도를 높이기.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR mix, title 800 weight 56–68px, section labels 600 weight 20–24px, body text 400–500 weight 16–20px. 숫자는 굵고 단단한 산세리프로 처리.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, charcoal #1F1F1F, warm gray #E9E9E9, soft beige #F6F1E8, signature accent #D9A441 or brand accent derived from {컬러}.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal or warm gray rules, cards with 8–12px corner radius, soft drop shadow 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08).
- Layout accents: subtle dividers, grid alignment, small calendar/map/check icons, fine dotted background texture, semi-transparent chart lines, QR-code placeholder box, sponsor logo strip; use {컬러} as the consistent branding cue.
- Poster realism: include print-like details such as small footer text, contact block, consultation QR area, issue-like label “FRANCHISE GUIDE 2026”, and realistic disclaimer-style microcopy without making the design feel like a legal document.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with RF 35mm full-frame commercial poster framing for the overall layout, with a secondary 50mm product-style crop for the store photo in {비주얼}.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light, slightly from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, no harsh specular highlights; the store image should feel evenly lit, warm, and trustworthy.
- Color grade: clean white + charcoal base with muted warm beige highlights and a restrained gold accent, editorial corporate brochure tone.
- Texture detail: crisp printed-poster finish, subtle paper grain, realistic photo inset edges, fine shadows under cards, sharp legible typography, tactile business brochure quality.

[6. MOOD]
Professional franchise recruitment poster — polished corporate brochure aesthetic with a premium retail-investment presentation feel, like a modern business seminar handout displayed in a startup fair booth.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “프랜차이즈 가맹 모집”, “2026 상반기 신규 가맹점 모집”, “예비 점주 창업 설명회”, {프랜차이즈}, {수익 정보}, {지원}, {초기 비용}, {상담일정}, {장소}, {문의}, {참가정보}, {주최}
- Poster must include realistic rendered Korean details: “상담 예약”, “가맹 절차”, “수익 예시”, “지원 혜택”, “초기 비용”, “참가비 무료”, “사전 예약 필수”, “QR로 상담 신청”.
- All Korean characters must render clearly without garbling, spacing errors, or broken syllables.
- Numbers in the revenue and cost sections must remain legible and aligned; charts, badges, QR box, sponsor strip, and information cards should not overlap the text.
- Composition should preserve a poster-like vertical hierarchy with headline, brand, store photo, metrics, support, cost, seminar schedule, and contact sections clearly separated.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness
- Human figure distortion or surreal business imagery

studio:prompts3:ours-684.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean social-media review card news layout for a store, combining a realistic customer photo collage, rating highlight, short review quotes, and carousel-style editorial UI details. Vertical premium cafe review summary that feels like a saved Instagram card news page with authentic visit photos, textured paper, and trustworthy review snippets.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main review collage so it occupies about 58% of the frame height, with the store name header at the top 14%, the rating block in the upper-right, and a compact card-news footer at the bottom.
- Use {매장} as the main identity text, supported by a small date label, slide number, and editorial category tag such as "REVIEW NOTE" and "방문 후기 모음".
- Apply {컬러} as the dominant palette direction while retaining cream paper, charcoal text blocks, muted gold accent rules, warm gray UI labels, and off-white quote cards.
- Use {비율} to guide the vertical social card ratio and ensure all content feels designed for a 1024x1536 card-news post.
- Use {후기 5} as the visible quote content, and {별점} as the numerical trust signal in a prominent badge paired with star icons and review-count styling.
- Make {비주얼} the structural guide for the overall collage-and-review arrangement, including realistic cafe tables, drinks, dessert plates, receipts, menu details, hands, storefront glimpses, and natural customer snapshot textures.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: place {매장} in a large serif masthead style, centered or slightly left-aligned, with a thin muted-gold divider rule beneath it. Add small supporting text around the masthead: "VOL.05", "2026.05 REVIEW", "방문 후기 모아보기", and a tiny handle line such as "@today_review.kr".
2. Rating emphasis zone: position {별점} in the upper-right inside a cream translucent panel with a charcoal outline, five small gold star icons, and a tiny label "평점 요약". Add micro text such as "실방문 코멘트 기준" beneath the badge.
3. Main collage area: build a 2x2 or 3-panel customer photo collage across the center, with rounded corners, thin white gutters, soft drop shadows, and realistic tile content: latte art close-up, pastry on ceramic plate, store interior counter, handwritten receipt, menu board fragment, and a hand placing a cup on a wood tabletop.
4. Quote chips: insert the five short phrases from {후기 5} as small quote boxes around the collage edges, each with quotation marks, reviewer initials such as "고객 A", small visit dates such as "05.12 방문", and compact star mini-icons. Keep all five quotes readable and visually connected to the collage.
5. Supporting visual labels: integrate {비주얼} as the composition cue for how images, rating, review chips, and micro labels cluster in an editorial rhythm. Include small decorative tags such as "BEST", "재방문 의사", "추천 메뉴", and "분위기 체크" where appropriate.
6. Footer strip: create a narrow bottom card-news area using {타이포}, with page indicator "01 / 05", save/share micro icons, a small CTA "저장하고 방문하기", and a fine-print line "customer review digest · cafe editorial card".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the main Korean title in bold semi-condensed weight, and Pretendard for supporting labels in medium weight; English subtitle in a refined small-caps sans style. Apply {타이포} consistently to subtitle, CTA, date, and micro UI text.
- Color palette: cream #F6F0E6, charcoal #2E2A27, muted gold #C8A45D, warm gray #B9B2A8, off-white #FBF8F2, with {컬러} influencing accent intensity and image grading.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal rules, soft drop shadow 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.10) on collage tiles, slight embossed feel on rating badge, subtle paper grain on the background, and realistic photo-paper edges on customer images.
- Graphic details: add thin gold dividers, small corner numbers, tiny carousel dots, sticker-like review tags, and editorial caption lines while keeping the hierarchy clear and premium.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial lifestyle photo look, 35mm full-frame lens at f/2.8 for the collage images, with a clean top-down or slight angle presentation.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill on the right and no harsh highlights; subtle reflected light for tabletop surfaces.
- Color grade: warm cream, cocoa, and muted gold with low saturation, balanced contrast, and a clean magazine-print finish.
- Realism: collage photos should show believable customer-shot details such as shallow depth of field, natural crumbs, cup condensation, ceramic texture, wood grain, receipt paper, soft reflections on glass, and slight perspective differences between tiles.

[6. MOOD]
Premium cafe review editorial — Kinfolk-inspired social card with a polished customer-storyboard feel, enriched by authentic visit-photo evidence, warm service atmosphere, and trustworthy card-news information density.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "오늘카페" must appear exactly if used from {매장}; all visible Korean quote text from {후기 5} must be rendered verbatim and legible; "평균 4.8 / 후기 132개" must appear exactly if used from {별점}.
- Add legible Korean micro text: "방문 후기 모아보기", "평점 요약", "실방문 코멘트 기준", "저장하고 방문하기", "추천 메뉴", "재방문 의사", and page indicator "01 / 05".
- All customer photo tiles should look like realistic stacked review images with clean rectangular framing, consistent spacing, natural shadows, and believable cafe content rather than floating cutouts.
- Typography hierarchy must remain: store name largest, rating second, quotes smaller, subtitle and UI micro text smallest.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness
