[1. PURPOSE]
Kiosk self-order UI mockup poster for a food service venue, vertical mobile-friendly presentation.
Realistic commercial UI showcase with a full kiosk ordering screen, menu pricing, cart summary, pickup guidance, and payment-ready flow for {매장명}.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center a tall kiosk touchscreen as the hero element, occupying about 70% of the frame height, set inside a realistic black or charcoal kiosk frame with tempered-glass reflections and a sturdy pedestal base.
- Background should show a softly blurred {매장유형} interior with counter lights, menu boards, trays, packaging, and warm service-area details, while keeping the kiosk screen clearly readable.
- Place {매장명} and {지점정보} in the kiosk header, small receipt preview, or background signage so the mockup feels like an actual in-store ordering machine.
- Build a dense but readable menu screen using {메뉴구성}: product photos, Korean item names, prices, option badges, spicy/popular/new tags, and + buttons on each card.
- Include an active order state: selected items in {장바구니내용}, quantity steppers, subtotal, discount line, total amount, and a large 결제하기 button.
- Add real kiosk details such as language selector, order type toggle, pickup number area, card/NFC/QR payment icons, receipt option, allergy info link, and staff-call button.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone: show {매장명}, store category label for {매장유형}, current date/time, order type buttons "매장 식사" and "포장", plus language controls "한국어 · English · 日本語 · 中文".
- Promotion strip: add {프로모션문구} as a bright horizontal banner with small food illustration stickers, coupon tag, or limited-time badge.
- Category navigation zone: include {UI디테일} as functional category tabs such as 추천, 세트, 단품, 사이드, 음료, 디저트, plus a compact search field.
- Main menu grid zone: display {메뉴구성} as 8–12 product tiles with appetizing thumbnail photos, item names, prices in 원, nutrition or spicy labels, sold-out/new/popular chips, and clear + buttons.
- Cart zone: position {장바구니내용} as a fixed summary panel on the lower third or right side of the kiosk UI, with selected items, option notes, quantity controls, subtotal, 쿠폰 적용, 총 결제금액, and payment CTA.
- Store information zone: include {지점정보}, business hours, pickup counter note, customer service phone, and a small receipt-style order preview near the bottom of the interface.
- Color system: apply {브랜드컬러} across active tabs, CTA buttons, price highlights, badges, dividers, and status chips so the kiosk reads as a cohesive franchise interface.
- Format zone: keep the full composition in a tall 1024x1536 poster layout, optimized for vertical product mockup presentation and kiosk-screen readability.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the interface, with bold 700 weights for prices, order totals, and CTA buttons; medium 500 for item names; 12–22px UI hierarchy depending on distance.
- Color palette: use {브랜드컬러} with white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, warm light gray #F2F2F2, and a high-contrast accent color for active buttons, price highlights, and category states.
- UI components: use rounded 18px menu cards, 1px light-gray dividers, pill-shaped category tabs, soft status badges, visible touch targets, and a soft drop shadow of 0px 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12) for the kiosk frame.
- Content density: make the interface feel like a real operating kiosk with menu information, notices, prices, icons, receipt lines, and payment instructions arranged in a polished hierarchy.
- Product imagery: show realistic food thumbnails with slight overhead angles, glossy packaging, paper tray liners, drink cups, sauces, and side dishes matching {매장유형}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm standard lens look, front-facing product capture with slight perspective correction, like a premium UI presentation mockup.
- Lighting: soft studio lighting from upper-left with gentle fill from the right, controlled screen glare, crisp UI readability, and subtle reflections on the kiosk glass.
- Color grade: clean white + brand accent + charcoal with restrained saturation, matching a polished fast-food kiosk interface aesthetic.
- Material realism: matte metal kiosk body, faint fingerprints on glass edge, illuminated screen surface, plastic card reader module, QR scanner window, and receipt slot detail.

[6. MOOD]
Commercial fast-food kiosk presentation — McDonald's and Lotteria-style self-order UI reference with a polished franchise system feel, lively in-store realism, appetizing menu photography, and dependable checkout flow.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: include readable Korean UI strings such as "버거온 키오스크", "매장 식사", "포장", "추천 메뉴", "세트", "단품", "사이드", "음료", "장바구니", "쿠폰 적용", "총 결제금액", "결제하기", "주문번호 247", "영수증 출력".
- Example menu text may include "시그니처 불고기버거 ₩6,900", "더블치즈 세트 ₩9,800", "감자튀김 R ₩2,500", "제로콜라 ₩2,000", "치킨텐더 4조각 ₩4,200".
- Store info text may include "강남역 2호점", "서울 강남구 테헤란로 24", "영업시간 10:00–22:00", "문의 02-1234-5678".
- Maintain a realistic kiosk UI layout with clear hierarchy, legible buttons, balanced menu/cart separation, and no accidental overlapping labels.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness mashups

studio:prompts3:ours-585.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean digital signage menu display for a cafe or food shop, designed as a large horizontal LCD menu board for in-store use.
Realistic retail signage layout with appetizing menu photos, names, prices, recommendation markers, store information, category labels, and practical ordering details, optimized for fast readability from a distance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main display uses a wide LCD-like composition with {매장 종류} as the overall store context, framed like a mounted digital menu board in a real shop counter area.
- Left zone (about 28%): create a store identity and ordering-info panel with a logo-like brand block, store name, short Korean tagline, operating hours, address/contact line, and today’s recommended menu.
- Right zone (about 72%): arrange {메뉴 구성} in a structured grid or signage-style auto-sliding menu-card layout with clear category grouping and readable prices.
- Background treatment: dark charcoal digital screen surface with subtle matte LCD texture, soft reflections along the bezel, crisp edge contrast, and slight luminous UI glow.
- Add realistic menu-board details such as small category tabs, numbered item tags, “BEST”, “NEW”, “추천” badges, temperature icons like HOT / ICE, set-upgrade notice, takeout note, and decorative divider lines that support readability.
- The screen should feel like an actual commercial menu system installed in a cafe or food shop, with polished retail UI density rather than a flat poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top/left header area: place the store identity block in the left zone, with a compact logo-like placeholder area, a clean separator line, and Korean store text such as “오늘의 메뉴”, “주문은 카운터에서”, “영업시간 08:00–22:00”.
2. Store info band: include small practical lines like “서울시 중구 남대문로 24”, “02-1234-5678”, “TAKE OUT 가능”, and a tiny QR/order icon area rendered as graphic UI detail, not as an official certification.
3. Main menu field: render {메뉴 구성} as 6–8 items with each tile showing an appetizing food or drink photo, Korean menu name, price, short one-line description, and a small recommendation badge when needed.
4. Menu examples to visually populate the board: “아메리카노 ₩4,500”, “바닐라 라떼 ₩5,800”, “제주 말차 라떼 ₩6,200”, “딸기 크림 프라페 ₩6,800”, “치즈 베이글 ₩4,900”, “허니 브레드 ₩7,500”, using the requested {메뉴 구성} as the primary content direction.
5. Grid logic: align items in a balanced multi-column grid or signage-style auto-slide frame, making prices easy to scan instantly; include category headers such as “COFFEE”, “NON-COFFEE”, “DESSERT”, and “SET MENU”.
6. Text hierarchy: keep the menu name larger than supporting text, make the price the most visually prominent numeric element, and use short Korean microcopy like “부드러운 우유폼”, “시그니처 블렌드”, “오늘만 추천”.
7. Footer ticker: add a slim lower information strip with Korean notices such as “샷 추가 +₩700 · 디카페인 변경 +₩500 · 텀블러 할인 ₩300 · 원산지 표기는 카운터에서 확인”.
8. Surface behavior: use a realistic LCD signage look with sharp UI edges, subtle screen glow, laminated glass reflections, and commercial UI depth.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for headers, Noto Sans KR Bold for menu names, Pretendard SemiBold for prices; header 48–60px feel, item text 26–34px feel, prices 40–54px feel.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with concrete implementation such as charcoal #1E1E22, amber #D89A3A, off-white #F5F1E8, and muted gray #A6A6A6.
- Border/shadow: thin divider lines in 15% opacity white, soft screen glow, subtle shadow under menu tiles (0 6px 18px 12% opacity), and amber accent rules to mimic commercial LCD UI depth.
- Menu photography: food and beverage images should look realistic and appetizing, with ceramic cups, ice cubes, foam texture, pastry crumb texture, garnish, and natural highlights inside the menu tiles.
- Layout expression: follow {레이아웃} and {비율}; use {타이포} as the typographic mood while preserving strong distance readability.
- Include small retail details: category chips, item numbers, price alignment guides, promo ribbon “오늘의 추천”, allergen-style tiny icons, and a clean bottom service notice band.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing product mockup look, equivalent to a 50mm lens at f/8 on a studio setup, perfectly square-on to the screen with minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: even studio softbox lighting from upper-left with a mild fill from the right, controlled highlight on screen edges, realistic LCD glass sheen, and subtle bezel reflection.
- Color grade: dark charcoal base with warm amber accents and clean white text, keeping a polished signage-system tone.
- Screen realism: include thin black LCD bezel, faint mounting shadow behind the display, crisp pixel-like UI sharpness, and slight glow around bright text and menu photos.

[6. MOOD]
Premium in-store digital menu signage — Starbucks / Ediya LCD board aesthetic with a clean retail UI finish, warm appetizing menu imagery, and practical Korean shop information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함
  - 디지털 사이니지 메뉴 디스플레이
  - {매장 종류}
  - {메뉴 구성}
  - {레이아웃}
  - {컬러 톤}
  - {타이포}
  - {비율}

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Webnovel social media ad for Instagram/Facebook, designed as a square performance banner with strong click-through hierarchy.
Romance-webtoon-style promotional creative with platform-ad polish, combining cover art, character hero, readable Korean promo copy, social-feed UI details, and compact social proof elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square canvas with the main character hero centered and occupying about 45–55% of the frame, the cover art slightly behind or to one side as a supporting layer.
- Top and upper-mid areas should hold the title and hook copy; include a small sponsored label, account handle, and native SNS-style header so it feels like a real Instagram/Facebook ad post.
- Background should be a polished platform-ad gradient or soft textured wash that matches {컬러 톤}, enriched with subtle romance bokeh, faint app-card layering, soft light streaks, and tasteful decorative sparkles that support the genre.
- Add realistic feed elements: tiny like/comment/share/save icons, carousel dots, a CTA button, hashtag-style caption text, and a compact engagement strip without overpowering the hero.
- Keep the layout compact, ad-like, and instantly readable at mobile size, using {작품·장르}, {카피}, {비주얼}, {플랫폼 정보}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} as the content pillars.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: build a smooth, high-contrast ad backdrop in the tone of {컬러 톤}, using a subtle vignette, paper-like soft texture, romance bokeh, faint glow accents, and lightly blurred story-card shapes that make the center subject pop.
2. SNS header layer: at the top, place a small profile circle, handle text such as "@romance_daily", a tiny "광고" or "Sponsored" label, and a three-dot menu icon to make the creative look native to Instagram/Facebook.
3. Main hero zone: place the character hero from {비주얼} as the dominant focal point, separated from the background with a soft realistic shadow, crisp edge definition, glossy hair highlights, and believable portrait depth.
4. Cover-support layer: integrate the {작품·장르} cover art behind or beside the hero in a controlled scale, including a visible book-cover/card edge, small title cue, and tiny volume label such as "VOL.01" or "NEW" so it reads as a webnovel cover asset.
5. Copy zone: set {카피} in a bold, mobile-readable promo layout with strong hierarchy; add short supporting Korean blurbs such as "무료 5회차 오픈", "매주 월·목 업데이트", and a small CTA button reading "지금 읽기".
6. Platform info zone: place {플랫폼 정보} as a compact trust/info strip, using rounded chips, a thin banner treatment, or app-store-style label that looks native to SNS ad creative.
7. Social proof zone: add tiny star rating, view-count, save-count, and comment-count style elements from {비주얼}; examples include "★ 4.9", "조회 128만", "저장 12.4만", "댓글 1,284" aligned neatly near the lower section.
8. Feed interaction layer: include small like/comment/share/save micro icons, carousel dots, and hashtag-like caption text such as "#로맨스웹소설 #무료회차 #운명로맨스" near the bottom for a realistic social ad finish.
9. Final balance: keep all elements aligned to a tight grid, with the hero, title, cover cue, CTA, and platform info visually linked so the ad feels polished, modern, and conversion-focused.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main hook, with Pretendard SemiBold/Medium for support text; title size should be large enough to read on mobile at 1024px, while badges, handle text, hashtags, and UI labels stay compact and crisp.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 톤} exactly; for romance use pink + gold accents, with off-white or soft cream text panels and restrained dark contrast for legibility.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and about 15% opacity for the hero and card elements; use rounded rectangles, translucent glass chips, delicate highlight strokes, and soft glow accents for info chips and CTA.
- Graphic details: add believable SNS advertising details such as a small profile avatar, "광고" label, carousel dots, CTA button, micro icons, engagement counts, and short hashtag caption text, all kept secondary to the hero and hook.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: use a 85mm f/1.4 portrait look for the character hero and cover integration, with shallow depth-of-field separation and ad-ready clarity.
- Lighting: soft studio key from upper-left at roughly 45° plus a gentle fill from the right, creating clean facial modeling, catchlights in the eyes, glossy promotional finish, and believable shadows on layered UI cards.
- Color grade: romance-ad grade with pink highlights, warm gold accents, and slightly softened contrast; keep skin tones natural and avoid plastic smoothing.
- Rendering quality: polished digital illustration blended with realistic SNS ad compositing, crisp Korean typography, high-resolution cover-card edges, soft bokeh, and clean mobile-feed readability.

[6. MOOD]
KakaoPage / Naver Series-style romance webnovel ad — polished mobile promotional creative with a fast-scanning, platform-native commercial feel, like a real sponsored Instagram/Facebook square post for a trending romance webnovel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함.
  - "우연이 운명이 되어"
  - "한 번 보면 못 멈춤 — 무료 5회차"
  - "카카오페이지 / 무료 5회차 / 매주 월·목 업데이트"
- Also include small realistic SNS ad text elements in Korean, such as "광고", "지금 읽기", "조회 128만", "저장 12.4만", "댓글 1,284", "#로맨스웹소설 #무료회차".
- Maintain a square ad composition with a clear hero, visible cover cue, CTA button, small star rating, view-count details, feed interaction icons, and no broken Korean characters.
- Keep the visual tone aligned with webnovel platform advertising; the copy must feel concise, clickable, and conversion-oriented.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean webtoon character sticker pack, a square 4x4 grid of 16 expression stickers for messaging apps, fandom goods, and social sharing.
Realistic printable sticker-sheet presentation with die-cut character poses, bold outline, readable Korean emotion labels, backing-paper texture, collectible app-asset packaging details, product header, barcode, creator credit, and small stationery-store information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 캔버스는 정사각형 1024x1024 비율이며, {비율}을 유지한 4x4 그리드가 화면 중심을 크게 차지하고, 상단에는 실제 판매용 굿즈처럼 보이는 스티커팩 헤더 바를 포함한다.
- 각 칸에는 {캐릭터}가 단독 주인공으로 배치되고, {캐릭터 의상}과 동일한 얼굴 비례, 헤어스타일, 컬러 포인트를 유지한다. 표정과 자세는 {16 표정·자세}를 반영하되 16칸 모두 서로 다른 감정이 즉시 구분되게 한다.
- 배경은 따뜻한 크림 톤 스티커 백킹지로 처리하고, 미세한 종이 섬유 질감, 반투명 칼선, 둥근 사각 패널 구획선, 작은 등록 마크, 인쇄 잉크의 아주 약한 번짐을 더해 실제 인쇄된 스티커팩 느낌을 만든다.
- 모든 스티커는 동일한 캐릭터 디자인 언어를 유지하며, {레이아웃}에 맞춰 시선 높이, 캐릭터 크기, 라벨 위치, 다이컷 여백을 통일한다.
- 상단 헤더에는 Korean text: "{팩 제목}", "오늘의 자취", "VOL.16", "{발행일}", "메시지용", "CUT LINE GUIDE"를 제품 정보처럼 넣고, 작은 spine credit 형태로 "그림 {작가명}"을 세로 또는 얇은 캡션으로 배치한다.
- 우측 하단에는 실제 상품 패키지처럼 바코드 영역, 상품 코드 "{상품 코드}", 가격 "{가격}", 스토어명 "{스토어명}", 짧은 사용 안내 "채팅에 붙여 쓰는 16종 감정표현"을 배치한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1행 1열~4열: {캐릭터}의 기본 감정 4종을 상반신 또는 머리 중심으로 크게 보여준다. 패널 라벨은 순서대로 "기쁨", "슬픔", "놀람", "화남"이며, 기쁨에는 반짝이, 슬픔에는 눈물 방울, 놀람에는 작은 말풍선 "헉", 화남에는 붉은 분노 마크를 넣는다.
- 2행 1열~4열: 일상 감정과 대화용 리액션을 강조한다. 패널 라벨은 "졸림", "배고픔", "사랑", "응원"이며, 졸림에는 "쿨쿨" 수면 글자, 배고픔에는 작은 그릇이나 김이 나는 음식 아이콘, 사랑에는 하트, 응원에는 파이팅 손동작과 "파이팅" 텍스트를 넣는다.
- 3행 1열~4열: 과장된 웹툰 리액션을 중심으로 구성한다. 패널 라벨은 "격노", "멍", "윙크", "하트"이며, 격노에는 불꽃과 굵은 눈썹, 멍에는 동그란 눈과 정적선, 윙크에는 별표, 하트에는 양손 하트 또는 큰 하트 오브젝트를 넣는다.
- 4행 1열~4열: 감정 세트의 마무리 리액션을 넣어 16종 구성이 완결되어 보이게 한다. 패널 라벨은 "눈물", "폭소", "절망", "잠"이며, 눈물에는 큰 눈물줄기, 폭소에는 흔들림 선과 "히히", 절망에는 회색 구름, 잠에는 베개와 작은 달 아이콘을 넣는다.
- 각 스티커는 크림색 백킹지 위에서 분리되어 보이고, 캐릭터 주변에는 흰색 다이컷 여백, 미세한 커팅 라인, {시그니처 소품}을 감정별로 작게 변주해 메시지용 스티커다운 풍부함을 만든다.
- 그리드 바깥 여백에는 작은 인쇄 요소로 "2026 SPRING", "SHEET 01/01", "16 STICKERS", "APP ASSET PACK", "Made for chat" 같은 패키지 마이크로카피를 넣어 실제 굿즈 시트처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 본 이미지는 웹툰 스티커 시트이므로 헤더와 감정 라벨을 실제 굿즈 패키지처럼 구성한다. Korean label text uses Pretendard SemiBold 24~28px for panel labels, Pretendard Bold 34~42px for the title "{팩 제목}", and tiny condensed sans-serif for product code, date, price, barcode captions, creator credit, and sheet serial text.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기준으로 크림 #F4EEDF, 차콜 #2B2B2B, 캐릭터 시그니처 컬러를 보조색으로 사용해 통일감 있게 묶는다. 패널 라벨 배경에는 옅은 파스텔 옐로, 민트, 핑크, 라벤더를 소량 섞어 감정별 구분을 준다.
- Border/shadow: {외곽선}에 맞춘 검정 굵은 외곽선 6~10px, 흰색 다이컷 테두리 10~16px, 소프트 셰도우 2px y-offset / 6px blur / 12% opacity로 스티커 컷아웃이 실제 백킹지 위에 붙어 있는 느낌을 만든다.
- Graphic details: rounded grid cells, tiny crop marks, die-cut guide dots, sheet serial text "2026 SPRING", small price-like label "{가격}", barcode block, app-pack code, creator credit, and tiny decorative sparkles may appear as natural stationery packaging details.
- Label hierarchy: 감정 라벨은 각 패널 하단에 동일한 위치로 두고, 효과음은 캐릭터의 표정을 보강하는 위치에 배치한다. 헤더 정보와 바코드, 가격, 스토어 정보는 시트 가장자리와 하단 정보 영역에 정렬해 상품 패키지의 현실감을 높인다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat product-sheet composition, digital illustration rendered as if captured in a clean studio scan; no perspective distortion, sticker-sheet layout aligned like a premium app asset pack.
- Lighting: even diffuse studio light from overhead, with soft paper texture visibility and subtle shadow separation around each sticker edge; keep the print surface crisp and legible.
- Color grade: warm cream base with charcoal outlines and limited signature accent colors, producing a crisp app-sticker palette with high contrast, realistic printed ink density, and friendly Korean webtoon energy.
- Rendering detail: flat webtoon illustration for the character, tactile print finish for the backing sheet, slightly raised die-cut sticker edges, fine halftone-like ink texture in shadows, and polished collectible stationery presentation.

[6. MOOD]
Playful Korean webtoon sticker pack aesthetic — like a polished KakaoTalk / Naver Webtoon character emoji sheet photographed as a real collectible stationery product, with cheerful labels, tidy cut lines, expressive character acting, cute micro props, and charming shop-ready packaging information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly if labels or text are rendered: "오늘의 자취", "{팩 제목}", "기쁨", "슬픔", "놀람", "화남", "졸림", "배고픔", "사랑", "응원", "격노", "멍", "윙크", "하트", "눈물", "폭소", "절망", "잠".
- Product text accuracy: include readable Korean or numeric package details such as "{발행일}", "그림 {작가명}", "{상품 코드}", "{가격}", "{스토어명}", "채팅에 붙여 쓰는 16종 감정표현".
- Layout invariant: exactly 16 sticker panels in a 4x4 grid; header, barcode, product code, price, creator credit, and decorative cut marks must stay outside or between the grid areas without creating extra sticker panels.
- Each panel must show the same character identity consistently across expressions; keep proportions, costume details, color accents, and line weight uniform throughout.
- All outlines must remain bold, clean, and fully closed so the stickers read crisply on mobile screens and as printed die-cut stickers.
- Small Korean labels and micro details should be legible enough to feel printed, with no broken Hangul or random pseudo-text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness mashups

[1. PURPOSE]
Webtoon preview mockup for a mobile platform UI, showing a content-rich 4-panel teaser layout plus a visible Korean comment section. Designed as a shareable 9:16 app-screen composite with realistic interface density, episode labels, engagement metrics, tabs, preview captions, and platform-native mobile details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Full-frame mobile screen composition: the main preview area occupies the upper 68–70% of the canvas, while the comment mockup sits in the lower 30–32% like a real platform feed panel.
- The overall framing should feel like a captured webtoon app screen, with a top status bar, app header, title information card, episode navigation, clean white gutters, thin separators, rounded cards, and small interactive UI icons.
- Use {웹툰명·작가} as the title/author header in the top information area, including a title line, author credit, genre tag, star rating, subscribe/like button, and a small update-day badge.
- Arrange {4컷 미리보기} as the featured episode preview block: four webtoon thumbnails in a 2x2 grid, each with small Korean panel captions, episode numbering, and tiny corner labels such as “미리보기”, “컷 01”, “컷 02”.
- Place {댓글 mockup} in a stacked comment area beneath the preview, aligned left with circular avatar placeholders, bold usernames, Korean comment text, timestamp labels, reply counts, and tiny like counters.
- Background treatment: crisp app UI white with subtle gray dividers, platform-accent green/yellow controls, thumbnail image content, small icons, status indicators, and a realistic bottom navigation bar.
- Keep spacing tight and app-native, with mobile-safe margins, dense but readable hierarchy, and realistic Korean app-screen information throughout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top phone/status area: include time “오후 9:41”, signal/Wi-Fi/battery icons, then an app header with a back arrow, search icon, share icon, and a small platform tab label such as “웹툰 · 미리보기”.
- Top header strip: display {웹툰명·작가} as a webtoon title and author line, with episode metadata, genre chips, update day, a small rating badge, and engagement counts near it. Example details may include “매주 금요일 연재”, “관심 12.4만”, “★ 9.87”, “댓글 324”.
- Main preview block (upper center): show {4컷 미리보기} as four thumbnail panels arranged in a polished 2x2 grid, each panel suggesting a different scene from the same episode with expressive webtoon-style characters, speech-bubble fragments, background scenery, and episode continuity.
- Preview metadata line: include compact episode info, small star rating, view count, like count, comment count, and light UI icons rendered in the style of a real Korean webtoon platform.
- Add a short episode strip above or below the thumbnails: “EP.42 비 오는 편의점 앞”, “무료 공개 D-3”, “미리보기 4컷”, with a small progress bar or carousel dot indicator.
- Comment section (lower area): render {댓글 mockup} as 3 realistic comment rows with circular avatars, bold usernames, Korean comment text, timestamps such as “3분 전”, tiny like counts, reply links, and a comment input field labeled “댓글을 입력하세요”.
- Add comment UI controls: sorting tabs “인기순 / 최신순”, a total count label “댓글 324”, a small spoiler warning chip “스포일러 주의”, and a bottom nav hint with icons for 홈, 웹툰, 관심, MY.
- UI separation: use thin gray dividers, rounded card edges, subtle shadows, and section labels to distinguish the preview area from the comment block, maintaining a polished app screenshot look.
- Platform styling cue: echo the feel of Naver Webtoon or Kakao Webtoon through green/white or yellow/black accent logic, while keeping the layout original and generic enough to read as a fictional mockup.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, bold 700 for title, medium 500 for metadata, regular 400 for comments; title around 34–40px, episode labels around 24–28px, body comments around 22–26px, UI labels around 18–20px, micro metadata around 14–16px.
- Color palette: platform signature green #00D564, clean white #FFFFFF, soft gray #EAECEF, charcoal #222222, muted gray #7A7F87, optional Kakao-style yellow #FEE500 and black #111111 depending on the UI cue from {비주얼} and {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: app UI shadows, 1px separators, subtle card shadow 0px 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), rounded corners 16px, small pill chips with 999px radius.
- Webtoon thumbnail treatment: colorful comic panels, readable character silhouettes, speech bubbles, action marks, small background details, and slight panel-to-panel variation while preserving one coherent episode mood.
- Interface realism: include tappable buttons, icon labels, tab states, counters, microcopy, small carousel dots, bookmark/heart icons, and a bottom navigation area to make the image feel like an actual mobile app capture.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: smartphone screenshot realism, flat UI capture style with no perspective distortion, as if viewed on an iPhone Pro Max screen in portrait orientation.
- Lighting: even studio-flat display glow, crisp screen clarity, slightly lifted whites to mimic a clean app interface, with vivid webtoon panel colors contained inside the preview thumbnails.
- Color grade: platform-native green/white or yellow/black palette with neutral whites and high readability, lightly contrast-enhanced for screenshot sharpness.

[6. MOOD]

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {장면} occupies the central 60–70% of the sketchbook page, framed like a rough comic cut with natural handwritten notes and small thumbnail planning marks around it.
- Background treatment: {배경} with visible paper grain, slight edge noise, desk surface texture, faint paper curl, soft cast shadow, and realistic tabletop context as if photographed in an artist’s workspace.
- Spacing and framing: let the subject sit slightly off-center if the scene suggests action; use surrounding page area for arrows, timing marks, small margin doodles, correction circles, and Korean production notes.
- Line quality: {스케치 결} must read as rough pen + lightly erased pencil underdrawing, with imperfect contour breaks, repeated searching lines, hatching tests, pressure variation, and quick gesture strokes.
- Signature placement: {작가 사인} placed small in the lower-right corner, with a tiny date mark nearby like a real sketchbook signature.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Canvas base — build a white sketchbook page on a vertical 1024x1536 layout, matching {비율}, with tactile paper fibers, faint gray shadow at the edges, slight page curl, subtle smudges, graphite dust, and warm desk reflection.
2. Subject block — draw {장면} as the dominant comic-cut subject, preserving a rough editorial sketch feel rather than a finished illustration; include visible staging marks such as action arrows, eye-line guides, and quick pose thumbnails.
3. Line construction — apply {스케치 결} with black pen lines, visible correction marks, light erased pencil traces, loose construction circles, cross-contour guides, hatching patches, and intentionally unfinished simplified forms.
4. Background layer — integrate {배경} as the scene context inside or around the comic cut, with enough environmental cues to feel specific and lived-in: floor lines, window shadow, speed lines, signage fragments, desk-edge shadow, or rough perspective guides when appropriate.
5. Accent color pass — apply {컬러} as selective marker or colored-pencil accents on key focus areas, note tabs, circled corrections, or one dramatic motion/detail area, leaving most of the drawing ink-and-graphite driven.
6. Artist mark — add {작가 사인} in the lower-right as a tiny handwritten signature, matching an analog sketchbook page; include small Korean annotations such as “컷 A-03”, “동선 확인”, “빛 방향”, “수정 후보”, and a date label like “2026.05.01”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: no large polished title; any lettering should feel hand-lettered with pen, pencil, or thin marker. Render short Korean sketch notes clearly: “러프 03”, “컷 A”, “시선 이동”, “톤 보류”, “속도감 추가”.
- Color palette: black ink, white paper, warm gray shadows, graphite smears, and one accent tone from {컬러}; keep the accent restrained like real marker or colored pencil absorbed into paper.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, about 15% opacity; edges should feel like photographed paper rather than a digital frame, with tiny tape residue, page crease, and binder-hole or notebook-edge hints if they fit the composition.
- Real-world details: include subtle desk context such as a nearby pen tip, masking tape strip, eraser crumbs, paper clip shadow, ruler edge, or faint coffee-ring stain, without covering the main sketch.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: overhead tabletop photo look, 50mm lens, f/4, as if documenting a sketchbook page laid flat on a desk.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at about 45°, with a faint secondary fill from the right and gentle shadow falloff at the page edges.
- Color grade: neutral paper white with graphite gray shadows and a restrained accent hue; low-contrast, analog scan-like finish with realistic paper texture and pen bleed.

[6. MOOD]
Indie sketchbook editorial — raw zine illustration, like a behind-the-scenes notebook page from a comics artist’s working draft, energetic, tactile, and convincingly handmade.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the rendered image must preserve clear Hangul in all handwritten notes, including “러프 03”, “컷 A-03”, “동선 확인”, “빛 방향”, “수정 후보”, and “톤 보류”, without broken characters or garbled spacing.

A professional studio model-sheet page with consistent proportions, readable costume construction, Korean production labels, color callouts, measurement guides, and practical annotation details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main 3-view lineup occupies about 72% of the width, arranged left-to-right as front view, left side view, and back view, all at the same scale and standing on the same baseline.
- Expression mini-panel occupies the right 20% of the canvas, separated by a thin production-rule divider and aligned vertically to the center of the main lineup.
- Background is {배경}, presented as a realistic animation reference board surface with subtle paper grain, pale grid ticks, baseline ruler marks, and light guide lines that support the turnaround layout.
- Use {캐릭터} as the central character concept, keeping the face, hairstyle, proportions, and costume consistent across all views.
- Use {3 view} as the structural layout rule, with the same pose and the same body proportions across each view.
- Use {표정 컷} as a compact reference panel with small but clearly legible facial variation.
- Use {의상} as the defining costume language, with seams, trims, accessories, fabric panels, fasteners, pockets, footwear details, and silhouette clearly separated.
- Add a top header strip like a real production sheet: Korean title “캐릭터 시트”, sheet code “SHEET 01”, date label “2026.05”, model credit “모델명: {캐릭터}”, costume credit “의상: {의상}”, and a small artist/revision line “REV.A / 디자인 검수용”.
- Include small technical callouts near the figures, such as fabric color swatches, arrow notes for collar, sleeve, hem, shoes, and accessory placement, without changing the character design.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main front view: place the character on the left third, full body, facing camera directly, neutral stance, arms relaxed, crisp readable silhouette, no perspective distortion. Add the label “정면 FRONT” above or below the figure, plus small height tick marks beside the body.
2. Side view: place immediately to the right of the front view, left-facing profile, matching height and clothing alignment, same hairstyle volume and shoe profile. Add the label “측면 SIDE” and include a small note line for profile details such as “머리 볼륨 유지” or “소매 길이 동일”.
3. Back view: place to the right of the side view, full back view, same pose height and costume construction visible from behind, including collar, hemline, back seams, straps, closures, and back accessories. Add the label “후면 BACK”.
4. Expression panel: place on the right side as a narrow vertical column, showing exactly four small face thumbnails for smile, surprise, sadness, and anger, each with the same head shape and line weight. Label them in Korean as “미소”, “놀람”, “슬픔”, “화남”.
5. Layout separation: use production-sheet dividers, alignment guides, measuring ticks, baseline markers, and small annotation arrows so the page feels like a real design approval board; keep all limbs readable and prevent overlapping between the three main views.
6. Character sheet finish: make the whole page feel like an animation studio turnaround board, with crisp outlines, controlled flat cel colors, light marker-like shading on fabric folds, precise Korean labels, and evenly readable details in every view.
7. Add a compact lower information band containing “색상표”, 5–7 color swatches sampled from {의상} and {배경}, small hex-like labels, page number “01/01”, and a tiny approval checkbox row “라인 / 컬러 / 의상 / 표정”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean labels, with smaller Noto Sans KR Regular for notes; dark charcoal text, technical yet editorial, like a Korean animation production packet.
- Color palette: off-white #F7F7F2, charcoal #2B2B2B, soft gray #D9D9D9, muted accent colors from {배경} and {의상}, keeping the palette controlled and animation-sheet friendly.
- Border/shadow: thin light-gray panel lines, 2px separation rules, subtle paper shadow at panel edges, faint blue-gray guide marks, and small printed registration ticks for a believable production-board finish.
- Linework: confident manga-style contour lines with slightly varied stroke weight, clear inner seam lines, visible costume trims, accessory outlines, shoe soles, hair strand groups, and back-view construction details.
- Annotation design: use small arrows, circled detail numbers, swatch chips, and short Korean notes such as “주요 색”, “원단 주름”, “뒤 여밈”, “신발 디테일”; all notes must support the character reference purpose.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: orthographic illustration sheet look, like a clean turnaround board photographed head-on with a 50mm equivalent neutral framing, no dramatic perspective.
- Lighting: even diffuse studio lighting from the front, near-shadowless, with gentle paper texture visible and uniform brightness across all panels.
- Color grade: neutral anime-production palette with soft paper white, restrained saturation, crisp line clarity, and subtle printed-board realism.
- Rendering: polished Korean comic/anime concept-art finish, flat cel base colors with delicate fold shadows, precise edges, and tangible paper-board presentation rather than a sterile mockup.

[6. MOOD]
Anime production character design sheet — polished model-sheet reference board feel, like a real studio turnaround page used for animation approval, with practical Korean labels, revision marks, color chips, and designer notes.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all rendered Korean labels must remain fully legible and free of broken Korean characters, including “캐릭터 시트”, “정면”, “측면”, “후면”, “표정”, “미소”, “놀람”, “슬픔”, “화남”, “색상표”, and “모델명: {캐릭터}”.
- All 3 views must show the same character identity, same costume, same hairstyle, same height proportions, and the same standing pose language.
- The expression panel must contain exactly 4 facial expressions, clearly separated and consistent with the main character design.
- Do not add extra full-body character views beyond front, side, and back; added production details must be labels, swatches, rulers, notes, or sheet graphics only.
- Preserve {캐릭터}, {3 view}, {표정 컷}, {의상}, {배경}, and {비율} exactly as the design inputs shaping the character sheet.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Background treatment: build {배경·세트} as a clear genre-specific environment with cinematic depth, layered atmospheric detail, practical set elements, and story-relevant textures that support the characters.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Title zone (top 18–22%): place {제목·작가} in a bold Korean display typographic treatment, with the title larger than the author line and strong separation between the two. Add a small genre pill near the title, for example “{장르} · 독점 연재” or “{장르} · 오리지널”.
2) Character zone (mid 50–60%): render {인물 결} as the visual hero, with expressive pose, clear silhouette, face/upper-body emphasis, nuanced clothing detail, hair highlights, jewelry, weapons, magic effects, documents, flowers, neon reflections, or other genre-appropriate story cues.
3) Environment zone (full-frame depth): extend {배경·세트} behind the characters with foreground/midground/background separation so the cover feels like an illustrated key visual; include believable environmental details such as candlelight, rain-streaked glass, palace curtains, city signs, library shelves, battlefield smoke, occult symbols, or starship panels depending on {장르}.

6) Typography integration: place the title, author text, micro-labels, side credit, and short blurbs so they remain legible over the artwork, using contrast, subtle glow, outline, shadow, translucent panels, or metallic foil effects where needed. Reflect {타이포} in the title treatment.
7) Final polish: keep the image polished like a commercial web novel cover, with crisp character edges, tactile fabric/material rendering, cinematic lighting, and refined details that reward close viewing while preserving thumbnail readability.

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical single-image webtoon page for social scrolling, designed as a polished Korean comic strip with 3–5 stacked scenes, readable dialogue, expressive pacing, and believable everyday visual detail. 
A Naver Webtoon / Kakao Webtoon-style vertical episode page with flexibility for {장르·주제}, including everyday comedy, romance, fantasy, or thriller beats.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall canvas: tall 9:16 vertical page with 3~5 panels stacked top-to-bottom, separated by warm webtoon gutters of consistent height for smooth scrolling.
- Episode framing: add a small top header strip before the first panel with a short Korean title label such as "EP.12 오늘도 삐끗!", a tiny date "2026.05.01", and a subtle creator credit "글·그림 @작가명".
- Scene rhythm: top panel as hook / middle panels for escalation / final panel for punchline or closing beat, with each panel showing enough background context to feel like a lived-in Korean webtoon scene.
- Character rendering: keep {캐릭터 결} consistent across every panel, with stable face proportions, line weight, hairstyle, accessories, and costume continuity.
- Dialogue placement: place {대사·말풍선} inside each panel with clear readable spacing around speech balloons; include occasional small Korean sound effects like "띠링!", "쿵", "헉", or "..." when they support the scene.
- Environmental detail: depending on {장르·주제}, include natural props and setting clues such as a convenience-store sign, phone screen, café table, subway handle, school hallway poster, office desk items, fantasy talisman, rainy window, or streetlight reflections.
- Color strategy: apply {컬러 톤} across the page with one accent color reserved for key reactions, highlights, motion lines, emotional effects, or punchline emphasis.
- Layout feel: use {레이아웃 결} with crisp panel rhythm, readable mobile pacing, varied shot sizes, and a satisfying final scroll beat.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Opening panel — Introduce the situation using {장르·주제}, with the main subject(s) placed slightly off-center for comic timing and immediate readability; add a small location/time tag in Korean such as "아침 8:10, 지하철역 앞" or "방과 후, 2학년 복도".
2. Development panel(s) — Escalate the joke or tension through clear body language, expressive facial changes, props being used, background reactions from side characters, and dialogue beats from {대사·말풍선}.
3. Reaction panel — Make the strongest facial expression the focal point, using close-up framing, accent lines, tiny sweat marks, sparkles, gloom shadows, or comedic impact symbols that match {컬러 톤}.
4. Closing panel — End with a punchline or emotional beat, using a slightly larger reaction area, a final readable caption-like balloon if needed, and a small footer note such as "다음 화에 계속" or "댓글로 당신의 선택은?" when appropriate.
5. Optional extra panel — If the composition uses 5 panels, reserve the last panel for a delayed reaction, visual gag, final sting, or tiny after-caption, still matching the same {캐릭터 결} and maintaining continuity with earlier panels.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use clean Korean comic lettering inspired by Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight, with balloon text sized for mobile readability.
- Korean micro-text: add short legible webtoon details where useful, such as "오늘의 미션", "알림 3개", "특가", "동아리 모집", "출근 5분 전", or "마감 D-1".
- Color palette: build the page around {컬러 톤}; keep background whites slightly warm, shadows neutral charcoal, and use one saturated accent hue only where needed for reactions, objects, or dramatic emphasis.
- Panel treatment: use thin panel borders or implied panel separation with soft webtoon shadows, varied panel heights, occasional inset close-up, and tasteful vertical motion effects for scroll momentum.
- Text treatment: speech balloons should be crisp, evenly spaced, and highly legible; caption boxes, SFX lettering, and tiny UI labels should feel like part of a real Korean webtoon page.
- Detail density: include believable background textures and small props that support the scene while keeping the characters and dialogue as the clear reading path.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulated comic framing, like a 35mm editorial documentary crop translated into illustration, with occasional tighter close-ups for reactions and one wider establishing panel for setting.
- Lighting: flat-to-soft studio-like lighting with gentle directional shading, consistent across panels, adapting to the chosen genre when needed through rain glow, café warmth, school fluorescent light, fantasy aura, or thriller shadow accents.
- Color grade: restrained cream / charcoal base with a single accent color, tuned for clean mobile reading and vertical-scroll clarity while preserving the richness of character expressions, props, and backgrounds.
- Rendering: modern Korean digital webtoon illustration with confident line art, cel-shaded faces, soft blush and shadow layers, expressive eyes, readable hands, and consistent costume folds across panels.

[6. MOOD]
Korean webtoon slice-of-life page — Naver Webtoon and Kakao Webtoon daily-scroll readability with crisp comedic timing, lively panel-to-panel acting, recognizable Korean setting details, and an episode-like finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main character placement: the {캐릭터 결} hero sits slightly left of center and occupies about 48–55% of the frame, with a large readable head, compact body, expressive face, and space for episode text, series marks, and social-card details.
- Background treatment: warm cream-beige paper field with visible soft grain, faint notebook texture, casual hand-drawn coral accent shapes, tiny tape marks, sticker corners, and lightly layered desk-life motifs that feel natural for a Korean daily-life toon cover.
- Text and prop spacing: {시리즈명·장르} appears as the top header, {회차 정보} sits near the upper-right or lower-right as a compact badge, and {대표 비주얼} elements are grouped as an illustrated daily-life scene around the character without covering the face or episode number.
- Add realistic Instagram cover-card details: small creator handle “@oneul_jachwi”, short hashtag line “#자취툰 #주말루틴 #혼자살기”, tiny save/share/heart/comment icons, page indicator “7/10”, and a small CTA sticker “다음 화도 저장!” integrated into the design.
- Use {시리즈명·장르}, {회차 정보}, {캐릭터 결}, {컬러 팔레트}, {타이포}, {대표 비주얼}, {비율} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 15–18%): place {시리즈명·장르} in a rounded, friendly title treatment with strong thumbnail readability; add a tiny creator label “@oneul_jachwi” and small seasonal note “2026 봄·여름 연재” near the title if it fits naturally.
2) Episode label zone (upper-right or lower-right, 12–14%): set {회차 정보} inside a rounded chip, hand-drawn sticker, or washi-tape label, using high-contrast dark text on warm light fill; include a small “7/10” carousel indicator nearby.
3) Hero character zone (center 50%): draw {캐릭터 결} as the main focal point, front-facing and slightly oversized, with crisp outline, soft inner shading, clear silhouette, rosy cheeks, readable expression, and clothing/accessory details that match the daily-life series tone.
4) Daily-life prop cluster (bottom 25–30%): arrange {대표 비주얼} as supporting illustrated objects around the hero—coffee cup, open notebook, phone with chat bubbles, slippers, snack wrapper, small plant, laundry basket, pet accessory, or desk item—using the same cute cartoon line style and subtle shadows.
5) Social-footer zone (bottom edge): add tiny Instagram-like UI marks including heart/comment/share/save icons, “좋아요 1.2만”, and the short caption “주말은 천천히 흘러가도 괜찮아” in small Korean text, keeping the title and episode label dominant.
6) Palette integration: apply {컬러 팔레트} across the title, badge, props, stickers, UI icons, speech bubbles, and accent shapes so the whole cover feels like one cohesive episode card rather than separate stickers.
7) Final framing: keep the composition square, balanced, thumb-stopping, and content-rich, with layered decorative details supporting the character while maintaining clear recognition of the series title and episode number.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: rounded Korean display style inspired by Pretendard Rounded / Nunito Sans Rounded / hand-drawn lettering, title weight 700–900, episode label weight 600, subtitle and UI microcopy weight 500, with sizes tuned for 1024x1024 thumbnail legibility.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} as the main palette; keep cream beige as the dominant base, coral as the accent, charcoal for text, warm amber for highlights, and small muted mint or dusty blue details only when they support the palette.
- Border/shadow: use a soft 2–4 px outline on character and props, with a gentle drop shadow at 4 px y-offset, 10–14 px blur, around 12–18% opacity for separation from the background.
- Texture and finish: include subtle paper grain, slightly imperfect hand-drawn linework, sticker edges, washi-tape strips, soft ink registration variation, and cozy digital brush texture so the cover feels like a real creator-made Instagram post.
- Decorative system: use small stars, arrows, speech bubbles, diary tabs, receipt-like labels, and corner doodles in moderation, making them functional as visual guides toward the character, title, and episode badge.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: illustrated poster look, digital drawing framed like a square social cover, with a subtle 35mm editorial composition feel and front-facing simplified perspective.
- Lighting: even studio-like cartoon shading with a soft top-left highlight, gentle contact shadows beneath the character and props, and warm ambient light that keeps the feed thumbnail bright and inviting.
- Color grade: warm cream + coral + charcoal + amber, slightly softened saturation, with a cozy printed-webtoon cover tone and tactile creator-zine personality.

[6. MOOD]
Casual indie webtoon cover — feels like a playful Korean Instagram comic series poster with the friendly charm of daily-life creator art, a lived-in weekend routine mood, and authentic social-feed details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: "오늘의 자취", "EP.07 — 주말의 일상".
- Additional small Korean text may appear only as realistic cover support: "@oneul_jachwi", "#자취툰 #주말루틴 #혼자살기", "7/10", "좋아요 1.2만", "주말은 천천히 흘러가도 괜찮아", "다음 화도 저장!".
- The cover must read clearly as a series episode thumbnail at a glance; preserve the front-facing cute-cartoon proportion with a large head and small body.
- Do not shift the main character into a realistic human style; keep the illustration rounded, comic-like, and aligned with {캐릭터 결}.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 22%): set {그룹·데뷔} as a bold masthead with clear hierarchy; include {발행일}, {슬라이드 번호}, and a small feature label reading “K-POP INTRO FILE” near the headline.

3. Member lineup block (middle 48%): present {멤버 라인업} as five evenly spaced member cards with matching studio crop style, each card containing portrait area, Korean name label, position label, tiny stat badge, and small decorative corner number 01–05.
4. Hit-song block (bottom 18%): render {대표 히트곡} as a ranked mini-chart with two entries, compact bars, album-note captions, rank badges, and tiny chart-date metadata.
5. Footer line (bottom edge): place {발행처}, {페이지 표시}, and {CTA 문구} as small publisher / card-news navigation text with save/share micro icons.

- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for headlines, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, and Pretendard Regular for small metadata; headline size should feel like 72–92px equivalent, labels 24–30px equivalent, metadata 16–20px equivalent.
- Color palette: white #F8F8F6, charcoal #222222, soft gray #D9D9D6, pale ink blue-gray #EEF1F4, and {그룹 시그니처 컬러}; use the accent for rank numbers, slide dots, thin rules, stickers, and key tags.

- Korean text treatment: all rendered Korean must look printed, properly kerned, and consistent with a professional entertainment-media card-news template.

- Color grade: neutral editorial grade with white balance slightly cool, charcoal crispness, gentle skin-tone preservation, and restrained accent saturation matching {그룹 시그니처 컬러}.
- Material feel: printed magazine-card texture with fine paper grain, precise vector-like text, and layered but orderly infographic elements.

Premium K-pop editorial card-news — fashion magazine infographic feel, fan-account shareability, polished Seoul pop-press presentation, energetic but credible entertainment journalism.

- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “NEW WAVE”, “2024 데뷔 5인조”, “FIRST LIGHT”, “1위”, “NEW WAVE”, “2위”, “@kpop_intro_kr”, “카드뉴스 채널”, “SLIDE 01”, “1/5”, “저장하고 다음 멤버 보기”, “2026.05.01”, “#뉴웨이브입문”.
- Layout invariants: maintain exactly three stacked main sections in the order hero / member lineup / hit songs; member lineup must show 5 members; the ranked hit-song block must show 2 entries; slide number, page indicator, CTA, and publisher credit must appear as metadata within these sections or footer, not as a fourth section.
- Required readable Korean content: render “멤버 5명 정면 사진 + 이름 + 포지션”, “상단 그룹 hero + 가운데 멤버 라인업 + 하단 히트곡”, “데뷔일 2024.03.15”, “대표곡 차트”, “입문 포인트”.

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop trading photocard design, front-and-back presentation, collectible card mockup for fan merchandise and social sharing.
Vertical premium idol merchandise showcase inspired by BTS / NCT photocard aesthetics, with realistic printed-card texture, fan-collector details, and a tangible desk-styled presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single tall photocard set in a vertical 1024x1536 frame; the front face is dominant while the back face peeks beside or behind it to show both sides at once.
- Keep the card edges crisp and rectangular, with a slight 3D tilt, realistic thickness, rounded-corner laminated finish, and a soft cast shadow that makes the card feel physically placed in the scene.
- Use {아티스트·시리즈}, {캐릭터}, {포토카드 결}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃}, {비율} as the customizable content elements.
- Surround the photocard with believable fan-merch context: a translucent protective sleeve, a partial album insert, tiny holographic confetti, sticker tabs, a small ticket-stub strip, and a satin or matte paper surface matching {컬러 톤}.
- Maintain a polished product-shot composition where the card remains the hero object, but include realistic reflections, printed edges, and collector-tabletop details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main card area: build a collectible photocard with glossy premium coating; the front face shows the character portrait in an editorial idol style, while the back face is visible enough to reveal signature details, serial numbering, and fan-club style printed information.
2. Front face composition: place {캐릭터} as the hero portrait with polished studio styling, chest-up or waist-up depending on {비율}; include a small top label reading "PHOTO CARD", a date tag "2026.05.01", and a short Korean caption such as "빛나는 순간" or "오늘의 포카".
3. Back face details: include a neat autograph area, edition numbering such as "NO.042/100", series code "VOL.247", a small QR-like graphic block, a fan message line "함께한 모든 순간을 기억해", and compact custom series marks that feel like premium fan merch.
4. Collector details: add a tiny model-name credit line such as "MODEL: {캐릭터}", a series credit "SERIES: {아티스트·시리즈}", and a location/date label "SEOUL · 2026"; keep these printed elements sharp and integrated into the card design.
5. Surface effects: add subtle holographic foil accents along the border, rainbow refraction on corners, laminated sheen, light fingerprints on the protective sleeve, tiny dust specks caught in the light, and realistic paper thickness.
6. Text hierarchy: set the series title {아티스트·시리즈} as the strongest text element, then support it with smaller labels, serial info, caption text, sticker-like tags, and signature-style marks; all Korean and numeric text must remain crisp and fully legible.
7. Layout treatment: follow {레이아웃} with both sides visible in a balanced offset arrangement, slight overlap, dimensional separation, and fan-trading-card display energy rather than a flat mockup.
8. Decorative framing: include tasteful corner icons, star-sparkle sticker motifs, pearl or metallic dot accents, and a slim transparent sleeve highlight that echoes {포토카드 결} and {컬러 톤}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main series title, Noto Sans KR Medium for labels, and a neat handwritten-signature style only for the autograph area; title size should feel like a card masthead, labels should stay compact and precise.
- Korean printed text examples to include where appropriate: "오늘의 포카", "빛나는 순간", "서울 콘서트", "함께한 모든 순간", "한정판 포토카드".
- Color palette: base the design on {컬러 톤}, with a dominant album signature hue, plus metallic gold #D4AF37 and holographic cyan-violet accents #7EE8FF / #A78BFA for foil details.
- Border/shadow: thin crisp border lines, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, and a faint specular highlight to suggest coated card stock.
- Material realism: show glossy PET sleeve reflections, coated card-stock edges, foil-stamped micro accents, slightly raised typography, and realistic contact shadows on the tabletop or satin fabric.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product shot, 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens look with a shallow but controlled depth of field; front card remains tack sharp, background slightly softened.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, and a narrow rim highlight along the card edge to emphasize the glossy finish.
- Color grade: polished idol-merch palette with clean neutrals, saturated signature color, gold foil glints, and a slight cool-magenta balance for holographic realism.
- Real-world presentation: macro-product photography feel, visible card thickness, believable reflections, fine paper grain, subtle foil flare, and a few fan-collector accessories placed around the card.

[6. MOOD]
Premium K-pop collectible merch editorial — glossy album photocard showcase with a BTS / NCT fan-trading-card display feel, warm fan-collection intimacy, and realistic unboxing-table styling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: every Korean string must render perfectly and without broken characters.
- Must appear exactly as intended in the design: {아티스트·시리즈}, {캐릭터}, {포토카드 결}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃}, {비율}.
- Render added Korean text cleanly, including "오늘의 포카", "빛나는 순간", "서울 콘서트", "함께한 모든 순간", and "한정판 포토카드" if used.
- Serial formatting must stay clean and readable, such as "NO.042/100", "VOL.247", "SEOUL · 2026", and "2026.05.01".
- Preserve front-back card presentation in a single cohesive composition with realistic laminated photocard material, visible sleeve reflections, and sharp printed typography.
- No face distortion, no extra fingers or anatomy issues if any hand is shown, and no illegible microtext.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop fan sign event and concert merchandise mockup, four-item collage layout for a realistic promotional merch preview.
Use a polished fandom-goods editorial look with tactile product photography, printed labels, event information, barcode/SKU details, and coordinated packaging elements, suitable for social post, pitch deck, concert booth banner, or online merch announcement.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- A 4-item collage fills the full landscape frame, with each product occupying a separate panel and consistent scale across all panels.
- Use {아티스트·팬덤} as the central identity anchor across the set; make it feel like a real K-pop fan sign and concert goods drop with a unified visual system.
- Background treatment: {배경} with a premium studio merch-table / flat-lay presentation feel, including realistic paper cards, product tags, acrylic reflections, fabric texture, plastic packaging, and soft cast shadows.
- Maintain a balanced commercial layout with readable product hierarchy, natural spacing between items, and enough surrounding printed detail to feel like an actual merchandise preview board.
- Place {비율} as the intended canvas relationship; keep the collage structured for a wide horizontal presentation.
- Add a slim event-info header or footer strip with Korean details such as date, venue, ticket note, SKU/barcode area, and small fanclub-style credit text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main hero panel: place {아티스트·팬덤} branding as the dominant visual identity, with the most recognizable merch item front and center, preferably the lightstick shown with reflective plastic, glowing inner detail, wrist strap, box sleeve, and printed product tag.
2. Secondary panels: arrange the remaining {굿즈 4종} items in a coordinated four-part collage, each shown as a realistic merch mockup with consistent perspective and lighting.
3. Color system: apply {시그니처 컬러} consistently across packaging, accents, print details, product labels, sticker tabs, decorative dividers, and small highlight elements.
4. Logo application: integrate {로고·심볼} on apparel, packaging, accessory surfaces, hang tags, small label stickers, and corner badges with believable print placement and realistic scale.
5. Product realism: show material differences clearly — matte cotton weave and fold creases for apparel, terry/fiber texture for the towel, glossy acrylic/metal for keyring and badge details, and semi-translucent or reflective parts for lightstick details.
6. Presentation finish: make the layout polished like a professional fandom merchandise concept board, with printed item numbers, short Korean captions, subtle grid dividers, price/SKU microcopy, folded paper shadows, product wrappers, and a small barcode block.
7. Add realistic surrounding collateral: mini ticket stub, fan sign entry card, order sheet corner, small holographic sticker, and tiny caution/size labels, all coordinated with the same color palette.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold clean sans-serif such as Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean labels, with medium-to-bold weight and clear hierarchy; small supporting text can use a lighter sans-serif at 18–24px equivalent.
- Color palette: {시그니처 컬러} with crisp white, soft cool gray, and restrained gold accents; use hex-equivalent direction like #1E4DFF, #FFFFFF, #D8B15A, and pale neutral gray for background balance.
- Border/shadow: subtle studio-style drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, about 15% opacity; keep edges crisp and mockup-like rather than painterly.
- Graphic details: use thin dividing rules, rounded label chips, small serial numbers, barcode-like black lines, holographic sticker shine, and tiny product-spec text to make the board feel manufactured and photographed.
- Korean copy should be short and realistic, like actual merch catalog labels, not long marketing paragraphs.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: professional studio product photography look, 50mm lens equivalent at f/8 for flat-lay clarity and accurate merch proportion.
- Lighting: even softbox lighting from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from the right to keep logos and fabric textures readable.
- Color grade: clean cool-white base with saturated blue, bright white, and metallic gold accents; controlled contrast, no heavy warmth.
- Rendering quality: high-resolution realistic product mockup, sharp typography, visible material texture, slight lens realism, natural contact shadows, polished acrylic highlights, crisp printed packaging, and believable folds on fabric items.

[6. MOOD]
Premium K-pop fandom merchandise editorial — polished fan event preview with a BTS / SEVENTEEN fan-sign presentation feel, energetic concert anticipation, collectible goods excitement, and a real merch booth catalog atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "NEW WAVE", "WAVERS", "01 응원봉 (라이트스틱)", "02 티셔츠", "03 응원 타올", "04 키링·뱃지".
- Also render short supporting Korean event details clearly: "팬사인회 & 콘서트 굿즈", "2026.05.18 SAT 18:00", "서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장", "티켓 오픈 D-7", "MD 부스 운영 12:00–20:00", "ONLINE PRE-ORDER", "₩39,000", "₩45,000", "₩25,000", "₩18,000".
- Include small realistic microcopy such as "VOL.07 GOODS PREVIEW", "SKU NW-WV-2026", "model credit: WAVERS CREW", and a barcode/SKU area printed on the layout.
- All four merch items must appear as a cohesive set with consistent design language, unified scale, and believable product mockup realism.
- Keep the composition landscape-wide and clearly readable as a four-item collage.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized idol likenesses

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop concert / world tour poster in A4 vertical format, designed for fan announcement, ticketing promo, venue display, and social sharing.
High-energy concert poster with dramatic stage presence, tour-city listing, ticketing details, sponsor strip, and bilingual headline hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {아티스트·투어} occupies the upper 42% as a dominant hero focal point, with the face or full-body pose anchored slightly off-center for concert-poster tension.
- Background treatment: deep dark stage environment with layered haze, spotlight beams, LED glow, subtle metallic texture, stadium truss silhouettes, and small crowd-light bokeh to make the venue feel real.
- Layout framing: vertical A4-style poster with strong center axis, dramatic title lockup, dense lower information block, and a polished arena-poster rhythm suitable for an official tour announcement.
- Keep {메인장소} and {공연일시} as the primary Korea stop information, then place {월드투어일정} as a structured world-tour schedule zone in the lower section.
- Integrate {히어로비주얼} so the subject, costume, microphone, in-ear monitor, stage riser, props, or illustration treatment feels like a live concert key visual rather than an album cover.
- Add realistic poster details: ticket open notice, venue line, seat-price microcopy, sponsor / production strip, QR-style ticket box, small legal note, and decorative holographic graphics.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (top 42%): {히어로비주얼} rendered as a dramatic full-body idol pose or signature character illustration, with strong rim light, stage fog, lens flare, visible LED panels, and a centered spotlight cone.
- Title block (upper-middle): {아티스트·투어} set in oversized bold English headline type, spanning 2 lines if needed, with crisp spacing and slight glow edge to feel like a tour banner.
- Korean subtitle layer (just below title): include “새로운 파동, 하나의 무대” and “월드투어 서울 스페셜” in smaller weight and tighter tracking.
- Event details block (middle-lower): show “{메인장소}”, “{공연일시}”, “TICKET OPEN {티켓정보}”, and “전석 지정 · 팬클럽 선예매 · 일반 예매” as a clear stacked information system.
- Tour schedule block (lower-middle): {월드투어일정} arranged as a stacked list with city/date lines, dot bullets, thin dividers, and small caption text such as “MORE CITIES TO BE ANNOUNCED”.
- Decorative graphics: neon streaks, concert lighting flares, confetti specks, holographic line fragments, waveform graphics, starbursts, and translucent ticket-stub shapes orbiting the hero without obscuring the headline.
- Sponsor / production footer (bottom 12%): include {스폰서문구}, “주최 WAVE LIVE · 주관 STAGEWORKS · 문의 02-1234-5678”, a barcode-like ticket strip, QR-style square, tiny age rating, and venue notice.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {타이포스타일}; bold condensed sans for the English headline, e.g. Bebas Neue / Anton / DIN Condensed; Korean support text in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR SemiBold; schedule and ticket text in smaller 12–18px weight for clarity.
- Color palette: {컬러톤} using deep black #050505, electric blue #2D7CFF, hot pink #FF3DBE, gold #D8B45A, and neon violet #8A4DFF; preserve strong contrast on a dark base.
- Depth treatment: use soft drop shadows 4px y-offset, 16px blur, 18% opacity behind the headline and hero cutout; add metallic gradients, glassy glow panels, and subtle paper grain for printed-poster realism.
- Text treatment: sharp, clean edges with high legibility; use subtle outer glow on key headline accents and restrained glow on schedule dividers, never causing body copy to blur.
- Poster finish: glossy tour-merch aesthetic with layered lighting, crisp event information, sponsor footer, ticketing microcopy, and decorative stage graphics that feel professionally produced.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: stage-photography look with Canon EOS R5 and RF 85mm f/1.2 for hero portrait framing, or a cinematic 70-200mm telephoto feel for live-performance compression.
- Lighting: concert stage lighting with hard white key spotlight from upper-left, saturated blue/pink LED backlight from behind, and thin rim light on hair/clothing edges; add light haze to make beams visible.
- Color grade: dark noir base with neon cyan, magenta, and gold highlights; high contrast, slightly lifted midtones, vivid highlight bloom, and polished tour-poster finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium K-pop world tour key visual — a BTS / BLACKPINK-style arena concert announcement with glossy stage drama, ticketing-poster realism, and magazine-cover intensity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Rendered Korean poster text must include these exact strings: “서울 KSPO DOME 6.15-16”, “추가”, “티켓 오픈”, “전석 지정”, “새로운 파동, 하나의 무대”.
- Include realistic event microcopy in Korean: “주최 WAVE LIVE”, “문의 02-1234-5678”, “팬클럽 선예매”, “일반 예매”, and “공연장 사정에 따라 일부 내용이 변경될 수 있습니다.”
- Bilingual typography must remain clean and readable; English and Korean must not merge into broken or garbled characters.
- Keep the composition poster-like and high-fashion; the hero subject must remain visually dominant over the schedule and sponsor blocks.
- If a full-body figure is used, hands, limbs, and proportions must be anatomically correct.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or altered real-person likenesses that distort identity
- Nude, sexualized, or suggestive emphasis

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop music video still frame, cinematic editorial capture with a dramatic story-driven feel. Designed as a single promotional still that reads like a high-budget MV scene, with enough real set detail to feel captured during an actual shoot rather than generated as a sterile portrait.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Frame orientation is a {비율} landscape still, using {장면 설정} as the primary scene setting and {아티스트 구성} as the focal subject treatment.
- Place the artist dominant in the mid-to-foreground with strong separation from the environment through lighting, depth of field, costume silhouette, and movement blur from the performance moment.
- Pose and expression must follow {자세와 표정}, with the face, hands, hair, and body angle framed like a decisive beat captured during choreography or a dramatic acting moment inside the MV narrative.
- Background treatment should match {조명 분위기} and {컬러 톤}, including natural MV-set details such as wet asphalt, rooftop railings, LED signs, stage haze, cables, reflective puddles, wind-blown fabric, distant dancers, or practical lights where appropriate.
- Styling should include {의상 스타일}, hair and makeup that match the genre, and {소품 디테일} integrated naturally into the scene.
- Add a subtle in-frame MV identity element when it fits the shot: a small corner title card, monitor-style timestamp, or on-set slate detail referencing {MV 제목}, {앨범/싱글명}, {공개일}, and {장면 타임코드} without turning the image into a poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Scene foundation: establish {장면 설정} as the full visual context, whether rooftop night city lights, beach horizon, urban street textures, backstage corridor, party glow, rain-soaked road, or isolated moody space.
- Main subject block: place {아티스트 구성} as the clear visual anchor, with clothing silhouette, hair movement, accessories, body angle, and gaze reading instantly as K-pop MV styling.
- Pose capture: render {자세와 표정} with authentic stage-energy or chic stillness, ensuring the expression feels frozen at the peak of a performance beat.
- Lighting build: apply {조명 분위기} with strong directional contrast, accent highlights, practical light sources, haze beams, reflections, and crisp rim light for hair and shoulders.
- Color design: push {컬러 톤} so the palette feels like a recognizable MV signature—deep dark base with vivid accent color presence, controlled bloom, and polished color grading.
- Set realism: include believable surfaces, props, wardrobe textures, makeup sheen, condensation, dust, water droplets, scuffed floor marks, lens flare, or background signage to make the frame feel filmed on a real production set.
- Final polish: reinforce the frame as a still-cut from a premium music video, with dramatic energy, environmental depth, screen-capture realism, and editorial-level finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if text appears, use bold condensed Korean display styling inspired by Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold, rendered as small MV title-card or production-detail text rather than advertising copy.
- Text content may include: “{MV 제목}”, “{앨범/싱글명}”, “{장면 타임코드}”, “{공개일}”, and a tiny credit line “{크레딧 문구}”.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with deep charcoal, black, midnight navy, and high-saturation accent tones such as pink #FF4FA3, purple #8A5CFF, cyan #2DE2FF, or amber #FFB347 according to the chosen scene.
- Border/shadow: subtle cinematic vignette, soft edge falloff, anamorphic-style flare, controlled bloom on highlights, and natural shadow gradients from the set lighting.
- Texture: preserve realistic skin texture, wardrobe fabric, jewelry highlights, makeup detail, smoke density, floor reflection, and background depth so the image feels like a real MV still.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ARRI Alexa Mini LF look, 35mm or 50mm cinema lens, f/2.0 to f/2.8 for subject separation and MV-style depth.
- Lighting: high-contrast cinematic lighting with a key light from upper-left or side angle, plus neon practicals or warm amber fill depending on {조명 분위기}; add crisp rim light for hair and shoulders.
- Color grade: dark base with magenta-violet-cyan accents, subtle teal shadows, rich blacks, luminous skin highlights, and controlled highlight glow for a premium K-pop MV grade.
- Capture feel: slight motion blur on hands, hair, fabric, or background dancers; sharp facial focus; realistic bokeh from LED tubes, traffic lights, or stage fixtures.

[6. MOOD]
High-budget K-pop MV still — Blackpink / NewJeans / BTS music-video editorial energy with a cinematic trailer-like tension, glossy styling, narrative atmosphere, and a decisive performance-frame impact.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all visible Korean must render cleanly, especially “{MV 제목}”, “{앨범/싱글명}”, “{공개일}”, “{크레딧 문구}”, and scene detail text such as “SCENE 07 / {장면 타임코드}”.
- Suggested in-frame text treatment: small lower-left or upper-right text reading “{MV 제목}”, “{앨범/싱글명}”, “{공개일} 공개”, “SCENE 07 / {장면 타임코드}”, not covering the artist’s face.
- Composition invariants: the frame must feel like one decisive MV still with strong subject focus, cinematic environment, dramatic color contrast, realistic production-set details, and polished screen-capture realism.
- The artist must look original and non-identical to any real celebrity while still carrying a premium idol-performance aura.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person face replication
- Fake award badges or official broadcast marks

studio:prompts3:ours-570.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
K-pop 포토북 앨범 자켓, 1024x1536 세로 표지형 비주얼. {앨범명·아티스트}를 중심으로, 실제 음반 매장에 진열된 포토북 커버처럼 인물 사진, 앨범 메타 정보, 버전 라벨, 트랙/크레딧, 바코드 영역까지 갖춘 고급 편집 디자인을 만든다. NewJeans·LE SSERAFIM·IVE 계열의 세련된 K-pop 앨범 무드를 참고하되, 특정 실존 인물의 얼굴을 복제하지 않고 독창적인 아이돌 화보 커버로 완성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 프레임은 1024x1536 세로 {비율}로 구성하고, 상단 16%는 앨범 타이틀과 버전 라벨, 중앙 58%는 주인공 비주얼, 하단 20%는 앨범 정보·크레딧·바코드 레이어로 분리한다.
- 주 피사체는 중앙보다 약간 아래에 배치해 시선이 타이틀과 인물에 동시에 머물도록 하고, {비주얼}이 프레임의 60~72%를 차지하게 한다.
- 배경은 {컨셉 결}에 맞는 콘셉트 세트로 구성한다. 실제 촬영 세트처럼 벽면, 바닥, 천, 조명 반사, 포스터 조각, 금속 프레임, 식물 그림자, 필름 스티커, 별빛 입자 등 콘셉트에 맞는 물성을 더해 입체감을 만든다.
- 표지 가장자리에는 인쇄물 느낌의 얇은 프레임, 작은 재단선 마크, 앨범 스파인 텍스트, 우하단 바코드 박스, 좌하단 카탈로그 번호를 배치해 실제 포토북 패키지처럼 보이게 한다.
- {앨범명·아티스트}, {앨범 종류}, {컬러 톤}, {포맷}, {비율}을 커버 정보로 자연스럽게 통합하고, 모든 텍스트는 한글·영문이 정확히 읽히도록 배치한다.
- 추가 인쇄 텍스트 예시를 작게 포함한다: “PHOTOBOOK VER.”, “VOL.01”, “2026.05 RELEASE”, “CAT. NO. KP-0526”, “MODEL CREDIT / {비주얼}”, “INCLUDES PHOTOBOOK · LYRIC CARD · MINI POSTER”, “TRACK 01 빛나는 밤”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background plane: {컨셉 결}에 맞는 스튜디오형 배경을 먼저 깐다. 시티 라이프면 다크 톤 도시 그라데이션, 창문 반사, 젖은 아스팔트 질감, 네온 사인 조각을 넣고, 자연 보헤미안이면 베이지·세이지·오프화이트 패브릭, 종이 포스터, 말린 꽃, 우드 플로어 질감을 넣는다. 우주 사이파이면 딥 블루·퍼플의 미세한 입자, 홀로그램 필름, 크롬 소품, 별자리 그래픽을 넣고, 고딕이면 차콜·블랙·메탈릭 하이라이트, 촛대 실루엣, 벨벳 커튼, 장식 프레임을 더한다. 레트로면 필름 그레인, 따뜻한 색 번짐, 빈티지 스티커, 카세트/폴라로이드 느낌의 인쇄 레이어를 적용한다.
2) Hero subject: {비주얼}의 인물을 중앙 히어로로 배치하고, 얼굴·상반신·포즈가 즉시 읽히도록 선명하게 렌더링한다. 표정은 K-pop 포토북 커버에 맞는 절제된 카리스마와 자연스러운 여유를 유지하고, 헤어·메이크업·의상 디테일은 실제 패션 에디토리얼처럼 섬세하게 표현한다.
3) Signature object layer: {비주얼} 안의 시그니처 소품을 피사체 주변 1~3개 지점에 배치해 콘셉트를 보강한다. 예: 투명 포토카드, 접힌 가사지, 메탈 키링, 미니 포스터, 리본 태그, 홀로그램 스티커, 작은 꽃가지, 필름 스트립. 소품은 인물의 시선 방향과 타이틀 가독성을 방해하지 않게 둔다.
4) Title block: 상단에 {앨범명·아티스트}를 굵고 정제된 앨범 타이틀로 배치하고, 영문 메인 타이틀과 한글 아티스트 표기가 모두 정확히 보이게 만든다. 타이틀 주변에 “THE 1ST PHOTOBOOK”, “SPECIAL EDITION”, “2026년 5월호 감성의 컴백” 같은 짧은 보조 문구를 넣어 실제 앨범 커버의 정보량을 만든다.
5) Album meta line: {앨범 종류}는 하단 또는 타이틀 주변 보조 정보로 배치하고, 포토북 표지라면 좌하단에 “PHOTOBOOK PACKAGE”, “96P BOOKLET”, “POSTCARD SET” 같은 제품 정보 라인을 넣는다. LP 자켓 느낌이 필요하면 하단 중앙에 얇은 메타 텍스트와 트랙 리스트를 넣어 레코드 커버처럼 처리한다.
6) Format framing: {포맷}에 맞춰 가장자리에 얇은 인쇄 테두리, 재단 마크, 스파인 영역, 작은 접지선 느낌을 둔다. 정사각 LP 자켓 결이면 레코드 커버처럼 중심축을 안정적으로 잡고, 세로 포토북 표지면 패션 매거진 커버처럼 타이틀·인물·하단 크레딧의 리듬을 만든다.
7) Color application: {컬러 톤}을 배경, 의상, 포인트 라이트, 타이포 컬러, 스티커, 바코드 박스, 크레딧 라인에 일관되게 반영한다. 네온이나 메탈릭 포인트가 필요한 경우 작은 라벨, 라인 그래픽, 반사광에 적용해 표지의 완성도를 높인다.
8) Real packaging details: 우하단에는 흰색 또는 반투명 바코드 영역과 가격/품번 느낌의 작은 글자를 넣는다: “₩24,000”, “ISBN 979-11-0526-052-6”, “Made in Korea”. 하단 중앙에는 짧은 트랙/챕터 라인 2~3개를 넣는다: “01. 빛나는 밤”, “02. 너의 계절”, “03. 다시, 우리”. 좌측 가장자리에는 세로 스파인 텍스트로 “{앨범명·아티스트} / {앨범 종류} / PHOTOBOOK VER.”를 넣는다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold, Noto Sans KR Bold, 또는 깔끔한 condensed sans-serif를 사용해 K-pop 앨범 커버처럼 선명하고 현대적인 인상을 만든다. 타이틀은 44~78px, 보조 텍스트는 16~28px, 크레딧·품번·트랙 리스트는 9~14px 정도의 위계로 설정한다.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 기준으로 구성하되, 시티는 #0B0F1A / #FF2BD6 / #35D7FF, 자연은 #F3EBDD / #8DAA7C / #C7B08A, 우주는 #101B3A / #7B5CFF / #B7D6FF 같은 조합을 사용한다. 작은 라벨과 스티커에는 보조색을 1~2개 더해 실제 인쇄물 같은 풍부함을 만든다.
- Border/shadow: 커버 가장자리에 1.5~2px의 얇은 인쇄 테두리, 작은 재단선, 부분적인 종이 그림자를 넣고, 피사체 아래에 8px y-offset, 20px blur, 18% opacity의 부드러운 그림자를 넣어 콜라주가 아닌 완성도 높은 앨범 자켓처럼 보이게 한다.
- Text treatment: 영문과 한글을 같은 줄에 배치할 경우 자간을 약간 넓게 주고, 한글 깨짐 없이 또렷한 벡터 타이포처럼 보이게 처리한다. 작은 크레딧도 흐릿한 장식이 아니라 실제로 읽히는 인쇄 텍스트처럼 정렬한다.
- Editorial layering: 타이틀, 인물, 스티커, 바코드, 트랙 리스트, 스파인 텍스트가 서로 다른 깊이로 겹치도록 하되, 인물의 얼굴과 핵심 타이틀은 항상 가장 선명하게 유지한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 with 80mm lens at f/5.6 for a polished fashion-cover look, or Sony A7R IV with 85mm f/1.4 for a clean idol portrait rendering.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light at 45° from upper-left, gentle fill from front-right, and a subtle rim light from behind to separate the subject from the background; keep highlights crisp but not glossy.
- Color grade: cinematic K-pop editorial grade with controlled contrast, clean blacks, and a palette driven by the selected {컬러 톤}; apply subtle grain only if it matches the {컨셉 결}.
- Material rendering: 표현되는 종이, 비닐 래핑, 홀로그램 스티커, 금속 액세서리, 패브릭 의상, 유리/크롬 소품은 실제 촬영된 제품 사진처럼 표면 반사와 질감을 분명하게 가진다.

[6. MOOD]
Premium K-pop comeback photobook cover — NewJeans / LE SSERAFIM / IVE promotional album editorial feel, high-fashion and polished like a music magazine cover, with realistic album packaging details, collectible photobook energy, and a finished retail-release appearance.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 커버 핵심 문자열은 실제 입력값인 {앨범명·아티스트}, {앨범 종류}, {컨셉 결}, {비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {포맷}, {비율}이다.
- Set additional small Korean cover lines clearly, such as “2026.05 RELEASE”, “포토북 버전”, “TRACK 01 빛나는 밤”, “초회 한정 구성”, “모델 크레딧”.
- The cover must feel like a real K-pop album jacket with precise composition framing, typography hierarchy, barcode area, spine text, track/credit microtext, and editorial polish.
- Preserve clean facial anatomy, natural hands, realistic proportion, detailed styling, and believable studio photography.
- All Korean and English text must be legible, correctly spelled, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness of a real idol
